| | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. She has spent her career advocating for her client’s interests while also achieving tangible, positive outcomes. In Congress, she will hold true to her core conservative values while ensuring Washington D.C. is working for the people of District Two. A passionate advocate for families, farms, and faith, Dobson aims to preserve the bedrock values and moral backbone that have defined our nation. With a call for Alabama common sense, she is determined to challenge the far-left agenda in Washington, D.C., advocating for the rights of property owners and defending the freedom to think, speak, and act without interference. Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia. Her decision to run for Congress is deeply rooted in a desire to secure a future for her children and to champion the principles that have made America the land of the free.

In Alaska we collected 43,000 Signatures across the largest state in the country, we did so with 400+ volunteers. All of these people are still in Alaska and they are ready for petition #2, I led the entire initiative from writing the petition, to distribution of petition books, through managing signature events, to collecting signature books, verifying signature books, and marketing / media, through Two court battles at the Alaska Superior Court & Alaska Supreme Court (which we won unanimously). Now I’m finishing writing my new petition(s) and I’m wanting to organize the volunteers better, I’m going to have 40 Team Leads across 40 Districts. Each district will have signature goals and they will help lead signature events, help collect signature books, and do education events, they will be the boots on the ground helping me finish the project faster and more efficiently than the last petition. We spent barely any money doing the first petition and I’m Expecting to spend even less this time. If you want to help sign up today, I already have 175 volunteers signed up already.

Dear Peter,
With the election so close, we’re hearing from voters asking if they can trust Trump’s commitment to real health change in America. Here’s what RFK Jr. said in response to this question:
_“President Trump has kept his word about everything so far. He did things I didn’t even ask him to do—he put me on the transition team ahead of the election.**He told me, ‘I want to leave as my legacy the end of the chronic disease epidemic and make us... the healthiest nation in the world.’** ”_
This time around, President Trump is determined to sideline the lobbyists and corporate insiders who control our agencies. Together, RFK Jr. and Donald Trump will end the chronic disease epidemic and Make America Healthy Again.
[But they can’t do this without your help.](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-trust?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trusting_trump_11_4_24_1&n=6) Every dollar will push our message to more Americans in these final critical days. If we want to elect leaders with a genuine health vision, it’s now or never.
[Can you make a donation right now and ensure we have the resources to reach every last voter?](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-trust?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trusting_trump_11_4_24_1&n=7)
[Rush Your Donation](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-trust?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=trusting_trump_11_4_24_1&n=8)
**And remember, Election Day is almost here. A vote for Trump is a vote for a healthier, stronger future for all of us.**
For our health and our future,
Team Kennedy

| Peter,

Before polls open tomorrow, I just want to take a moment to say _thank you._

We’ve come a long way since launching this campaign in April of last year. Together, we’ve built something powerful. Because of your support, encouragement, and tireless work, we have reached historic milestones that change Northern and Upper Michigan for the better.

This has only been possible with your grassroots support, working day in and day out to show MI-01 that they deserve a representative who actually shows up, listens, and fights for them.

As a 5th-generation Michigander and a veteran's advocate, I have deep roots in this district.**I've seen firsthand the challenges our families face, from lack of accessible childcare to inadequate support for veterans. I’m running for Congress because we need a representative who is truly connected to our community and committed to making a difference.**

Tomorrow, Michiganders will head to the polls and make their voices heard. And until polls close, we’ll be doing what we do best–connecting with voters and getting out the vote in MI-01. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96574268/510447112/1737394279?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTY5NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjNhYjgxNS0wOTliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6DZC0MKz5EsHXQ4HHjQnKLAjIgBSx_KP27fPmIHHTKI=&emci=ba4baf0f-099b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=f23ab815-099b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=31112076)

This is it, friend!

Tomorrow is Election Day, which means that months of knocking doors, calling neighbors, and working hard to get out the vote are coming to an end.

Just over 24 hours from now, I hope we’ll all be celebrating wins from the top of the ticket with our first woman president down the ballot to local wins throughout San Diego County.

**But before we can celebrate, there’s one crucial thing left to do: VOTE!

[_Click here to find your polling locations, make a plan, and ensure you don’t miss the chance to vote in this historic election →_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96574269/510447113/1697095066?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTY5NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjNhYjgxNS0wOTliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6DZC0MKz5EsHXQ4HHjQnKLAjIgBSx_KP27fPmIHHTKI=&emci=ba4baf0f-099b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=f23ab815-099b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=31112076)**

---

My name may not be on the ballot this time around, **but _that doesn’t mean I’m sitting this election out._**

With Vice President Kamala Harris poised to make history, good friends of mine like Assemblymember Akilah Weber, Dr. LaShae Sharp Collins, and San Diego Council President Sean Elo-Rivera running in competitive races, and propositions that address critical issues like criminal justice reform and affordable housing on the ballot, there are a lot of important choices to make this election.

**Like you, I’ll be eagerly watching as the election results come in tomorrow night, and hopefully celebrating wins for our community, our county,_and_ our country.

[_If you’re planning to vote in person tomorrow, click here to find your polling location, and join me in celebrating all the hard work countless candidates, volunteers, and activists have put into this election cycle: https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/polling-place_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96574271/510447115/1697095066?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTY5NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjNhYjgxNS0wOTliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6DZC0MKz5EsHXQ4HHjQnKLAjIgBSx_KP27fPmIHHTKI=&emci=ba4baf0f-099b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=f23ab815-099b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=31112076)**

Thank you for being a voter.

Monica Montgomery Steppe
_District Four Supervisor | San Diego County Board of Supervisors_

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges -- from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this tomorrow. So I am asking:

subject: It’s Election Eve! Here’s what you need to do for Election Day…..
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=1)
---
Peter, tomorrow is finally Election Day! And everyone will fall in two categories: those who already voted absentee or in person, and those going to vote on Election Day. First for those of you who have already voted, thank you! We need every Republican to get out & vote in this election. So you may be thinking your duty is done because you already cast your vote. But there is still something we need you to do: On Election Day we need you to contact at least 5 family/friends/coworkers/church members/neighbors. You can send them a text, an email, message on social media, or call them. But make it a goal to reach out to 5 people and **ENCOURAGE THEM TO GO VOTE!** We must swamp the vote to overcome any margin of cheating! So even if you voted beforehand, there is still work to be done on Election Day. Please contact at least 5 people. **Tell them to VOTE NO on the liberal Supreme Court judges**. Send them the image below so they remember their names. Share the info on the other judges ([available here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaOEva1Jz4u7JgJ_UBwFRQd8&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=2)). Explain the ease & benefits of voting straight party Republican. Share your knowledge with your sphere of influence & help us multiply your vote! And if you haven’t seen this video done by Governor Kevin Stitt, [click here to watch it now & share it with everyone you know! ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=hN0FNeoNOFX4sKu0n6pYneCbWLOphrPk3f8rLC_mBeScTI_2nUHw8Wf7LP7RH6ONyVfb9q4HKjd5AL26VPrKOXlBK6CgttIXftne1JtWgFNdvOFhi_3N6swWyOipKY6f&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=3) For those of you who plan to vote on Election Day, we recommend you make a plan ahead of time. Here are some suggestions:
1. Verify your polling location. [You can look it up online here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=KVdJ3K8uGr2-EEON3vpq7JrUAOTJcXIqIeMkaRQa_DKfivfTPuuMQMoqu_KdtkBV&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=4).
2. Look at your sample ballot. [You can see what your ballot will look like by entering your data here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=KVdJ3K8uGr2-EEON3vpq7JrUAOTJcXIqIeMkaRQa_DKfivfTPuuMQMoqu_KdtkBV&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=5).
3. Print your research to bring with you or save it to your phone. [You can find out info on the judges to print & bring with you here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaOEva1Jz4u7JgJ_UBwFRQd8&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=6). (**Remember: VOTE NO on all three liberal supreme court judges Edmondson, Gurich, & Kauger!**).
4. Bring someone WITH YOU to vote! Reach out to a coworker, family, friend, or anyone you can think of to bring them to vote with you!
5. Don’t forget to bring your ID. Photo id works best, but your voter id card will work as well.
6. Lines could be long as we’ve seen record turnout, so you may want to bring along some water & possibly a snack.

We’re looking forward to some huge victories on Election Day for Oklahoma & for our country. Voting straight party Republican will help get us back to the great economy we had 4 years ago. Voting NO on these liberal judges on the Oklahoma Supreme Court will help us follow the Constitution for years ahead. Together we can make a difference. Encourage everyone you know to go VOTE! -Team OKGOP

This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/unsubscribe?e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=7).
You can also keep up with OKGOP on [Twitter](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JcrYNQ7dhdufXPgOgJxNGHSsRONv6mnq7ly6aBOUvGVprSj7jfHNOpP70kR_1QLA&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=8) or [Facebook](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=UQNagEd-DqbIXa37T8ODid9mG9NGbq3z9te4_riKc6EaGmrOrRzKc2wAaVTFbzRY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_election_eve_here_s_wha&n=9).

You can send them a text, an email, message on social media, or call them. But make it a goal to reach out to 5 people and ENCOURAGE THEM TO GO VOTE! We must swamp the vote to overcome any margin of cheating! So even if you voted beforehand, there is still work to be done on Election Day. Please contact at least 5 people. Tell them to VOTE NO on the liberal Supreme Court judges. Send them the image below so they remember their names. Share the info on the other judges (). Explain the ease & benefits of voting straight party Republican. Share your knowledge with your sphere of influence & help us multiply your vote! And if you haven’t seen this video done by Governor Kevin Stitt, For those of you who plan to vote on Election Day, we recommend you make a plan ahead of time. Here are some suggestions: 1. Verify your polling location. . 2. Look at your sample ballot. . 3. Print your research to bring with you or save it to your phone. . (Remember: VOTE NO on all three liberal supreme court judges Edmondson, Gurich, & Kauger!). 4. Bring someone WITH YOU to vote! Reach out to a coworker, family, friend, or anyone you can think of to bring them to vote with you! 5. Don’t forget to bring your ID. Photo id works best, but your voter id card will work as well. 6. Lines could be long as we’ve seen record turnout, so you may want to bring along some water & possibly a snack. We’re looking forward to some huge victories on Election Day for Oklahoma & for our country. Voting straight party Republican will help get us back to the great economy we had 4 years ago. Voting NO on these liberal judges on the Oklahoma Supreme Court will help us follow the Constitution for years ahead. Together we can make a difference. Encourage everyone you know to go VOTE! -Team OKGOP

| | Tomorrow, America gets to take place in a truly unique process—voting for our country’s elected representatives. It is a privilege not everyone in the world has, and one for which so many brave American service members fought and died to defend. When you go to your local polling place, take a moment to think just how lucky we are to exercise this right. All elections are important, but this one is especially so. You are voting for the future of America and the future of Michigan. You are voting to put America and American interests first. You are voting not to turn our back on the world, but to demand more from our allies and partners and to look at the world through the lens of what’s best for Americans first. You are voting to stand up to China - to defend our national and economic security. You are voting to ensure that partnerships are built openly here in Michigan first, not clandestinely with Chinese Communist Party-backed companies. You are voting to stand up for the right to decide what’s best for you and your family, not some bureaucrat in Washington with a radical agenda. When you enter the polling booth tomorrow, I hope you will stand with me in defending America, putting Michigan families first, and entrust me with the honor and privilege of becoming your next Senator for this truly great state.

body:
https://tnhousedems.com/ [https://tnhousedems.com/]
Hi Peter,
Tomorrow is Election Day, and we’re counting on you to help shape the future of Tennessee. I’m proud to say that, because of you, we’ve been able to make historic investments across this entire state in key districts. You and other investors in our Caucus have made all of our work possible.
I have one final request before the polls open: we need to raise an additional $10,000 today to pay our phone bankers who are reaching out to voters and reminding them to vote. Can you rush a contribution now to help us make those calls? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dems24]
DONATE HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dems24]
Also, if you haven’t already voted, please take a moment to finalize your voting plan for tomorrow. Know where you’ll be voting and what time you’ll go vote, and remember to bring a state or federally issued ID. Every vote will truly matter in tomorrow’s election, especially in our most competitive House districts.
Let’s make sure that everyone who believes in a brighter, more inclusive Tennessee has the chance to make their voice heard. Spread the word and bring a friend or family member with you to the polls
With heartfelt thanks,
Rep. John Ray Clemmons

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8153%2E5257348%2E7uKl8U ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, you can
have the best-written Constitution in the world, and I believe we do.

The strongest system of checks and balances, and maybe we do.

But none of it will be enough if elected officials don’t give meaning to
their oath of office. If that oath isn’t informed by ideas of right and
wrong, and if people are unwilling to accept the truth, or even that there
is something called fact.

The tragic story of the last ten years is the story of GOP capitulation to
the immortality of the former president. The historian Robert Caro once
said that power doesn’t corrupt as much as it reveals, and it has revealed
a lot about JD Vance, Mitch McConnell, John Roberts, and so many more.
People willing to sacrifice everything they once believed in to be closer
to the seat of power.

But I think this election will reveal something else about America. It
will reveal once again that the American people value the truth and value
decency, and they want someone with integrity in the White House. Someone
like Kamala Harris.

We are a deeply resilient country, with millions of beautiful, patriotic
people in every state, and they will see us through this difficult time.
November 5th will mark the end of a very difficult chapter and the
beginning of a bright new future, if we all do our part and vote.

This is the last time I’ll ask before the polls close,
Derek. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=nov2024_abs_em.SALZ0e&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241104_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8153%2E5257348%2E7uKl8U ]I am humbly asking you
to contribute any amount that feels right to help us earn as many
Democratic votes as possible in these final hours.

For nearly two years on the campaign trail, I have been meeting with
Californians to discuss the cost of living crisis and the crisis of our
democracy.

I have never felt more strongly that we need to bring about serious change
— real change — when we elect Kamala Harris with the strong Democratic
majorities she needs to pass effective legislation tomorrow.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=nov2024_abs_em.SALZ0e&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241104_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=8153%2E5257348%2E7uKl8U ]We need a strong Democratic turnout tomorrow to hold the Senate, take
back the House, and defeat Trump. Your support still makes a difference,
and every penny counts. Please pitch in before midnight to my campaign to
help us win.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96576130/510471862/158001685?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTMzNWMwYzMtMGU5Yi1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3KhiJEo5FFFTSEQNyjQD6Rdf73PWRBe1o9uz4wOjwQk=) This is it, friend.

Tomorrow, hundreds of thousands of voters in CA-30 will have their ballots counted to decide the future of our district. Before the big day, I want to take a minute to make one last pitch as to why you should elect me as your next representative. It has been the privilege of my life to serve this community. As a Councilmember, Mayor of the City of Glendale, and as your representative in the State Assembly for the past eight years, I’ve always been a fighter for our progressive values. I championed bold policies to create more affordable housing, protect our reproductive freedoms, and make California a model for environmental sustainability and clean renewable energy, even as big oil fought us. I faced intimidation and threats after I voted to ban the Glendale Gun Show from being held near our schools, because – above all else – I’m committed to keeping our community safe. And when sexual harassment scandals struck state government, I led the charge to hold perpetrators accountable. I’m ready to deliver for this community -- on the climate crisis, housing, healthcare access, and so much more. But I cannot do this alone. Taking our locally-grown values to Washington is going to require this whole community coming together, and I cannot put into words how much I have appreciated your support every step of the way. Thank you – see you after the polls close! Laura | 🗳️ **Before you click away, have you voted yet?** 🗳️

Today is a GREAT day to submit your ballot. Don’t delay! As a Councilmember, Mayor of the City of Glendale, and as your representative in the State Assembly for the past eight years, I’ve always been a fighter for our progressive values. I championed bold policies to create more affordable housing, protect our reproductive freedoms, and make California a model for environmental sustainability and clean renewable energy, even as big oil fought us. I faced intimidation and threats after I voted to ban the Glendale Gun Show from being held near our schools, because – above all else – I’m committed to keeping our community safe. And when sexual harassment scandals struck state government, I led the charge to hold perpetrators accountable. I’m ready to deliver for this community -- on the climate crisis, housing, healthcare access, and so much more. But I cannot do this alone. Taking our locally-grown values to Washington is going to require this whole community coming together, and I cannot put into words how much I have appreciated your support every step of the way. body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Tomorrow is Election Day and it's our last chance to shine a light on one of the most important issues at stake in this election: women’s rights.
My friends at Vote Common Good made this amazing ad speaking to Republican and independent voters who want to support our campaign because they’re sick of the constant chaos.
MANY have already made the switch, but some of them are feeling a lot of pressure from other people in their lives – and this video speaks to them.
Take a look:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/women-win-wilson-c2g?refcode=20241104_jordan_against_women_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/women-win-wilson-c2g?refcode=20241104_jordan_against_women_image]
Click here to watch the whole video . [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/women-win-wilson-c2g?refcode=20241104_jordan_against_women_link1]
Jim Jordan has consistently shown us who he is – a man who votes against women, their rights, and their safety at every turn.
Will you chip in $25 or more to help us defeat Jim Jordan and fight for women everywhere? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/women-win-wilson-c2g?refcode=20241104_jordan_against_women_link2]
Let’s look at the facts and buckle up because this is a long list:
Jim Jordan voted against the Violence Against Women’s Act and its reauthorization multiple times. He said no to protecting survivors of domestic violence.
He opposed the Speak Out Act , which would empower survivors of sexual assault and harassment to speak openly.
He voted against the Right to Contraception Act , putting women’s access to essential health care at risk.
Jordan also voted against the Ensuring Access to Abortion Act and the Women’s Health Protection Act , showing his disregard for bodily autonomy and reproductive freedom.
When it came to ensuring safety through the Federal Extreme Risk Protection Order Act , he was nowhere to be found.
He refused to support the Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act , leaving women vulnerable in workplaces.
He rejected the Family Violence Prevention Services Improvement Act , essential for supporting victims and preventing violence.
Even acts like the PUMP for Nursing Mothers Act and the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act , which help working moms, didn’t receive his vote.
He voted against the Paycheck Fairness Act not once, but twice, showing he isn’t interested in closing the wage gap or supporting equal pay.
And all of these votes are just within the last few years – think of how he’s voted against women over the last 17 years.
The reality is this: Jim Jordan is not just a threat to women in Ohio. He’s a danger to women across the country.
He’s voted against ratifying the Equal Rights Amendment , the Equality Act , and countless other measures that protect women’s rights, safety, and equality.
Our campaign is about building a future where every woman’s voice, body, and safety are protected and respected.
Unlike Jordan, we’re fighting for a country where women aren’t sidelined or stripped of their rights.
Remember, what happens in the booth stays in the booth.
No matter your political affiliation or external pressure, your vote is yours and yours alone. When you step into that booth, you reclaim your voice, your choice, and your power.
Let’s show Jim Jordan that women are fighting back. Contribute now to help us end his dangerous legacy and bring real change to Washington [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/women-win-wilson-c2g?refcode=20241104_jordan_against_women_link3]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

| | Fellow Patriot,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _one day away_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. Hi, Peter!
Across the country, a dedicated group of volunteers have worked to turn out voters for the care agenda.
Our program has mobilized an impressive field operation, including over 360 paid staff and 260 volunteer canvassers and phone bankers across the Sunbelt, alongside in‐language outreach to Spanish‐speaking, infrequent voters of color. This massive outreach effort includes over 7.8 million phone calls, 300,000 door knocks, and 1.8 million text messages featuring authentic care worker stories — meaningful voter engagements powered by care workers themselves.
We’re so grateful for the care workers, caregivers, and allies in our movement who have spent days mobilizing communities across crucial swing states.
**Their conversations with voters could make the difference between four years of pro-care policies, or four years of Project 2025’s cuts to Medicare.**
Care often falls under the radar when we think about politics. But the truth is, that **care work is the work that makes everything else possible.**

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96578004/510491454/-1694523815?ms=110424_Groundupdates3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MjY4NDk1Zi0xMzliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Rgj5WN4DwNrRffEaFwmYKihE_IwAucmzAs04IvEdEAE=&emci=9ba705eb-7e98-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=6268495f-139b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=864787)

_\- Hillary Holley, Care in Action Executive Director_

clean_body: Our volunteers are proving that care work makes everything else possible. Tomorrow is Election Day — there’s only one day left to use your voice for the Care Agenda. ** Hi, Peter! Across the country, a dedicated group of volunteers have worked to turn out voters for the care agenda. Our program has mobilized an impressive field operation, including over 360 paid staff and 260 volunteer canvassers and phone bankers across the Sunbelt, alongside in‐language outreach to Spanish‐speaking, infrequent voters of color. This massive outreach effort includes over 7.8 million phone calls, 300,000 door knocks, and 1.8 million text messages featuring authentic care worker stories — meaningful voter engagements powered by care workers themselves. We’re so grateful for the care workers, caregivers, and allies in our movement who have spent days mobilizing communities across crucial swing states. Their conversations with voters could make the difference between four years of pro-care policies, or four years of Project 2025’s cuts to Medicare. Care often falls under the radar when we think about politics. But the truth is, that care work is the work that makes everything else possible. If you’re feeling stressed about the election and cast your ballot already, take a look at these photos and updates from the ground in North Carolina: “After debriefing with the workers who knocked over 2,500 doors in NC yesterday, it’s clear that we can win." \- Hillary Holley, Care in Action Executive Director What to expect on Election Night (and beyond): If you haven’t voted yet, ** ** **** Thank you for your support. We’re counting on you! Care in Action

clean_body: We can’t let them flip the Lone Star State blue | Fellow Patriot, I’m taking a few minutes off the campaign trail to write you this email. 1: Early voting here in Texas, like in most of the country, is well underway. This election isn’t going to be decided on November 5th -- the most crucial ballots are being cast RIGHT NOW, at this very second. 2: As we inch closer to the end of the campaign, Democrats are turning up the heat on me. My opponent is raising money hand over fist, and reports indicate that Kamala Harris plans to ratchet up her efforts in the Lone Star State during the home stretch. 3: If I lose my seat to Colin Allred, that’s the ballgame. Republicans will fail to take back control of the Senate. At that point, Kamala will likely have won the presidency too, along with a massive Democrat Majority in the House of Representatives. I hate reaching out and asking for money like this. But the truth is that every dollar you donate is another loyal Republican voter I can turn out to the polls. body:
#

Peter, this is the last time I’ll write to you before Election Day.
There’s not much I can say that hasn’t already been said, so I wanted to come to you with gratitude.
I’ve known tough times in my life. Every time, I’ve gotten to the other side because I’ve had people who cared about me. People who supported me. People who believed in me.
For a kid who grew up sleeping on the floor to be in a neck-and-neck race for a U.S. Senate seat in one of the most important elections in the history of our country, it’s incredibly humbling.
But I’ve never forgotten that it is people like you, Peter, that got me here. People who have put in their time and effort to support someone they might never meet because they have hope that we can do better. So, one more time, thank you.
I promise you that I will not forget it.
But to win this race, we have to hit our final goals. We set out to raise $1.5 million before the polls close to reach all of our voters and be ready for whatever comes next. We’re close now, and if we make good progress tonight and tomorrow we can hit that goal. It’s critical that we do.
So, if you’re still with me, I’m humbly asking you:

name: Bob Casey
subject: These are more than words to me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
Once again I am asking for the honor of your trust.
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4787%2E552475%2Ei6HXEs)
**_"All public service is a trust, given in faith and accepted in honor.”_**
Peter, those are the words inscribed over the front door of the Finance Building in Harrisburg, where I began my public service as PA’s Auditor General.
But they’re so much more than words to me.
One thing you might not know about me is that my wife, Terese, and I raised our four daughters in the same community where I grew up — my hometown of Scranton, PA.
Pennsylvania has been and always will be my home. If there is anything I've learned from serving the Commonwealth, it’s that PA’s hardworking people need an actual champion in Washington — which brings me back to those words.
**_All public service is a trust, given in faith._** As your Senator, I am reminded every day that you have put your trust in me to fight for what’s right.
**_And accepted in honor._** I work to earn that trust by standing up for you and your families: against Republican attacks on Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid; against tax cuts for the ultra-rich; against countries like China that threaten our jobs with unfair trade practices; and against big health care companies raising costs for the middle class.
Peter, my record as Senator makes it clear who I’m fighting for in Washington. My Republican opponent, on the other hand, has a decades-long record of selling out working people and shipping jobs overseas — to enrich himself and his Wall Street friends. That’s why the stakes are too high to sit out this election.
I am once again asking for the honor of your trust:
**[Our re-election fight is among the most expensive and competitive Senate races in the country. I will do whatever it takes to defend this seat and our Democratic Majority — and I’m asking you to make your first donation to fuel the fight.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241104-9?refcode=em20241104-9&refcode2=4787_552475_i6HXEs&akid=4787%2E552475%2Ei6HXEs)**
**[Donate ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241104-9?refcode=em20241104-9&refcode2=4787_552475_i6HXEs&akid=4787%2E552475%2Ei6HXEs)**
Thank you for being part of our team.
With gratitude,
Bob Casey

Peter,

It’s hard to believe we’re finally here. It’s the eve of Election Day.

While we finalize our last-minute pitch to undecided voters out on the campaign trail, I’m looking back with gratitude for this movement. We’ve come a long way since launching this campaign – and now we’re inches away from unseating Mike Garcia and ensuring a Democratic majority.

It was never my plan to run for Congress. I dedicated my career to delivering results for our community as NASA Chief of Staff under President Obama, creating over 700 good jobs in Santa Clarita and the Antelope Valley, and co-founding a first-of-its-kind wildfire prevention organization.

I realized that Mike Garcia was putting party over the people he was elected to serve. It shows in his votes for an extreme abortion ban, shady self-serving stock dealings, and alignment with Trump and the far-right.

| **San Joaquin, Stanislaus, and Merced County Farm Bureaus Endorse John Duarte for Congress**
---
| | **Merced** \- The San Joaquin, Stanislaus, and Merced County Farm Bureaus have officially endorsed Congressman John Duarte for re-election. As a fourth-generation Valley farmer and member of the Farm Bureau, John Duarte understands the challenges facing California’s farmers.

_“We feed the nation from California’s Central Valley,”_ said Congressman John Duarte._“We need to support our local farmers, secure water for the Valley, and provide our agricultural community with the resources to succeed for generations to come.”_

The Farm Bureau endorsements join a broad list of support for Congressman Duarte's re-election campaign. For more information about John Duarte and his campaign, visit www.JohnDuarteforCongress.com.

| | Fellow Patriot,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _one day away_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. Team —

When I was in Iraq, in urban combat, we had a special knock we’d use when we were surrounded by insurgents.

The comfort in that knock was knowing that while danger was all around you, the person on the other side of the door was friendly — someone you could depend on.

I’ve never been afraid to ask for help when I needed it. And right now, I’m knocking. I’m coming to you for help, friend.

Kari Lake is on the offense. With just a few days until voting ends, she has a resource advantage over us. She’s got more money to spend, and she is funneling all of it into a massive surge. She’s outspending us on television in one of the most important regions of the state. **But I refuse to let her win.**

I did not swear an oath to support and defend the Constitution to lose against someone who has spread more lies and disinformation about our elections than any other politician in the country after Trump himself. [**If you’re with me, donate $10.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56814?t=7&akid=22512%2E4449941%2ERNhzM-)

I did not lose some of my best friends in combat to cede the democracy they fought for to Trump, Lake, and the MAGA Right. This election is bigger than just who controls the House, the Senate, or the White House. It is about ensuring our democracy survives for our kids and our grandkids. [**If you’re with me, donate $10.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56814?t=8&akid=22512%2E4449941%2ERNhzM-)

In the toughest times of my life, I have been incredibly fortunate to have the support I needed to get through. My mom, my sisters, my community, my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. **And we did not come this far to lose to Kari Lake.** [**I can’t overstate how important this is: Please, make a split $10 donation with Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats and my campaign today if you are ready to help me win this campaign for U.S. Senate, hold our Senate Majority, and defend our democracy.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56814?t=9&akid=22512%2E4449941%2ERNhzM-) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Ruben Gallego will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56815?t=10&akid=22512%2E4449941%2ERNhzM-)

### A Better Way Forward
---
On the eve of the election, I wanted to take a few minutes to share a few thoughts as we head into the big day.

I believe tomorrow is a consequential day for all Americans as our nation faces
economic instability, national security threats, and unrest on the global stage.

We need to find a better way forward by learning how to work together again so we can find solutions to these challenges.

Over the last few months, I’ve laid out my vision for a more affordable future, discussed the need to secure our borders, and shared how I would use my years as a district court judge to improve public safety.

I hope I’ve earned your vote through my commitment to finding solutions to the
problems facing this country and helping you and your family achieve the American Dream.

I’m grateful for the overwhelming support I’ve received for my vision for Minnesota’s Third District, and I feel confident about winning this election. However, no one—not even the most experienced pollsters—knows for sure what will happen in tomorrow’s election.

But that doesn’t mean we face an uncertain future. I believe we all walk a divinely appointed path, and we can rest in the knowledge that we are running the good race.

The values that are the bedrock of my campaign—faith, freedom, family, and love of country—are not limited to politics. I hope you will join me in championing these values in big and small ways throughout our communities beyond this election season. Because it’s worth repeating, we need a better way forward.

This election season ends tomorrow, and then the work begins to heal this country and make the American Dream a reality for every person, regardless of political beliefs.

Thank you for your support, and please be sure to vote. And of course, God Bless America.

Sincerely,
Tad Jude

P.S. For election night updates, be sure to check my Facebook page, where I will livestream the results as they become available.

body:
we gotta run through the tape
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96579145/510498386/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3748-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDNjZDAyOS0xZDliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sZKwizSCqW-sf-zN9tmVvh_Dugrgt33bL-_6KYpZ_BM=)
Friend, with Election Day tomorrow, I know you're probably getting a lot of emails. But I hope you read this one all the way to the end because it's a little different.

**I'd like to start by saying thank you, friend.** I’m beyond grateful for this incredible grassroots team – made up of thousands of working folks who believe that together, we can make a difference for our country.

Whether you’ve shown up to an event, visited a stop on my bus tour, chipped in a few bucks, or volunteered to knock on doors, I’m proud to have you alongside me in this fight.
And this is a fight unlike any other, friend. It’s the closest Senate race in the country, and it will ultimately decide control of the chamber. Now, I don't like to think much about Democrat or Republican, or left or right – I'll work with anyone if it means making the lives of Ohioans and working families better.

But this year, the choice could not be more clear. I'm running for reelection to increase wages, lower costs, defend our fundamental freedoms, and protect the Dignity of Work.

Meanwhile, my opponent thinks he knows how to live your life better than you do. He wants to give his billionaire friends a tax cut, slash programs like Social Security and Medicare, and strip us of our rights. **I know we can do better than Bernie Moreno, friend – because I've seen it myself.**
Growing up in Mansfield, Ohio, I was surrounded by a community of ironworkers, carpenters, auto workers, and electricians. I spent summers working on my family's farm – and I saw how getting a good job meant you could build a good life for yourself and your family.

But I saw firsthand how corporations lobbied for tax breaks and bad trade deals that shipped Ohio jobs overseas and increased the everyday costs of groceries and medicine. Now who does that serve?

Not the teacher in Akron or the nurse in Dayton. And not the thousands of hardworking Americans who get up every day and head to work with the determination to provide for their families, and the hope that their kids will have it a little better than they did.

**That's why I've devoted my life to fighting for the Dignity of Work – the belief that hard work should pay off for everyone, no matter who you are, where you live, or what kind of work you do. Because when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work.**
So now I’m in the fight of my life to defend Ohio’s seat and our Senate majority. And as I reflect on this journey, I am filled with so much hope, friend. Because you believe in fighting for the little guy, standing up for working families, and coming together for a brighter future, just like I do.
**So now, with the finish line in sight, we gotta run through the tape. Polls show this race is statistically tied, which means we need to do everything in our power to get out every last vote and win.**

**So with Election Day just hours away, I’m personally asking one more time, friend: **[Will you give $5 now to help us win in Ohio, defend our Senate majority, and continue the fight for the Dignity of Work?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96579146/510498387/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk3748-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDNjZDAyOS0xZDliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sZKwizSCqW-sf-zN9tmVvh_Dugrgt33bL-_6KYpZ_BM=)
Together, we fight. Together, we win.
In solidarity,

clean_body: we gotta run through the tape | | | = Friend, with Election Day tomorrow, I know you're probably getting a lot of emails. But I hope you read this one all the way to the end because it's a little different. I'd like to start by saying thank you, friend. I’m beyond grateful for this incredible grassroots team – made up of thousands of working folks who believe that together, we can make a difference for our country. Whether you’ve shown up to an event, visited a stop on my bus tour, chipped in a few bucks, or volunteered to knock on doors, I’m proud to have you alongside me in this fight. And this is a fight unlike any other, friend. It’s the closest Senate race in the country, and it will ultimately decide control of the chamber. Now, I don't like to think much about Democrat or Republican, or left or right – I'll work with anyone if it means making the lives of Ohioans and working families better. But this year, the choice could not be more clear. I'm running for reelection to increase wages, lower costs, defend our fundamental freedoms, and protect the Dignity of Work. Meanwhile, my opponent thinks he knows how to live your life better than you do. He wants to give his billionaire friends a tax cut, slash programs like Social Security and Medicare, and strip us of our rights. I know we can do better than Bernie Moreno, friend – because I've seen it myself. Growing up in Mansfield, Ohio, I was surrounded by a community of ironworkers, carpenters, auto workers, and electricians. I spent summers working on my family's farm – and I saw how getting a good job meant you could build a good life for yourself and your family. But I saw firsthand how corporations lobbied for tax breaks and bad trade deals that shipped Ohio jobs overseas and increased the everyday costs of groceries and medicine. Now who does that serve? Not the teacher in Akron or the nurse in Dayton. And not the thousands of hardworking Americans who get up every day and head to work with the determination to provide for their families, and the hope that their kids will have it a little better than they did. That's why I've devoted my life to fighting for the Dignity of Work – the belief that hard work should pay off for everyone, no matter who you are, where you live, or what kind of work you do. Because when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. So now I’m in the fight of my life to defend Ohio’s seat and our Senate majority. And as I reflect on this journey, I am filled with so much hope, friend. Because you believe in fighting for the little guy, standing up for working families, and coming together for a brighter future, just like I do. So now, with the finish line in sight, we gotta run through the tape. Polls show this race is statistically tied, which means we need to do everything in our power to get out every last vote and win. When I was in Iraq, in urban combat, we had a special knock we’d use when we were surrounded by insurgents.
The comfort in that knock was knowing that while danger was all around you, the person on the other side of the door was friendly — someone you could depend on.
I’ve never been afraid to ask for help when I needed it. And right now, I’m knocking. I’m coming to you for help.
Kari Lake is on the offense. With less than 24 hours until voting ends, she has a resource advantage over us. She’s got more money to spend, and she is funneling all of it into a massive surge. She’s outspending us on television in one of the most important regions of the state. But I refuse to let her win.
I did not swear an oath to support and defend the Constitution to lose against someone who has spread more lies and disinformation about our elections than any other politician in the country after Trump himself. If you’re with me, donate $20. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]
I did not lose some of my best friends in combat to cede the democracy they fought for to Trump, Lake, and the MAGA Right. This election is bigger than just who controls the House, the Senate, or the White House. It is about ensuring our democracy survives for our kids and our grandkids. If you’re with me, donate $20. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]

Using round numbers...
1\. Our early vote/MIB for Republicans is up ~10% this year compared to 2020.
2\. Dem's is down 21%.
3\. I ran 3 different scenarios accounting for different levels of IN-PERSON voter turnout: low, moderate, and the average of 2016 and 2020 turnout.
4\. The concerns:
* #1 What portion of the 10% increase in Rep MIB are low propensity voters versus high propensity voters just voting early? My indication is that it's mostly just a shift in votes from tomorrow to earlier.
* #2 What portion of Dem's MIB decline will show up tomorrow at the polls instead + illegals voting + shenanigans occurring like suitcases under tables coming out.
* #3 Did Trump's campaign do enough to convince Independent voters to vote for him this time? In 2020, they overwhelmingly voted for Biden. We must hit on all cylinders tomorrow.

We have no margin for error.
* Turnout is key.
* Calling your low propensity voting cousin and getting him out to vote is key (and should have ALWAYS been the strategy... not registering ppl)
* See fraud? Take out your phone and make them famous.

I'll see y'all on the other side in the morning. Blessings!

name: Ken Burns
subject: Asking you to support Ruben Gallego in Arizona.

body:
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
#

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241101-6-160&refcode2=3538.734936.JhtQVW&t=1&akid=3538%2E734936%2EJhtQVW)
---
Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns.
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations.
To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father.
His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division.
We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign.
[**Can you make a donation of $20.24 or whatever you can afford to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona? This is a critical moment for our country, and I would not ask for your help if this were not so important.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241101-6-160&amount=20.24&t=2&akid=3538%2E734936%2EJhtQVW)

subject: Is there ANYTHING we can say before Election Day begins?
body:

#
Peter — with only ONE DAY left until Election Day, here are three reasons why we need your help now more than ever.
1. **Lucas Kunce is in a STATISTICAL TIE with Josh Hawley.** This is huge news. The latest poll shows Lucas within the margin of error, only down three points behind Josh Hawley. Our chances of winning this race have never been better, and it’s why we need all the help we can get to reach voters over this final day to close this small gap.
2. **Lucas Kunce is gaining momentum after his stellar performance in the debate against Josh Hawley.** Take a look at social media: Missourians were extremely impressed by Lucas’ performance in the debate last Thursday. body:

I’m used to being written off,
Peter.

When I first ran for Congress, no one thought I could win — especially
when an extremely popular challenger jumped into the race.

I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time, and she said,
“Well Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s
going to be tough.”

I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my
turn?”

The next thing I said was this: I believe that women have to run —
especially when it’s hard — and not wait our turn. We can’t wait until we
get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.

I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman elected to
the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last
time our team would make history.

When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots
supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us
off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the chamber from our
state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.

In 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and enduring
over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and we won.

Time and again, grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the
odds. The battle to protect my seat this year will be no different, as I
try to win reelection in the most competitive Senate race in the country.

Eric Hovde and his GOP allies have already spent more than $100 million to
buy this seat and recent polls show my opponent in the lead for the first
time. Protecting this seat won’t be easy, but together, I know we can defy
the odds once more.

In recent news we have [heard of Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/d5d2eac3-a12f-4548-96d1-32546c29a95a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s wistful thinking that he should have never left the White House, in the same speech in which he made remarks about violence to members of the press. We have heard of Trump supporter Elon Musk's unlawful interference in international diplomacy by [communicating and colluding with Putin to limit internet access to Taiwan](https://substack.com/redirect/66826430-0170-49c5-ae39-020579a97713?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And we have heard of the [close 10-year friendship of Donald Trump with sexual predator Jeffrey Epstein. ](https://substack.com/redirect/e4190425-2021-4e14-8d35-ac561b9cf1aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
MAGA supporter and House Speaker Mike Johnson campaigned this week for MAGA Republican Brandon Williams. Williams' district includes Utica and Syracuse, and is in commuting distance to Albany. All of these areas are poised to benefit from the new microchip industry made possible by Biden's CHIPS Act. Mike Johnson - did he even know where he was when he said this, or does he just not care - declared that if Trump is elected, [they will repeal the CHIPS Act. ](https://substack.com/redirect/b81c1751-6a8a-420a-b3d7-d671ab190b1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As you know, I am often referred to as the Radical Far Left Liberal Democrat. Elise Stefanik, the far right fascist sympathizer (I'll spare you the excessive use of capital letters), has had no comment to make on Trump's gaffes and goofs, nor those of her fellow MAGA supporters. (Johnson, btw, is also afar right fascist sympathizer.)
Instead of releasing a statement on the egregiousness of Donald Trump's remarks, or the insult of Mike Johnson's remarks, Stefanik instead accused NCPR of "election interference" for reporting her early vote in Saratoga County in an area that has been redisctricted. The far right fascist sympathizer [threatened to pull funding](https://substack.com/redirect/135cd223-147e-4449-8f08-22283ef5165c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from NCPR for the error.
In other news, she [shrieked over the "Far Left Democrats" ](https://substack.com/redirect/1793f87c-5f56-40ea-98e7-ef2b74ae33dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)who penned a fraudulent letter, allegedly from a Glens Falls businessman. WNYT called me for a comment. I know nothing of the letter, just as Castelli knew nothing of the letter two years ago.
Meanwhile, to my knowledge, there has not been a single campaign appearance by our representative that was advertised in advance and open to the public. To my knowledge, all appearances were basically private affairs, with news of them made public after the fact. Please correct me if I am wrong. No voter had an opportunity to learn about an event, attend the event, and ask their elected Congressional representative a question or voice a concern.
Additionally, in this cycle, and in the five prior cycles that Stefanik has been in office, there has been zero progress made on legislation that is helpful to daily life in New York's 21st Congressional District.
We are no closer to having an immigration bill.
We are no closer to having access to affordable healthcare for all, including care for mental health and addiction issues.
We are no closer to limits on price gouging. (By the way, I paid $2.89 a gallon for gas in Antwerp, NY today!)
We are no closer to help for veterans.
We are no closer to getting the Farm Bill renewed.
We are no closer to a congressional plan to address the housing crisis.
We are no close to a congressional response to multi-generational poverty, and all of its collateral consequences.
And - super important because time is running out on this one - we are no closer to having a national climate change policy.
New York 21 deserves a representative who is available to them to answer questions and to voice concerns.
If you haven't voted yet, please go vote. If you have voted, please ask your co-workers, your neighbors, the people at the grocery store, the people you meet during your day: "What's your voting plan?" If you know someone who needs a ride to the polls and you can do it, please be that person. If a voter needs someone to watch a child or an elderly parent while they run to the polls, please be that person.
We have had a succession of diminishing returns by the Democratic candidate in NY-21.
My hope is that the election in 2024 will reverse that trend.
I'm just getting started.
To quote the song that is often sung at the Harris rallies: "I'm a keep a-running 'cause a winner don't quit on themselves."
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

The far right fascist sympathizer from NCPR for the error. In other news, she penned a fraudulent letter, allegedly from a Glens Falls businessman. WNYT called me for a comment. I know nothing of the letter, just as Castelli knew nothing of the letter two years ago. Meanwhile, to my knowledge, there has not been a single campaign appearance by our representative that was advertised in advance and open to the public. To my knowledge, all appearances were basically private affairs, with news of them made public after the fact. Please correct me if I am wrong. No voter had an opportunity to learn about an event, attend the event, and ask their elected Congressional representative a question or voice a concern. Additionally, in this cycle, and in the five prior cycles that Stefanik has been in office, there has been zero progress made on legislation that is helpful to daily life in New York's 21st Congressional District. We are no closer to having an immigration bill. We are no closer to having access to affordable healthcare for all, including care for mental health and addiction issues. We are no closer to limits on price gouging. (By the way, I paid $2.89 a gallon for gas in Antwerp, NY today!) We are no closer to help for veterans. We are no closer to getting the Farm Bill renewed. We are no closer to a congressional plan to address the housing crisis. We are no close to a congressional response to multi-generational poverty, and all of its collateral consequences. And - super important because time is running out on this one - we are no closer to having a national climate change policy. New York 21 deserves a representative who is available to them to answer questions and to voice concerns. If you haven't voted yet, please go vote. If you have voted, please ask your co-workers, your neighbors, the people at the grocery store, the people you meet during your day: "What's your voting plan?" If you know someone who needs a ride to the polls and you can do it, please be that person. If a voter needs someone to watch a child or an elderly parent while they run to the polls, please be that person. We have had a succession of diminishing returns by the Democratic candidate in NY-21. My hope is that the election in 2024 will reverse that trend. I'm just getting started. To quote the song that is often sung at the Harris rallies: "I'm a keep a-running 'cause a winner don't quit on themselves." If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

body:
What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3c9m4o0rjs0gkdatc94l93dmnli9389e5rtb6t0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c3g62ob5chh2bs)
---
| | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9fca5619i5pg20khjg83euv8u2u7dekrlsdpjo8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c3g62ob5chh2bs) Dear Fellow American,

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

body:
Ready to make history, friend?
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3007345/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi there,

It's finally here—the last day to cast your ballot for the brighter future that Kamala Harris and Tim Walz can deliver. |
---
|
* * *
### 🔮 What to Expect
|
---
| Whatever happens today, there are a few things we're keeping in mind:

* It is normal and expected for results to take some time. And if the democratic process is endangered, the progressive movement is ready to support efforts to make sure every vote gets counted.

* The long trajectory of our work to secure a safer climate and a brighter future goes on—regardless of the outcome of this election. We cannot give up, because every fraction of a degree of warming we avoid equates to lives saved.

* YOUR vote and YOUR commitment to the climate movement matter. The climate crisis is already here, and we need all hands on deck.

|
---
| In other words: **Every vote matters, every fraction of a degree matters, and every one of the actions you take now matters.** |
---
|
* * *
### 🗳️ Go Vote
|
---
| _If you already voted, thank you!_ If you haven't voted yet, please get to the polls as soon as you can today:

* [Check your registration and look up your polling place](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3007346/87SdQ4wZ) and hours of operation

* Don't forget to [bring a valid form of ID if your state requires it](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3007347/87SdQ4wZ), and be prepared to stand in line for as long as you need to make sure your vote is counted

* If you have trouble voting, call or text [the voter protection hotline](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3007348/87SdQ4wZ) at 866-OUR-VOTE (866-687-8683)

|
---
|
* * *
There's a good chance we won't know tonight who our next president will be, the makeup of Congress, or the results of all the critical down-ballot races in states and cities across the country. And that's okay. Getting it right is so much more important than getting it fast, as each state takes the time it needs to count _every single_ vote.

No matter what the results turn out to be, **please know that Evergreen will never stop fighting for our climate, our democracy, and the thriving, just, and inclusive clean energy future that we all deserve.**

Thank you for being here with us for the long game,

Team Evergreen |
* * *
---
| _Evergreen is building the ambitious, actionable policy roadmap for an all-out mobilization to defeat climate change—and to create millions of jobs in a thriving, just, and inclusive clean energy future. None of this would be possible without your support._ |

name: Citizens for Turner
subject: Election Day is Here!
body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | Dear Friend, **Election Day is here!** Throughout my time in Congress, I have always stood up for the Miami Valley. Whether it is increasing jobs at Wright Patterson Air Force Base to over 38,000, securing federal funds for our community, or protecting our healthcare;**I will always show up to fight for you**. My work is not possible without your support. This is a pivotal election that will determine control of Congress and the direction of our country. Your vote is important in securing a majority in the House and fighting for the values we all hold dear. **I ask for your support today so that I may continue to serve and represent you.** Please join me in voting today!

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | Dear Friend, Election Day is here! Throughout my time in Congress, I have always stood up for the Miami Valley. Whether it is increasing jobs at Wright Patterson Air Force Base to over 38,000, securing federal funds for our community, or protecting our healthcare;I will always show up to fight for you. My work is not possible without your support. This is a pivotal election that will determine control of Congress and the direction of our country. Your vote is important in securing a majority in the House and fighting for the values we all hold dear. I ask for your support today so that I may continue to serve and represent you. Please join me in voting today! | | | | | | | | | Sincerely, Congressman Michael R. Turner

body:
Let's create a Better West Michigan for All!
| | |
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001fRg6Qhkr0wN7pd5OjOPU2BYljrfh-KjMdNdkrUIC6OZekD_fpFMCJX_LNptIUnUtJLRX6GaNFenJMkTrJkhdloXt92l7Ohkt5y3NrZzp5n1Uxu_y3Inxq2ZMWUVudwQV7grhmWje97co3_1DdVYJ3xpPvVeeZK4ND1GT1V3wTfo=&c=4gm96JVf49TgLnOyEJO9bjvySFRScSe-bFZXlu9EAr5WVpKxM4jDwQ==&ch=VuoaoX7ToO1S3ZNwkqoSMF6yTs2MG2YhHEymd5-Pl5qUHTWLvMvrLA==)

|
Friend

Today is Election Day!
It has been the honor of a lifetime to run to be your next United States Congressman, and I would be honored to earn your vote today.
Throughout this race, we have focused on our positive message of bringing Growth, Prosperity, and Security to the people of West Michigan.
Just as important, we have stayed out of all the nonsense that is swirling in politics these days.
---
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001fRg6Qhkr0wN7pd5OjOPU2BYljrfh-KjMdNdkrUIC6OZekD_fpFMCJX_LNptIUnUtJLRX6GaNFenJMkTrJkhdloXt92l7Ohkt5y3NrZzp5n1Uxu_y3Inxq2ZMWUVudwQV7grhmWje97co3_1DdVYJ3xpPvVeeZK4ND1GT1V3wTfo=&c=4gm96JVf49TgLnOyEJO9bjvySFRScSe-bFZXlu9EAr5WVpKxM4jDwQ==&ch=VuoaoX7ToO1S3ZNwkqoSMF6yTs2MG2YhHEymd5-Pl5qUHTWLvMvrLA==)
---
|
Over the past year, I've had the chance to travel across the district and meet voters from all walks of life. I think we all have a lot more in common than some people on social media and cable news like to pretend.
There are common-sense solutions to the problems that we face as a nation, if we have leaders who are willing to come together to work productively.
That's my approach: Paul for All. Let's put aside the petty and divisive politics and look forward to the future with resolve and optimism.
Finally, let me give my deepest thanks to all of you out there who decided to join Team Hudson. We truly couldn't have done it without all of your support.
Now let's go win this thing!
---
|
-- Paul Hudson

It has been the honor of a lifetime to run to be your next United States Congressman, and I would be honored to earn your vote today. Throughout this race, we have focused on our positive message of bringing Growth, Prosperity, and Security to the people of West Michigan. Just as important, we have stayed out of all the nonsense that is swirling in politics these days. | == | Over the past year, I've had the chance to travel across the district and meet voters from all walks of life. I think we all have a lot more in common than some people on social media and cable news like to pretend. There are common-sense solutions to the problems that we face as a nation, if we have leaders who are willing to come together to work productively. That's my approach: Paul for All. Let's put aside the petty and divisive politics and look forward to the future with resolve and optimism. # November 5, 2024
---
| LAST CHANCE - Polls Close Tonight
---
| It's Election Day! Most polls close tonight at 8PM, so if you haven't vote, please get out there and do so.
This is probably the most consequential election of our lifetime - we have a great chance to change the trajectory of our government so that the American Dream is within reach of every family.
But in order to make this happen, we all must vote.
Haven't voted yet? If you have your paper ballot, simply mark it and drop it off in a drop box, mail box, or bring it to a vote center.
If you can't find your ballot, head on over to a vote center and they'll give you a replacement ballot.

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund
subject: It’s Now or Never – Cast Your Ballot for Trump Today!
body:
You can still help us Get Out The Vote before the polls close!
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| ****************
###
**__****__********Today, we vote to save America. Today, we vote to protect our families. Today, we vote to revive the greatest country the world has ever known**. **_However, we can 't do all of that without you!_** We cannot stop until the polls close in every state, because Donald Trump must take back the White House and Americans must take back our nation. There is still time for you to help get people to the polls and cast their ballots for Trump. Here's how you can do that based on where you live:
---
| |
---
| ******** **** **********FIRST: Make Sure YOU Vote!**
If you haven't voted yet, today is your day! Make your plan and get to the polls. No excuses! Take a book, a snack, and a water bottle, just in case your line is long. Do not let long lines stop you from saving our country! **
SECOND: Get OTHER Trump Supporters to Vote!
** Take everyone Trump supporter with you that hasn't voted yet. You are the one who can make the difference between winning and losing! The first item you'll find below are links to educational resources that will help you, should you need well-referenced information about the candidates. | | | | | Happy Election Day! Polls are officially open across the 9th District! Today, all the dedication, energy, and support you’ve given has brought us to this important moment. Now, it’s time to make our voices heard across the 9th District and ensure every vote counts.
Polls are open from 6 AM to 7 PM, so make a plan to vote early if you can, and remind friends, family, and neighbors to do the same! Whether you’re voting on your way to work, during lunch, or after picking up the kids, every single vote brings us closer to unseating Morgan Griffith.
If you’re unsure where to go, you can find your polling place easily at [iwillvote.com](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=908fea119d&e=8cac9e7f7d).
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | If you have friends or family planning to vote for Morgan Griffith or are straight-ticket Republicans, consider sharing some of his positions with them with the graphic on this email. And remind them — it’s absolutely okay to split their ticket. A little information can go a long way in helping them make an informed choice.
---
|
---
| Thank you for being a part of this journey. Let’s make history together!
With gratitude and excitement,Karen Baker

# **Election Watch Party**
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
|
Friends,

_**Today is election day!**_

I am both excited and nervous about the future of our Nation. Much is on the line with the White House, Senate, and House all up for grabs.

Win or lose today, we must keep fighting to save this great country. **Because freedom is worth fighting for.**

I grew up in the Bronx, raised my family in the Bronx, and built a business in the Bronx. **I love New York and I appreciate Patriots like you.**

I'll be holding an election watch party tonight in The Bronx to watch the election results come in.

**Be sure to VOTE TODAY** , then join me for food, fellowship, and a fun time in Boogie Down Bronx tonight starting at 8PM at 1501 Bassett Avenue.

Let's keep up the fight!
_**Tina**_

At 15, I began taking early morning shifts at a doughnut shop before school. And while it wasn't much, the extra cash helped give my family and me the life we always dreamt of.

But do you know who else got their start in the doughnut business? My Trump-backed opponent, Rick Scott. However, while I made minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, he _owned_ two shops and reaped the benefits of his employees' hard work.
**Friend, like you, I believe we should have a leader who knows the meaning of hard work, not someone who uses others to work hard _for_ him. And that's why I'm in this race — to give Florida the leadership it deserves. **

My family moved to the U.S. from Ecuador with big dreams for a better life when I was 14 — and that better life didn't come easy. At 15, I began taking early morning shifts at a doughnut shop before school. And while it wasn't much, the extra cash helped give my family and me the life we always dreamt of. But do you know who else got their start in the doughnut business? My Trump-backed opponent, Rick Scott. However, while I made minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, he owned two shops and reaped the benefits of his employees' hard work. Friend, like you, I believe we should have a leader who knows the meaning of hard work, not someone who uses others to work hard for him. And that's why I'm in this race — to give Florida the leadership it deserves. But we still have work to do if we want to get out the vote in Florida and retire Rick Scott for good. clean_body: Let’s get out and vote in record numbers! Are you with us?| | | = | | | Hi Peter, TODAY is Election Day – all of our efforts this fall have been leading up to this moment!
