subject: My Election Day Message
body:
The time for talk is over—today is a day for action and our moment to make history. | | | | | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsGRA_J6jtCqYTGf9TBARmggSPVbT9acGv-q3fuGkH5fpWKqqPlmD81G2Ja6cSXR_GQGr7irGGwY2TUsaA4tbOwnS_oVl-SCOjaRBBb7gBAOG9Z_D2-VrUhbjSbtGz2uvmTKXFvDLwhRYcRs4h08kxX_gM9564vln777wJuqfZ_6GSc2eNxxEbzO5iWleP5fESCtvg-KUKnOnm6nzv2_ql99cUyXAX9naa6Ewtq2f_69rvy-F1ws2FaF72kIAWRtZpAVznizgnj_DxB4n484R8A_A-zlDaXCPq99BRi6eu-LErNscMq1RY6F_BWmclT7-I/4b7/-80Y1aROSq6RbHYpuNfoYA/h0/h001.VMP4yYKDlTPLf4l3hjE16y1H4QK28gmPrIo0qmc1_kE)
---
---
---
Today is the day.

This is not just any Election Day—it’s the most important election of our lives, the day we decide the future of our country. Democracy isn’t a guarantee; it’s something we must protect and defend every single day.

**The time for talk is over—today is a day for action and our moment to make history.**

This election is about choosing a positive vision for America—one where everyone has a fair shot, where we invest in education, protect the environment, defend women’s freedom to make choices over their own bodies, and ensure that health care and housing are within reach for every American. Up and down the ballot, Democrats are running to unite people, strengthen communities, and ensure our government serves all of us, not just a powerful few.

Every door you knocked, every conversation you started, and every reminder to vote has led us to this moment. Whether you've reached one person or ten thousand, your work has made an impact.

**So, let’s bring it home today.**
**
**

name: Anthony D'Esposito
subject: Tomorrow is Election Day — Let’s Secure Our Future Together!
body:
Hi Peter, Tuesday is Election Day, and this is our moment to make sure New York’s 4th District keeps moving forward. In Congress, I’ve taken real action to protect our community, secure our borders, and stand up for our values.
[](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-muhtyly-dytjdljkkt-r/) Hi Peter, Tuesday is Election Day, and this is our moment to make sure New York's 4th District keeps moving forward. **[Find your voting location.](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-muhtyly-dytjdljkkt-y/)** [WHERE TO VOTE ->](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-muhtyly-dytjdljkkt-j/) In Congress, I've taken real action to protect our community, secure our borders, and stand up for our values. **Here 's what we've achieved together:** **Leading the Charge to Hold Mayorkas Accountable** I led the charge on the impeachment of DHS Secretary Alejandro**** Mayorkas**,** demanding accountability for his failures to secure our borders and protect Americans. This administration has ignored the crisis at our southern border, and I'm committed to ensuring our nation's security is never compromised. **Standing Up for Taxpayers** I've been a vocal advocate for removing the cap on the SALT deduction**,** fighting to relieve the unfair tax burden placed on Long Islanders. Repealing the SALT cap is essential to making life more affordable for our community, and I'll keep pushing for relief. **Protecting Women 's Sports**I believe in fair competition and ensuring that women and girls have a level playing field. That's why I've stood firmly against policies that allow biological males to compete in women's sports, defending the rights of female athletes against radical agendas that threaten fair competition. **Strengthening Public Safety** With the Safer Prisons Act of 2024, I've introduced meaningful reform to prevent crime and protect Long Island families. From fighting organized retail crime to supporting our law enforcement, I've made sure our community has the resources it needs to stay safe. **Enhancing Emergency Preparedness** As Chair of the Subcommittee on Emergency Management and Technology, I've focused on strengthening our emergency response systems, so that our first responders are better equipped to handle any crisis swiftly and effectively. **Investing in Infrastructure** Through my work on the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure, I've secured funding for vital local projects--from improved roads to expanded public transit--directly benefiting our community's quality of life. **Unfortunately, my opponent has chosen to align with radical, anti-Israel donors like George Soros and supports failed policies like cashless bail.** Her priorities lie with far-left interests, not with the safety and welfare of New York's 4th District. We can't afford to let her turn our district in the wrong direction.Here's how you can help tomorrow:**[1\. Vote Early and Bring a Friend:](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-muhtyly-dytjdljkkt-i/)** Head to the polls early and encourage friends, family, and neighbors to do the same. Every vote counts!**2\. Spread the Word:** Let everyone in your circle know why this election matters. A simple message or call can make a huge impact.**[3\. Volunteer on Election Day:](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-muhtyly-dytjdljkkt-d/)** We still need volunteers for the final push. Sign up here to help at polling stations or make calls in support of our campaign. [WHERE TO VOTE ->](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-muhtyly-dytjdljkkt-h/) [VOLUNTEER ->](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-muhtyly-dytjdljkkt-k/) Tomorrow, we're not just voting--we're choosing the future of New York's 4th District. Let's finish strong and make our voices heard for a safer, stronger community.**Thank you for your support every step of the way.** Anthony | | [Unsubscribe](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-u-muhtyly-dytjdljkkt-u/)

# [New York City’s first motorized taxis were electric vehicles.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smh85n&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smh85n&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smh85n&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| A t the turn of the 20th century, gas engines hadn’t become the standard yet; electric, gas, and steam-powered vehicles each held around one-third of the U.S. automobile market. Electric vehicles stood out from the pack because they didn’t produce unpleasant pollution (sound familiar?) and because they were much quieter than their gas or steam counterparts. The big disadvantage was that they didn’t have great range, something that drivers still worry about today.
---
One of the very first electric cars in America was the [Electrobat](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smh85n&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), a heavy, utilitarian carriage powered by an adapted ship’s motor and built specifically for rough city roads. It had to safely lug around a 1,600-pound lead-acid battery, but it was the ideal vehicle to make short trips throughout the city. It became the basis for the first cab company in New York City, the Electric Carriage and Wagon Company, founded in 1896. The founders also came up with a clever way of working around the battery problem: a battery-swapping station made from an old skating rink on Broadway.
The Electric Carriage and Wagon Company reported 1,000 trips in April 1897, its first month of service, and the electric cab system was a success in New York. But public opinion — and the service itself — soured once it tried to expand to other markets. The new facilities were poorly managed, with undertrained drivers and badly maintained batteries. The taxi company, later called the Electric Vehicle Company, shut down in 1907, and electric cabs didn’t return to the Big Apple until 2022.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smh85n&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smh85n&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## New York City regulates taxi colors.
Metered cabs used to be all sorts of colors, including in New York City. In the early 20th century, operators would paint their whole fleet a signature color to make their cabs stand out. One company, the Yellow Taxicab Company, even got litigious, filing around 50 lawsuits against other operators to stop them from using its signature color. There were red, brown, and black cabs, but yellow ultimately won out as the dominant cab color in New York City. NYC implemented a medallion system in 1937 — still in use today — that limits the number of taxicabs that can operate in the city. The system only restricts cars that can be hailed, though; cars that arrange rides in advance are called “livery cabs.” In 1968, the city implemented a law to help riders tell the difference between the two: Taxicabs had to be yellow, and all other cabs had to be a different color. The livery cab drivers weren’t happy, and even set some yellow cabs on fire for operating in Brooklyn, which, along with the other boroughs, was considered livery territory at the time. The law is [still in place](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smh85n&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) today.

clean_body: At the turn of the 20th century, gas engines hadn’t become the standard yet; electric, gas, and steam-powered vehicles each held around one-third of the U.S. automobile market. | A t the turn of the 20th century, gas engines hadn’t become the standard yet; electric, gas, and steam-powered vehicles each held around one-third of the U.S. automobile market. Electric vehicles stood out from the pack because they didn’t produce unpleasant pollution (sound familiar?) and because they were much quieter than their gas or steam counterparts. The big disadvantage was that they didn’t have great range, something that drivers still worry about today. One of the very first electric cars in America was the , a heavy, utilitarian carriage powered by an adapted ship’s motor and built specifically for rough city roads. It had to safely lug around a 1,600-pound lead-acid battery, but it was the ideal vehicle to make short trips throughout the city. It became the basis for the first cab company in New York City, the Electric Carriage and Wagon Company, founded in 1896. The founders also came up with a clever way of working around the battery problem: a battery-swapping station made from an old skating rink on Broadway. The Electric Carriage and Wagon Company reported 1,000 trips in April 1897, its first month of service, and the electric cab system was a success in New York. But public opinion — and the service itself — soured once it tried to expand to other markets. The new facilities were poorly managed, with undertrained drivers and badly maintained batteries. The taxi company, later called the Electric Vehicle Company, shut down in 1907, and electric cabs didn’t return to the Big Apple until 2022. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Licensed cabs in New York City as of September 2023 13,587 | | Licensed electric cabs in New York City as of April 2022 25 | Licensed electric cabs in New York City as of April 2022 25 | | Approximate number of Uber drivers, including couriers, in 2022 5 million | | Percentage of electric vehicles on United States roads 1% | Percentage of electric vehicles on United States roads 1% | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- New York City regulates taxi colors. Metered cabs used to be all sorts of colors, including in New York City. In the early 20th century, operators would paint their whole fleet a signature color to make their cabs stand out. One company, the Yellow Taxicab Company, even got litigious, filing around 50 lawsuits against other operators to stop them from using its signature color. There were red, brown, and black cabs, but yellow ultimately won out as the dominant cab color in New York City. NYC implemented a medallion system in 1937 — still in use today — that limits the number of taxicabs that can operate in the city. The system only restricts cars that can be hailed, though; cars that arrange rides in advance are called “livery cabs.” In 1968, the city implemented a law to help riders tell the difference between the two: Taxicabs had to be yellow, and all other cabs had to be a different color. The livery cab drivers weren’t happy, and even set some yellow cabs on fire for operating in Brooklyn, which, along with the other boroughs, was considered livery territory at the time. The law is today. body:
https://www.depasqualeforag.com/ [https://www.depasqualeforag.com/] The moment we’ve been waiting for has finally arrived: It’s Election Day!

If you haven’t yet cast your ballot, here’s some helpful information you should know about voting in Pennsylvania:

Polls are open from 7 AM until 8 PM tonight. If you are in line to vote before 8 PM, stay in line! Your polling place will remain open until every voter who arrived before 8 PM has cast their vote.

To find your local polling place, click HERE → [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/Pages/PollingPlaceInfo.aspx?emci=027d0b2d-8401-ef11-aaf0-7c1e5214dad0&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=10203249]

If you’re planning to vote via mail-in or absentee ballot, it MUST be returned to a designated drop box or ballot return location *before* 8 PM tonight. Click here to find a list of drop boxes and ballot return locations in your county → [https://www.pa.gov/en/agencies/vote/voter-support/mail-in-and-absentee-ballot/return-ballot.html]

Eugene DePasquale is counting on all of us to make our voices heard at the ballot box. After all, our next Attorney General will have the power to either defend or attack our most fundamental rights — and it’s critical that Pennsylvania makes the right choice today.

Thank you for all that you’ve done throughout this campaign. More to come soon.

Team Eugene

Friends,

Happy Election Day, Florida!

Polls are officially open across the state from 7 AM to 7 PM local time — you have 12 hours left to make your voice heard!

If you still need to cast your ballot, find your polling location here: https://makeaplantovote.com/

This is your chance to get out and vote! If you are in line by 7 pm local time, stay in line and you will be allowed to cast your ballot. If you come across any problems at your polling location, contact the voter protection hotline at (833) 868-3352.

If you already voted, offer a ride to your family and friends, knock on doors, make calls, and help get out the vote in these final crucial hours. We can do this.

We have put in the work for over a year, and today is when all our hard work pays off. This is about the future of our democracy and our freedoms.

We can't wait to celebrate this big win together.

Thanks for being on Team DMP!

Team DMP

name: Yesli Vega
subject: Turn Your Values Into Action
body:
| | | | | |
---|---
Dear Neighbor,

Today is a pivotal moment in our nation's history. As Virginians, we will decide who will represent us in the U.S. Senate and the U.S. House of Representatives, and decide on an [amendment to the Virginia Constitution](https://sdfzsjebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018gKONxhb6VX85EUwTGKfV84sxCJUYJAM5KIDPYe1b0mg05wsa0NB48QGy3kwwXoMb1omChXwpwHDo7vvRrkZbHkZybWB8cGEvESxrrslQRoaDHgwXDr8UBuyd95w0OwCTRvyVdGdXXmITaiRE61M5nxXj5SwmsLgWGy8_q5yqbQ0aU22VYwKs887vq-BpoSXrssU5YBGhFO-Oqooi2TcIozPE085TsDE&c=-Bqevk6lVYSBWHN5E2ENaVTsVDH1daHCiAgTTPAPqVBZxrm8sstsnw==&ch=JOz_7zytcCvekCSK4loZxWsqZWYtzJ98I9KO24wzRiH6majJQUNhBA==). As Americans, we will have the opportunity to show who we support to be our next President. Every vote cast, even if it isn't the deciding vote, will exist as a permanent statement of our generation's values and vision for the future.

If you've already voted--thank you. Now, let's keep our momentum going by committing to send a text to 7 of our friends or family members who love our country. Remind them to cast their ballot before the polls close at 7:00 PM.

If you haven't voted early, I humbly ask that you make time in the next few hours to go cast your ballot. Please utilize the opportunity you've been given to participate in shaping the future of the United States. You can find where to vote and information about your ballot by [entering your address on the Department of Elections website](https://sdfzsjebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018gKONxhb6VX85EUwTGKfV84sxCJUYJAM5KIDPYe1b0mg05wsa0NB48QGy3kwwXoMjrU9vk1jVMhsbjqCEXo1Kp01qqFP7XpTDvimqkl0yzAhrOziOPszlHuX6t14u4K-EOOvNf3fc8iULdDNGoJYwKdJtjcjXUC9ph2AKQn9Q4ZZ586F5jZ_dTxtXza-bQRmxmxUqD4ywPJbcBZs0aA3RBcXdAkb3Htl&c=-Bqevk6lVYSBWHN5E2ENaVTsVDH1daHCiAgTTPAPqVBZxrm8sstsnw==&ch=JOz_7zytcCvekCSK4loZxWsqZWYtzJ98I9KO24wzRiH6majJQUNhBA==).

Your participation is what makes our constitutional republic work. Casting your ballot is how we turn our values into action. This is our chance to make our voices heard. Thank you for playing your part in this critical moment in our nation's story.

For America,

Yesli Vega

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Friends, family, longtime supporters, and newer members of Team Kaine:
Happy Election Day!! I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything you’ve done for my re-election campaign this year — and for many of you, everything you’ve done for so many campaigns over the years.
I’ll never forget my very first race, for Richmond City Council back in 1994. I won by just 97 votes — a reminder that every single vote matters that has stayed with me my entire career. Whether we’re talking about a city council district, the Commonwealth, or the whole country, that holds true. Your vote is your voice – your sacred right as an American to have a say in this nation’s future — and if you haven’t yet, I hope you go use it today!
Polls are open in Virginia and many other states, so NOW is the time to go speak up and speak out. For your beliefs, for your values, for your loved ones, and for the America you want to see.
You can find poll locations and hours and any other voting details you need at IWillVote.com [IWillVote.com] .
I’m optimistic right now.
You’ve probably heard me say a phrase that my mom taught me: If you want to be right, be a pessimist; if you want to DO right, be an optimist.
Well I’m a lifelong optimist, and today, I believe I’ll have the opportunity to both do right and be right.
Here’s why:
I know Virginians. I love Virginians. And I know and love Americans. As a Commonwealth and a nation, we are not a tear-down, tear-apart people. We are a come-together, lift-up people.
Today, we have the chance to prove that to ourselves and to the rest of the world.
If you’re looking for one last way to make an impact, you can still volunteer [https://go.kamalaharris.com/] . Reach out to your friends and family, remind them to go vote, and give optimism a try — I think you’ll like it.
Talk soon,
Tim Kaine

## Bastrop County Fire Burns 400 Acres
A structure fire in Bastrop County sparked a 400-acre wildfire on Sunday, prompting authorities to [evacuate roughly 65 homes](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2uozAQxfGnMZ2RZ2y-Chfb0GXbLZHxjBNrHRyBgfD2V0l_6yP9dPT_d5tuLqa43P-6J9vyDnlChUYCSNVM5GK6JlORnRUNULGFTqseFCJWD8vQdIFdQw0Z0D60KgTF1OsQQk-kqmg_GIBqADVqXTOYttemgcHNPXaNMIoplrzW5cGF324L6coHr7XPzyrZRymvTeg_AkeB43me9f9j588ocHRriT6xwHHhcxM4puxdEjjObitrfkmf96Vc8uvKMyYKcWXJh_O7KzEvm9wX4vV0l8AR20Hi3AbjA0njwUszq1YOmgapGR0ADu3Mqlotvc6YUtzaThh1f7qYvnfLr_0Oiz8BAAD__3Y6cf0). The Hudson Fire, located eight miles east of Bastrop city limits, was [about 30% contained](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQhX8N3rDgwHEyMHTxlq4drbM5klMxRAbHyb-v3LXq-p7e06fv6zpekSOn2ycu5Oor5BEUWKm1VN3okeN7tI13k_IX3ZDTvVFnrQCgubvTNF1C6APa0JuANGkKxnhru7kD8NSwO860Vp0GA8a0pO3pbGynLzidoe-EVeS55rWtd6r0whLiOz9pbee8NNHda30UYT4EDAKGfd_b7xemoxQwJNqLgCHmGaOAYcJS1_yQc95Sff8J5M7RB15JzrgVTjdZ8kKSnjhvWDmnIsuWPB7LZnX-sXOMXE69sOq2IMdfpPqvo6eDnwAAAP__JvhsOw) by Monday morning. Local firefighters were assisted by state emergency response teams, including over 90 personnel and over 60 assets providing air and ground support. Officials said that containment lines constructed by bulldozers appear to have stopped the fire from spreading. Bastrop County has a [history of devastating wildfires](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGvpCAUhX8Ndhi4gPoKimns3rZbmitcnyQoBnCc-fcbp9nqtd_J-XJy_n5P3xhi2H_-4Ea2vpY0gQDNpeTCTB5DfE-68XYW_ks2ZGWvxCAFADSrNXpwjnAg7PxipHZkUKnBmA5QaGGaYG-ZlMJIUKBUS1J3g9JGfuE8QG-YFuRDTbmtK1V6YVniOz0pty5tTbRrrUdh6sFgZDBe19VuZb8zBiPt_Cw3JawrZQZjTUepKQe6sRaCo8vEZyw1p4O7dO71za8Q_RIy8SOn7aiF0xPdiTWkvfBrpUx8DR-N4yCk_F-Yz7yTZzBi5o-HrKfofZOtP64QYyhdz7T42TDEz_j665tPC_8CAAD__8wJePM). In October 2015, the Hidden Pines Fire destroyed over 4,500 acres and 60 homes, while the Bastrop Complex Fire in September 2011 consumed more than 32,000 acres and 1,600 homes.
## Cruz, Allred Make Final Appeal To Voters
While former President Donald Trump is expected to win Texas fairly easily, polls show the race between Sen. Ted Cruz and his Democratic challenger, Rep. Colin Allred, is closer. Cruz leads by 4% in an [aggregate of recent surveys](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2P8jAQhH-N3SXyrm1IChdv4463vTLyxwKWFoJsH4H79afQXznS6JlH83VaTqFwuV_-hxu5_jqvCyo0A8Cg7JJD4fdiZHZR5RkkOThqNYFCRHl1FjPO0aQIU8w6GZWMni0pSBZijLMsbocBKAuoUeuRwBwmbSzMIU54tMIoyqWvdexX6vQK7czv9Ul1TOtNsrv2_mhC_xPoBfpt28ZKgRNTqI-Vd--9KNDvqQn0je6hk0B_oTvVwAL9riDQf-gCfarfP8OzDYG5UpbV5cdWmEs7HIVRl1so_Bnvf77xdPgbAAD__7esYXg). body:
Together, we'll win this election and keep fighting for Pennsylvania
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4792%2E552475%2EtyKOqF)
Peter,
Today, Pennsylvanians are casting their ballots in what will be the most important election of our lifetimes -- and they have an important choice to make.
Every day that I've had the honor of representing our great Commonwealth, I've fought for the people of Pennsylvania -- our workers, children, seniors, and people with disabilities. I've worked to protect American jobs, to make our border more secure, and to lower costs for working families. I have fought to take on corporate greed, and no matter what, I've always put Pennsylvania first.
My record as Senator makes it clear whom I'm fighting for in Washington. But there's still more work to cut through the gridlock, stand up to powerful special interests, and make the lives of hardworking Pennsylvanians easier.
And in today's election, the stakes are far too high to sit on the sidelines.
Women's rights, workers' rights, and voting rights are on the line. We must win Pennsylvania to win the White House and preserve our Senate majority, and it's going to take all of us working together to do just that.
**To quote Bruce Springsteen's lyrics, "We take care of our own."**
That's what it means to be a Commonwealth. We take care of our children and our seniors. We take care of our veterans and people with disabilities. We take care of the men and women of organized labor -- the people I've fought for every day I've been an elected official.
When I cast my ballot today, I'll be thinking about those words: We take care of our own. And I hope that you'll do the same.
We're going to take care of each other, and together, we're going to win this election and keep fighting for Pennsylvania.
Let's fight to the finish, Peter.
With gratitude,
Bob Casey

But there's still more work to cut through the gridlock, stand up to powerful special interests, and make the lives of hardworking Pennsylvanians easier. And in today's election, the stakes are far too high to sit on the sidelines. Women's rights, workers' rights, and voting rights are on the line. We must win Pennsylvania to win the White House and preserve our Senate majority, and it's going to take all of us working together to do just that. To quote Bruce Springsteen's lyrics, "We take care of our own." That's what it means to be a Commonwealth. We take care of our children and our seniors. We take care of our veterans and people with disabilities. We take care of the men and women of organized labor -- the people I've fought for every day I've been an elected official. When I cast my ballot today, I'll be thinking about those words: We take care of our own. And I hope that you'll do the same. We're going to take care of each other, and together, we're going to win this election and keep fighting for Pennsylvania. Let's fight to the finish, Peter. With gratitude, Bob Casey P.S. If you haven't voted yet, I hope you will make a plan to vote today. Go to to find your polling place, and make a plan to vote before the polls close at 8pm.

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[‘Unprecedented’ mistake by Secretary Griswold calls for unprecedented ruling, Libertarian Party argues in District Court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
DENVER — Some daylight may have been breathed Monday afternoon into what some have called the largest coverup in the history of Colorado’s mail-in balloting era, and perhaps ever in its secretary of state’s office.
A day before Election Day, the top ranking officials in the Colorado Libertarian Party were in a Denver courtroom down the street from where Secretary of State Jena Griswold hours earlier made what sounded like a mea culpa over a password maintenance blunder that may affect half the counties in Colorado.
At issue is hundreds of passwords which were posted in a public place on the secretary of state’s website and discovered by an expert of voting system components, only after they may have been public for four months.
“I am regretful for this error,” Griswold wrote in a press release shortly before Judge Kandace Gerdes gaveled in a hearing in the Libertarian Party v. the State of Colorado. Several high-ranking Republicans in Colorado have called for her immediate resignation, one Griswold says she will not give.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️**

[**Ganahl: Exposing Colorado’s election failures, how citizen pressure uncovered what officials tried to hide**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 31** _During my run as the GOP Nominee for Governor in 2022, I talked to voters across Colorado that didn’t trust our elections. 25% of Republicans didn’t vote. After the race, I decided to dig in and see if I could find a way to restore trust for voters in the process._
[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[**Prop. KK is a 6.5% tax on gun owners, firearm retailers that with local tax is ‘more like 30%’**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 31** Proposition KK has turned Colorado’s gun stores like Jerry’s Outdoor Sports into the front line of a battle over 2nd Amendment rights. Tim Holt, owner of Jerry’s Outdoor Sports, is speaking out. He argues Proposition KK targets the wallets of responsible gun owners and threatens small businesses.
|
---
**[Griswold’s apology for election security breach draws comparisons to Tina Peters’ case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold issued an apology following a security breach that exposed BIOS passwords for election equipment in 34 counties, raising questions about her office's oversight.
* The incident drew comparisons to the case of former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters, who faced strict penalties from Griswold for a similar security breach, prompting criticism of inconsistent handling.
* In response to the breach, the Colorado GOP and other parties are demanding Griswold’s resignation, while an external investigation has been launched to assess the situation and prevent future lapses.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[University of Colorado regent race in 3rd District: A contest of visions, with Ray Scott taking center stage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The University of Colorado regent race in Colorado’s 3rd District is a choice between former State Sen. Ray Scott and former teacher Robert Logan, highlighting differing priorities for the university’s future.
* Ray Scott emphasizes fiscal responsibility, drawing from his legislative experience to advocate for budgetary oversight, construction project management, and support for rural educational programs.
* Robert Logan focuses on inclusive educational policies and expanding access, though Scott’s supporters argue his budget-focused approach is essential to maintaining financial stability and supporting CU’s growth amid economic challenges.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Three senior judges in Colorado still haven’t filed personal financial disclosures with state](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Three senior Colorado judges have failed to submit their required financial disclosures, despite multiple reminders from state officials, raising transparency and accountability concerns.
* The judicial financial disclosure requirement was strengthened after it was revealed in 2023 that many judges hadn’t complied; however, some senior judges remain non-compliant, potentially hiding conflicts of interest.
* The issue has prompted the Colorado Commission on Judicial Discipline to investigate, while Amendment H, on the November ballot, could increase transparency by changing judicial discipline processes.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[2024 Election comes down to the wire — which America will turn out on Tuesday?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The 2024 election is anticipated to be a close race between Donald Trump and Kamala Harris, with polls and early voting data suggesting varying outcomes across key battleground states.
* Analysts and pollsters highlight the unpredictability of polling accuracy, as past elections have shown significant polling errors; there are concerns that minority voter turnout may be down in early voting, which could impact Harris’s performance.
* Both candidates have clear paths to winning the electoral college, but the outcome will depend heavily on final voter turnout on Election Day, particularly in crucial states like Pennsylvania, Georgia, and Arizona.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Williams: In effort to Make America Healthy Again, let’s remove government regulations on raw milk](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY LACI WILLIAMS, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Do you remember when the stereotype of a “crunchy granola liberal” was an insult so partisan that no conservative dared even to step into a health food store?_
_Well, it doesn’t seem that long ago, but with the rise of the Make America Healthy Again movement — or MAHA, as it has been coined — this insult has not only dropped its partisan label, but the label itself has shifted into something positive, a cause that both the left and the right can support._
_The more I research the “crunchy” movement, the more Google searches and X stalking sessions I do, the more I see that a key issue for the MAHA crowd is consuming raw milk._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

While some messages uplift and inspire, many can lead us astray._

Jason Crow from 6th District during campaign has been noticed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY LINDY BROWNING | STATE | NOVEMBER 2** _Laurie Arnold, who lives in Colorado’s 6th U.S. House District, wonders why her current representative, Jason Crow, is spending his time, money and energy campaigning for Democrats in Georgia, North Carolina, Delaware and Pennsylvania, rather than the people in Colorado’s 6th District._
[**Dierenbach: Colorado Congressman Crow and the Afghanistan withdrawal**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY KARL DIERENBACH | STATE |****NOVEMBER 1** _Dutifully following the orders of superiors is a fundamental aspect of being a good soldier. name: OKGOP
subject: It’s finally here!
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=1)
---
Peter, that’s right, it’s finally Election Day! If you haven’t voted yet, here’s what you need to know:
1. You can verify your polling location [by looking it up online here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=KVdJ3K8uGr2-EEON3vpq7JrUAOTJcXIqIeMkaRQa_DKfivfTPuuMQMoqu_KdtkBV&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=2).
2. And you can look at your sample ballot. [You can see what your ballot will look like by entering your data here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=KVdJ3K8uGr2-EEON3vpq7JrUAOTJcXIqIeMkaRQa_DKfivfTPuuMQMoqu_KdtkBV&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=3).
3. You should print your research to bring with you OR save it to your phone. [You can find out info on the judges to print & bring with you here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaOEva1Jz4u7JgJ_UBwFRQd8&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=4). (**Remember: VOTE NO on all three liberal supreme court judges Edmondson, Gurich, & Kauger!**).
4. Bring someone WITH YOU to vote! Reach out to a coworker, family, friend, or anyone you can think of to bring them to vote with you!
5. Don’t forget to bring your ID. Photo ID works best, but your voter ID card will work as well. You don’t need both, one or the other will work.
6. Lines could be long as we’ve already seen record voter turnout, so you may want to bring along some bottled water & possibly a snack.

And you should check out this video from Governor Stitt on why to VOTE NO on the three liberal Supreme Court judges. Just click the image to watch. [](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=hN0FNeoNOFX4sKu0n6pYneCbWLOphrPk3f8rLC_mBeScTI_2nUHw8Wf7LP7RH6ONyVfb9q4HKjd5AL26VPrKOXlBK6CgttIXftne1JtWgFNdvOFhi_3N6swWyOipKY6f&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=5) If you have already voted through absentee or early voting: thank you! We need every Republican to get out & vote in this election. So you may be thinking your duty is done because you already cast your vote. But there is still something we need you to do TODAY: We need you to contact at least 5 family/friends/coworkers/church members/neighbors. You can send them a text, an email, message on social media, or call them. But make it a goal to reach out to 5 people this morning and **ENCOURAGE THEM TO GO VOTE!** Polls are open until 7:00pm. We must swamp the vote to overcome any margin of cheating! So even if you voted beforehand, there is still work to be done today. Please contact at least 5 people. **Tell them to VOTE NO on the liberal Supreme Court judges**. Send them the image below so they remember their names. Have them watch the video below of Chairman Nathan Dahm discussing these liberal judges. Explain the ease & benefits of voting straight party Republican. Share your knowledge with your sphere of influence & help us multiply your vote on Election Day! [](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=hN0FNeoNOFX4sKu0n6pYneCbWLOphrPk3f8rLC_mBeTaJna08zBhDt6R0tNz_chhhA6kSx21ftZSdVheyCvVbAfV0CdogKtXYI_ZowOTU2VB4gudnxUPiSjigoJD9mIv&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=6) Together we can have a HISTORIC Election Day. But we must not stop until the polls have closed & we can say we’ve done everything we could. That means reaching out to 5 other people right away. Encourage everyone you know to go VOTE! -Team OKGOP

This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/unsubscribe?e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=7).
You can also keep up with OKGOP on [Twitter](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JcrYNQ7dhdufXPgOgJxNGHSsRONv6mnq7ly6aBOUvGVprSj7jfHNOpP70kR_1QLA&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=8) or [Facebook](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=UQNagEd-DqbIXa37T8ODid9mG9NGbq3z9te4_riKc6EaGmrOrRzKc2wAaVTFbzRY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_it_s_finally_here&n=9).

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...

* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.

| | | | | Peter,

It’s officially Election Day and polls are NOW OPEN!

**You have the power to vote YES on Measure #4 and bring long-overdue relief and reform to our property tax system.**

With a simple vote, we can eliminate North Dakota’s property tax, ending the burden on property owners across our state and changing the way we fund local communities for the better.

Measure #4 replaces the current system of confusing mill levies and unfair valuations with a transparent, fair funding approach. By voting YES, you’re empowering local communities to have full control over their funding decisions—freeing them from reliance on property taxes.

The state will cover the property tax you currently pay, so you won’t have to worry about escalating costs year after year. Going forward, you’ll only contribute toward any locally determined increases for future needs.

North Dakota has the resources to make this much-needed move, and we can do it without raising taxes!

Let’s seize this chance to end the unfair property tax burden on families and businesses and ensure a fairer funding approach for generations to come.

Vote YES on Measure #4 and be part of the solution for our state.

LET’S WIN!

Exactly 617 days ago (!), I kicked off this Senate campaign with a listening tour across Michigan to hear what people throughout the state want from their leaders.
I also launched with a promise that no one would work harder than I would to win this race.
Since then, I have visited every corner of this state and most places in-between (several times) -- and I have done my best to listen.
But no one person could take on a race of this size and importance alone. It is one of the most competitive and expensive Senate campaigns in the history of the country, and it has taken a record number of donors and volunteers to put us in position to win.

## Russian Airplane Bomb Plot Foiled
Western spy agencies have accused [Russia of plotting](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00D2OrDAQBODTQNbIP3iAwMFLyOalG6LGbhivPG6EzSBuv2LzjT-pVFVfz-mJIYa0_sc32bLwpIRqQUoQZvIY4jW1tbcLkSJdk5WdFr2UnTb1ywozPJTvnXgM2pORsjNC94vvtBRI7VAHe6dJKYzUQomuoXme0XkxeNVro7qqFeRD4b355pDKi5Z48Yf2xvG7jvZVypYr_a9SY6XG8zybNLtEZ769UmPis1LjJ3ji2ykX2hPk7QJcKblAGdC5IxPsR84BgRfYIhcoDBlnLrgSONxXhi1iogwbF0olYIwXzHwkDwvvcEAGhwk9glLatKIXphv6erd-O0OMIT_uKesbQ_ytXv668mPVTwAAAP__S7p3dA) to send incendiary devices on planes bound for the U.S. and Canada to undermine, aiming to undermine support for Ukraine. Russia [allegedly sent two](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOnDAQhJ_GdIvsNfwchYuLftHdNSlSogUvd46MjWwDubePSJ9qihmN9H2_HuODnHfh9aSVTVniiBIbUApkO1py_jM2lTULM7Ku2KhOy5tSnW6rt1lIS5zoq-v6W2Oxm0n3iFLKWVvZk62cud6Ukq3SEmVX8zRNNFvZW7zpFjvRSLauxFT_ji6UNy_-Ew9O9RzXypt3KVsW-i5wEDic51mvOVydwIED7FngEPi84ozJW4FD2nN2BDTPe2YLcYHNx1JceEGJsHkKBfjP5mN2B2egKVKysGeY4h4skEvXhjMk3mIqAgdKcL-rsh_fT6GHODsr9PePSxmf-SenrUrGbqfz3uWvi-i1kvP_CMr_jB4G_wYAAP__HYF7GQ) devices using logistics company DHL, which were discovered and ignited at hubs in Germany and England, prompting a multinational investigation, according to a Wall Street Journal report. Investigators determined that the incendiary devices [disguised as electric massagers,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtuhDAURL_GdBf5wWsLFxtFdJsiKVIiY192b2RsZJtF-_cR6VNNMdLRzPm-TTdDnsL9w6yoyxInyWUDQgBvJ2fIv6amcnpBlKgq1KJXfBCiV2310FYuaugW08zdoNDMtrvgoIyV82KsbZqK9EkTgrdCccn7Gud5Ntbxi5ODamXPGo6OSkz1T6RQHrj4V3xiqm1cK68fpWyZqSuTI5PjcRz1msPZMTligD0zOQY8zjhi8o7JMe05k4G85w1tQQdxgc3HUijcoUTIGBxQsBgcmfQCh0-ymCEG2CHDHPfgYPMm4Ek1Ca5XUXY7fjI1RkuOqfe3Uxce-QvTViXttoO8p9ydb-6rIf-3vvxn86nlbwAAAP__UHt6Pw) sent from Lithuania to the U.K., were part of a broader Russian plot to transport explosives on planes to North America. One suspect has been arrested in Lithuania and four in Poland, while authorities believe at least two more suspects are still at large.
## Judge OK's Elon's $1M-a-Day Sweepstakes
A Pennsylvania judge ruled on Monday that [Elon Musk's $1 million-a-day voter sweepstakes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJzEkbGO6yAURL_G7ojgAgEXFK9Jl9duaWG4JGwwWMDG8t-vvP3WW45GOiOd-bjPdxtTzI__dkXTQ5mBgiCMESpnb2M6ZjF6ExAB-YiGKU41Y4rL8WmcdUEiOBn04lFLiwKnCWCaeFgmtGM0J40xKhmnQNUFl2WxztPJg-YS1CAo-thLvXyWmPsTQzrKG-vFlXVM5tn71gb-b4DbADe7ZdzbWZ2h9ugSDnBbv9qLrDGlWDJpO-LWun1hI6n0jvUgG-bcjvS2OVryqrZlrESEq-ZOaFyUd06qwDRHKTCwKyoOdAD-h-tjNX7bT2q7npIeq43pR0r_7aS3ge8AAAD__ySDlsw), organized by his political action committee, can continue through Tuesday's election. The ruling came after Musk’s lawyers argued that winners are preselected as paid spokespeople rather than chosen by chance, countering claims from Philadelphia District Attorney Larry Krasner that the sweepstakes is a "scam" designed to sway voters illegally. Musk's "America PAC" stated that recipients are vetted and must align with the group's values, with plans for final winners in Arizona and Michigan before the election concludes. [The PAC ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGvpSAQRn-NdmMYENGCYhu7t-2WZpTxXt5DMMLV-O83br_9l-_knD9f0xf54OPrN21sy5omKWQLiCD05MiHe2prZ1dmyapmi0aJHtEoXb_tPKMybacFtp0eGE3XDaLrBYmFTSd07e3zhig0KiGFaXieZ1qcGJzslZamagU7X9LRfCcfy5vXcKeTj2ZJWx3su5Q9V-pXJcdKjtd1NZGv7Atvz6CSI-2VHCMVnyKFSo4cUoTtk38gA8LmQ_ApAoGjG85U-IB8Me-50A9nWCjCfqSF2QHBzjHmO5wUPcH3x70YMt35oRzFL4Eng9zKeV1BS4Wge5phQJYwGINIS-9o5eZdtlAf1u3XQ8_d4_jayId_TuV_jU8r_wYAAP__a2V-Rw) has registered over 1 million participants.
## Music Icon Quincy Jones Dies at 91
Quincy Jones, the [legendary music producer and composer](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3O4yAURJ_G7rD4sUMoKLZxl223tC5wndwIQxZwLL_9ytt_3YxGGh2dP4_lARQpPX_DhrateZFcjkwIxqclAMVzGftgV0SJqkcrtOJ3IbSa-pfVt0mL1YDW4PwoFHpjHGg00nDlQPZkrzch-CQUl1wP6JwDH7gJ8q4mqbuRY6CWy_DOlNoL13jmL5bB562P9tXap3bqVyfnTs7HcQzJ-YRHvfZOzlfs5JwdtR0K4VX-7pT8yd45YWXbXslDZBtgbSUzTA1LA0obpsYohb22crJGDRILhJUZwYpPMMpRjX2x4XNQjFRvF-pzA4r_0dpPqr5W_gsAAP__z4JuDA) known for his work on Michael Jackson's _Thriller_ and collaborations with icons like Frank Sinatra and Ray Charles, has died at 91. Jones earned 28 Grammys, produced Hollywood projects like _The Color Purple_ and _The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air,_ and founded his own record label. Listen to his [10 most famous songs here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFvwyAUBOBfA1ss3sMEPDB08ZauHS0wD5sKm8hGQemvr9y920knfaf7ekwPl3Lal0-3ka2xTCiwvwHchJqCS_k99TzYSIQkOVnQUhgALRVfrZZGYHTByLtQfoCoyXswRukYQFHkyV4agFAgBQrdkffezUEMAY1UqFkvKKRaju67pL2uFPO7vOjo5rLxbNdanyeTHwxHhmNrrfN-vjqG407tZDi6o6Y50xXnfvmRTZqwD4UfNjxbyjmd92tl2VzKf2r97-XL4m8AAAD__0LNU2Q). In later years, Jones published his memoir, _Q: The Autobiography of Quincy Jones_ , in 2001, and was the subject of a Netflix documentary in 2018 directed by his daughter, actor Rashida Jones. Take a [look at his life in photos](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1zgzAMhn-N2cxZsl3I4KELW7p25GwsgnIOTsENx7_v0a-7Dp2l55He9_Xcnz0nni8v_kaujLlHhUYCSGX76DntvamiG4mQdEUOGq1agEbbanKEzSmCMtHEwbSgdDPoaC2gJgjB2ordYQNQFrRC1dQUQvBDVKeIrbbYCKMocslLfc08l4nGtOcHLfWQb1VyUyn3VehngZ3Abtu2OnBKIfslHhsCu_uUS14Fdm_vPA-7vOaZVpl4JMmz_JrKi0-Jll0CatvCyRgU2Bm5-HXi6L8ZP0f5R_JD_Z6UYE0rsKsWF-8bp8Tr05HgcvOcPj8u_zX4cPgRAAD__5_5c0w).

Do you
think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College
works and its role in preserving free and representative
government?
YES
NO

For most
of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the
Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it
was considered essential to preserving free and representative
government.

But
today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an
attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This
movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because
of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with
a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply
don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including
the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because
of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission
on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of
Americans in all 50 states.

These
efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of
our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online
courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide
with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets
popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding
documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and
guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of
charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including
American civics) to thousands of American educators and
homeschoolers.

Your
answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will
help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to
liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this
is especially important in this critical time for America's
future.

So please
share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National
Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon
as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government
funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state
student grants or loans.

The
support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please
represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential
Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for
your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.

I wish I didn't have to write this piece. But I also believe we need to tell our stories, because silence never conquered injustice. My daughter turns 9 on Election Day. If Trump wins, I don't know if she'll make it to 10. Let me explain.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0b6f50bc-5f07-4592-bcf6-5474a70c3e5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

The joys of fatherhood.
Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..qbnzKUa_Fsip2qeszaYgnHqcWJlhW9_0WoVdkyXBig0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=151198854)
House Speaker Mike Johnson and Republican leadership have made clear that with a Trump win, they will fully repeal the Affordable Care Act (ACA). Since the ACA became law nearly 15 years ago, Republicans have tried 100 times--100 times--to repeal it. Fortunately, they have failed every time. And the best 'solution' they've offered since is "a concept of a plan" as Trump claimed. But with a potential Trump White House, GOP House, and GOP Senate, Republicans plan to tear down the ACA permanently.
Here's what that means for my daughter and our family. My daughter has an incurable disease that's fatal if not treated. We rely on the ACA to get her the critical care she needs. The ACA is far from perfect--in my view we need guaranteed universal healthcare as a human right--but the ACA is what we have right now. My wife worked miracles to get us ACA coverage. She then spent weeks on the phone with doctors, providers, and insurance companies to ensure our daughter got the critical life saving care she needs.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..qbnzKUa_Fsip2qeszaYgnHqcWJlhW9_0WoVdkyXBig0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=151198854)
Republicans instead want to strip away the ACA provision that bans insurance companies from denying people with pre-existing conditions--people like my daughter. They want to strip provisions that allow Medicare and Medicaid to negotiate life-saving drug prices--medications tens of millions of seniors need to live. They want to deregulate the healthcare industry (except, of course, when it comes to regulating women's bodies) to maximize profit, knowing full well--but not caring--that it will increase mortality rates. And that's where my daughter comes in. Without insurance, her medication costs $250,000 a year.
Yes, you read that right--$250,000 per year.
Republicans think it's fair to force Americans to spend $250,000 a year to ensure their child can live. This is the reality my wife and I would be forced to face if Trump wins and the ACA is repealed. I don't care what party you belong to--forcing a family into financial ruin to prevent their child from dying is not moral, just, or what freedom means--it is cruel and sociopathic.
So my ask of each of you is this: Vote. Please vote.
Vote for my daughter. Vote for the tens of millions who will be devastated under Trump fascism. Vote for the chance to move forward on economic justice domestically and human rights globally.
I have been as critical as anyone of Biden for funding genocide in Gaza, and I will continue to remain so. I _also_ recognize that Trump's fascism is a one-way street to devastation for every marginalized community. For every child. For every senior citizen. For every immigrant. For every woman in need of reproductive healthcare. Vote in historic numbers, and vote Trump out. Put an end to his political career. Leave him in the dust bin of history.
And then the real work begins.
Once we win on 11/5, we continue to work like hell to demand an end to genocide in Gaza, demand economic justice at home, demand abortion access for women, demand housing as a human right for all people, demand a living wage for working Americans, demand a humane immigration policy, demand long-term climate justice, and demand human dignity for _every_ person in this country--all things that will be impossible under Trump.
The bottom line is this. We cannot give up hope, and we cannot succumb to hopelessness. My daughter deserves better than that. Your children deserve better than that. Instead, we _can_ build that more perfect union we all deserve--but we must take action. And that starts with voting in historic numbers on 11/5.
Let's vote. Let's win. Let justice reign. Are you in?
**Note:** If you are unsure of where to vote, visit [iwillvote.com](https://substack.com/redirect/fc6ae9e4-a5c5-4bbb-acbf-c9646db4262c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and find your nearby polling location. Polls are generally open until 7pm local time.

There’s a lot happening right now, so we’ll keep it short. Here are 3 things you need to know to make a difference on this crucial Election Day:
1. **Polls across the country are beginning to open as you read this!** If you haven’t voted yet, now is the time. Head to your polling place and cast your vote. Remember, every single vote adds up, and yours could be the one that turns the tide. | Hi Peter, it’s Susan. Today is Election Day!!

body:
It's election day - get out there and vote.

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_week_gotv_2&n=1)
---
Tuesday, November 05, 2024 | Peter -- Today's the day—get out there and vote! We know that everyone is tired from a _long_ election season, but we can't rest yet. It's time to cap off a year of hard work supporting great candidates with the most meaningful step—heading to the polls and casting your ballot. And there's a lot on the ballot this year:
* Forward has more than 125 candidates on ballots across the country.
* There are over a dozen statewide and municipal pro-reform ballot initiatives this year to support.
* There are 2 statewide anti-reform ballot initiatives this year to defeat.

The reasons to get out and vote are nearly _endless_. If you've already voted by mail or early in person, congrats! But the job is only partly finished: Make sure your friends, family, and networks have voted--or will vote--as well! If you're voting in person this year, make sure to [check your polling place](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-khVkZUq2vgEvUcdDfrQQf_fP9AlV0BPU03xsmxadqqHm&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_week_gotv_2&n=2) and hours before you go! Be sure to take a picture of yourself voting* and tag us, along with adding #2024ward. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-khVkZUq2vgEvUcdDfrQQf_fP9AlV0BPU03xsmxadqqHm&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_week_gotv_2&n=3 "Find Your Polling Place") [Find Your Polling Place](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-khVkZUq2vgEvUcdDfrQQf_fP9AlV0BPU03xsmxadqqHm&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_week_gotv_2&n=3)
---
We'll be up late with you watching the results roll in. Together, we've all done such incredible work this year. You should be proud—beyond proud—of what we've all built together.
Here's to you, and here's to what comes next!
With Thanks,
The Forward Party

body:
Be a part of HISTORY in Making America Great Again | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/315becc9aefb/n41kepo7ku-12715770?e=25844e23a8)

#### Good Morning Republicans,

**Philippians 4:8** _And now, dear brothers and sisters, one final thing. Fix your thoughts on what is true, and honorable, and right, and pure and lovely, and admirable. Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise._

Throughout today I encourage you to spend as many moments of your day in prayer.
Give thanks.
Praise His name.
Seek guidance.
Ask for comfort.
Above all, glorify that His will be done.
* * *
I would be remiss if I didn't extend my gratitude to the amount of volunteers, candidates, and the many leaders across Nebraska who have worked tirelessly to be a part of History. To be a part of changing Nebraska's political culture.

The county growth has been phenomenal during a challenging time of defining our party between personalities and values.

The Republican candidate's courage and fortitude this year is really beyond compare for all races local to President! (Fight, Fight, Fight)

Lastly, we've seen an ability in the latter stages of this election of coalescing for a **mutual purpose** versus a contrived and forced unity. There has been more respecting of the role we all play in being a Team and less on who gets the credit or blame or comparison of efforts.

Truly and genuinely...thank you Republicans for the sacrifice of time, talent, and treasures.

As I write Coffee w/ the Chairman #40, I reflect back to the first newsletters and the messaging THEN, remains just as important today...

**_Coffee w/ the Chairman #1_**
**Go** to County Party meetings
**Go** to School Board meetings
**Go** to City Council meetings
**Speak **with confidence and knowledge, passion and articulation at county party, school board, and city council meetings.
**Speak** with others at your church or community organizations.
**Become** a county delegate in 2024 ****The NEGOP can show you how** **
**Become** an elected member of your County Party ****The NEGOP can show you how****
**Become** an elected member of the State Party ****The NEGOP can show you how**
Become** a candidate for your local school board and _really_ have an impact on your community ****The NEGOP can show you how****
**Become** a candidate for your city council, village board, NRD, ESU, county boards, community college boards, or energy boards. ****The NEGOP can show you how****

**_Coffee w/ the Chairman #2_**
In 2024 we will focus significant energy on voter registration & engagement goals:
* _Expand our Volunteer Base:_ There is no better way to have a voice in politics than by volunteering. The NEGOP is organizing engagement events state-wide and at the county level to present opportunities for volunteer recruitment and voter registration. We will be offering training programs from the RNC & internal design to ensure a well-structured operation.
* _Recruit and Develop Candidates:_ _**YOU WANT CHANGE?**_ Then, **_BE_** the change. Become a candidate for a local level of governance like _YOUR_ local school board! There are 244 local school boards districts & 19 Educational Service Units (ESU’s) and in 2024 there will be elections for about 3 candidates in each district. In collaboration with our county parties, state district caucuses, and national partners, our primary focus is to identify and recruit exceptional **Constitutional & Platform Republican (CPR’s)** candidates. Interviewed and prepared CPR’s will revive the party specifically targeting the local level such as _School Boards, ESU’s, Community College Boards, City Councils, NRD’s, Power Boards, and County Department_ positions.

**_Coffee w/ the Chairman #4_** _NEGOP Constitution
ARTICLE I _ _**Name and Objectives** _ _**Section 1.** The name of this organization shall be the Republican Party of Nebraska. _ _**Section 2.** The objectives of the Party shall be the **maintenance of government** _of, by and for the people_ according to the Constitution and laws of the United States and the State of Nebraska, AND **the furtherance of such principles** as may from time to time be adopted. _ _ARTICLE II _ **_Membership _** _Section 1. The membership of the Party shall be composed of all the registered Republican voters of the State of Nebraska**who desire to support the _objectives_ of the Party.**_ The biggest question of all is...who will be willing to work, and work tirelessly, to stand on this bridge of values/principles, this bridge of truth, and at the same time find ways to reach out to others? The work to do this can only come from constant, proactive, measured communication with a desire to have success for all and credit by none. We cannot serve others and at the same time be monument builders or seekers of a legacy. We cannot follow a path that is laid before us if we seek the treasures of this world. We can only believe that through our gifts and talents His will can and will be done. So now on this 40th Coffee email, I summarize what has been the motto that has created change and brought forth stability within our organization.

**#1 Show Up
#2 Know the Rules
#3 Achieve an Objective**

My prayer for today is not about winning an election, it's about the salvation of a country. I truly pray that we have an even greater opportunity to further our principles after November 5th because of new leadership. I pray that this country can be made anew with hope and enthusiasm for all it's potential. I pray for what my Pastor called "Dynamic disagreements" because as a party, we will grow so much more and develop even greater stability when we learn to "discourse with respect". When we move beyond right and wrong and onto good and fruitful, when we assemble the multitudes...Nebraska could be magnificent.

Today's election is going to be _**HISTORICAL**_.

I also pray for safety to all people. We must be hyper aware this week and measured in our speech. We must be beyond reproach and emulate grace, truth, and be the light for all to see. After today, our path is not any easier, but it will have greater clarity of what is before us.

No matter the outcomes today, we will have work to do tomorrow.
We will have preparations and planning to accomplish.
We still have to Make America Great Again.

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---

| –Chairman Underwood

| | | My fellow Americans:

I'm writing to you with a heart full of hope, pride, and worry. _And I 'd like to take a moment on this historic day to explain why:_

The Election Day polls are OPEN and Americans are lining up to decide our future. I have hope the American People will choose to reject the extreme Liberal policies of Kamala Harris and the Radical Democrats. I have overwhelming pride in the work Republicans up and down the ballot have put in to WIN today.

**But I 'm filled with worry...**
* _Did we do enough to spread our winning message?_

* _What will our country do if Kamala Harris, God forbid, wins this election?_

As one of my top supporters, it's important you know what I'm thinking. It's also important we do every single thing in our power to WIN. So here's my ask:

**Our Election Day voter contact operations are critically underfunded. We've unloaded everything in our pockets within the last week and desperately need top Patriots (like YOU!) to help replenish our budgets before polls close tonight.**

I want you to remember that today isn't just about victory and defeat. It's about the future of our country. It's about preserving the values we hold dear and ensuring that America remains a beacon of freedom and prosperity.

_**[So, I'm asking you to dig deep and give what you can. name: Service Member Support via USO
subject: Thoughts on this Election Day
body:
The USO will always be here
[](https://www.uso.org)
[DONATE NOW](https://links.e.uso.)
---
USO Supporter,
As Election Day unfolds and attention turns to new leadership across the nation, one thing remains steadfast: the unwavering dedication of our service members.
No matter who is elected or what changes may come, our heroes in uniform will continue to serve with commitment and courage -- whether they are stationed stateside or deployed far from their loved ones. At the USO, our job is to make sure these service members aren't forgotten, no matter who is in office or what is happening in the world.
Your support can provide everything from care packages to video call connections between parents and their kids at over 250 USO Centers worldwide -- places of comfort and connection for our military members wherever they serve.
**The USO is a nonprofit, non-government organization that relies on donations from strong military supporters like you.**
[DONATE NOW TO SUPPORT OUR HEROES](https://links.e.uso.)
---
**[Today, will you take a moment to make a difference for those who are serving? By donating $29 or more, you'll help us reach our $20,000 goal by midnight and make sure our service members know we haven't forgotten them. ](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/dp4vCP~)**
Thank you for your consistent support through every change.
--The USO

name: Christina (personal)
subject: Can I count on you one more time before the polls close?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Christina Bohannan for Congress
body:
One last donation could be the key to victory today.

|

Peter,

It’s Christina, and today is the day we’ve all been waiting for – it’s Election Day! After all our hard work and dedication, we’re finally here – but we’re not done yet.

body:

Peter, Today is Election Day, and I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to everyone who has supported this campaign. To all our donors, volunteers, and organizers on the ground—thank you. And to the Democratic parties of Cuyahoga, Medina, Wayne, and Holmes Counties (and cities in the counties), I deeply appreciate your endorsements and steadfast support. Special thanks to the organizations who championed our campaign, including Moms Demand Action, the League of Women Voters, Democrats Empower Medina, Medina Mavens, Indivisible Strongsville, and so many others. If I missed you here, know that your support has been invaluable. And to the labor unions standing by us as we fight for workers' rights—thank you. To our incredible campaign team: Nicole, our Operations Director, who dedicated herself over two cycles; the folks at 1833, our advisors and friends; Sonya, our financial director; and Statecraft, our digital team—thank you for your unwavering dedication. And to everyone who supported us in countless ways—from hosting fundraisers and knocking on doors to writing policy and setting up signs—thank you. Each of you has been essential to this movement, and I am truly grateful. Important issues are on and off the ballot this election, and whatever today’s results bring, I know we’ve laid a strong foundation for positive change in Ohio. I’m proud of the growth in grassroots organization across Northeast Ohio, which shows the strength and resilience of voters who want what’s best for our families, economy, futures, children, and seniors. Friends, this is it.
Today’s the day where we decide the future direction of our country and our community here in Suffolk County.
The stakes could not be higher. I believe it’s a choice between hope and hate, unity and division, common ground and chaos. It is the power of love versus the love of power.
The eyes of history are on us. And we will be judged by the decision we make. We need to earn this victory.
The enthusiasm and momentum are with us. But we need your help. When we work, we win. And we all know that America works best when we work together.
Together, we can restore the state local tax deduction that Trump and the Republicans took away. We can defend reproductive freedom. We finally pass the bipartisan border security bill. And we can build that broad patriotic coalition to defend American democracy and strengthen it for the 21st century.
All these things are possible if we win today. A Democratic House is essential to defending the American democracy we live in - and as Hakeem Jeffries said on Saturday night – this is a majority maker district.
The responsibility - and opportunity - is with us.
So this election, vote like our future depends - because it does.
Vote like freedom depends on it - because it does
Vote like equality depends on it - because it does.
And vote like our democracy depends on it - because it does.
Thank you for fighting the good fight with me. I couldn’t be more grateful for your support or more proud of what we’ve been able to accomplish together. The greatest days are still ahead of us. Let’s win!
-John

body:
Let’s get out the vote and flip this seat today.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
**Before I remind you about where I come from and why I’m running for this Senate seat, I’ll get straight to it:[Will you rush a $10 donation to my campaign right now so we can turn out every single voter before polls close at 7PM tonight?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83790?refcode=em20241105-8642&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8642%2E614464%2Exd9VxE)**
**[rush a donation](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83790?refcode=em20241105-8642&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8642%2E614464%2Exd9VxE)**
I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in Jeff City. Like so many Americans, my parents lived paycheck-to-paycheck — so when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, we struggled to get by.
**But we weren’t alone.**
When my parents had to take my sister to get surgeries at a hospital over 100 miles away in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes.
And when we couldn’t afford groceries, they brought more casserole and lasagna by the house than we could ever hope to eat.
**That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83790?refcode=em20241105-8642&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8642%2E614464%2Exd9VxE)
The support from our neighbors and friends motivated me to work hard, stay focused on school, and run on the cross-country team. After graduating from Jefferson City High School, I was able to get into Yale — which I could afford in part due to a Pell grant and scholarships from people around town.
I got to keep running at Yale, too.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83790?refcode=em20241105-8642&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8642%2E614464%2Exd9VxE)
**After undergrad and then law school at Mizzou, I joined the Marine Corps to honor and serve the community that had done so much for me.**
Less than a year after I completed training, I deployed to Iraq on my first of three tours of duty in the War on Terror, before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
During those 13 years of active duty I learned firsthand what service and sacrifice for your country really means: Doing the right thing when you’re thousands of miles from home, believing in a mission that’s bigger than yourself, and never forgetting the community you signed up to serve.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83790?refcode=em20241105-8642&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=8642%2E614464%2Exd9VxE)
In Iraq, I deployed to the Sunni Triangle where I led a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman, running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi. From our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83790?refcode=em20241105-8642&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=8642%2E614464%2Exd9VxE)
When I got back from living next to that burn pit, I had developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic.
They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
**So imagine how we all felt when politicians who had never worn the uniform, like Josh Hawley, threw us a giant middle finger and voted against aid for exposed veterans.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83790?refcode=em20241105-8642&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=8642%2E614464%2Exd9VxE)
My final tour was on the Joint Staff at the Pentagon. There, I worked with the National Security Council, State Department, Department of Homeland Security, FBI, CIA, and other agencies to stop the proliferation of nuclear, chemical, and missile technology around the globe, to keep these weapons out of the hands of bad actors.
I spent every day doing what I could to make the world a safer place, with fewer arms, less chance of conflict, and more money to spend on improving lives rather than destroying them.
One of the hardest things for me between these tours was coming back home to Jeff City, to the community I had signed up to serve, and seeing what was going on in my old neighborhood.
When I came back from Iraq, the first house I’d ever lived in was bulldozed down. **Now, it’s an empty lot:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83790?refcode=em20241105-8642&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=8642%2E614464%2Exd9VxE)
When I came back from Afghanistan, the house I lived in when I joined the Marine Corps was vacant and starting to fall apart. The corner store was boarded up.
The whole time all of us were risking our lives overseas, our leaders were spending trillions of dollars trying to build up towns in these other countries — places like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat — when we should have been spending our money, blood, and sweat on towns like St. Joe, St. Louis, and Jefferson City.
From the Middle East to the Pentagon, my time in the Marine Corps provided me with direct insight into the control that giant corporations have over our tax dollars, our politics, and our everyday lives.
So after active duty, I joined the American Economic Liberties Project — the nation’s leading non-profit in the fight against monopoly power in our economy and our democracy. We took on the corrupt politicians and monopolists who dominate our lives, squeeze small businesses out of our markets, and enrich corporate elites at the expense of everyday Americans — from Big Tech and agribusiness conglomerates, to pharmaceutical cartels and defense contractors.
But now corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley don’t just attack our way of life, but the democracy I swore to defend.
Everyday people should be calling the shots in our country — not giant corporations or the cowards and phonies they bought off in Washington. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate: To take power back for working families in Missouri and across America.
**And make no mistake about it, Missouri is on the frontline of this fight.**
While our state has been getting stripped for parts, politicians like Josh Hawley have been attacking workers with schemes like “Right-to-Work” and fighting to block wage increases for Missouri families — all to enrich multinational corporations and mega-donors who bankroll their campaigns.
As dozens of headquarters have been taken out of state, politicians in power like Josh Hawley were happy to sit back and watch it happen.
Manufacturing, agriculture, production — they’re shipping it all away to foreign oligarchs who don’t care about working people in our state. And while Missouri was getting gutted, these same politicians voted time and time again to spend trillions of dollars and thousands of lives on overseas wars that got their Big Oil friends rich.
They’ve spent decades sparking phony culture wars to distract and divide our families. They’ve become so obsessed with controlling our lives, they made Missouri the first state in the nation to ban abortion — without exceptions for victims of rape or incest.
**Our state deserves a Senator who will stand up and fight for it, not run for the exit like Josh Hawley.**
I’m running for U.S. Senate to be the warrior for working people that Missouri deserves — to fight like hell for our state and our people.
We’ve spent months uniting Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind our campaign — with early endorsements from the Missouri AFL-CIO, Missouri Fire Fighters, and dozens more statewide and union locals. And multiple recent polls have shown we’re in a STATISTICAL TIE with Josh Hawley, who _Morning Consult_ has consistently found to be the most vulnerable GOP Senator running in 2024.

Team,

**Polls are open in Wisconsin – this is the day.**

I have been so honored to have your support, and I am so incredibly energized by the incredible momentum I have seen across the district, the state, and the country throughout this campaign.

Now it’s time for us to take this campaign home over the finish line. **So if you haven’t already, get out and cast your ballot – and then make sure your friends, family, and neighbors do the same.**

We’ll be spending the whole day working to ensure we talk with voters all over the district, and I have to say, _I’m fired up._

Over and over as I’ve talked with people here in northeast Wisconsin, I hear the same thing. People are worried about attacks on our rights, worried about politicians who aren’t putting our families first, and worried about rising costs that make it harder to raise a family here. I’m worried too. That’s why I decided to run.

**But I’ve also heard over and over again that people are excited about this campaign. We’re ready to make our voices heard today and say _enough_ of the extremism, the divisiveness, the hatred – and to chart a new path forward.**

[_**So with that in mind, I’m asking one last time for your support.
