name: Team Gallego
subject: What comes next — and why we still need to fundraise.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Here in Arizona, the polls close at 7pm locally, 9pm on the east coast. We’ll lead with this — it’s our best guess that we won’t know who is going to win Arizona’s U.S. Senate race tonight.
#

Peter — today is the day.
Throughout the day, millions of people are going to cast their votes. Later tonight, the polls will close. And as the night goes on, we’ll begin to get a better understanding of how they voted.
Here in Arizona, the polls close at 7pm locally, 9pm on the east coast. We’ll lead with this — it’s our best guess that we won’t know who is going to win Arizona’s U.S. Senate race tonight.
We do know is this: **It’s going to be close.** We’ll be running through the finish line, and we’re spending through all of our resources until the last minute — we’re going to work to reach every last voter we possibly can.
We also know this: **Kari Lake has never given us any reason to believe she will respect the results of this election.**
She continues to dispute Trump’s defeat in 2020, and her own defeat in 2022. She continues to be engaged in litigation from that defeat. She has spread more lies and disinformation around our elections than any candidate in the country besides Donald Trump himself.
So, we still have to fundraise. We have to fundraise to close the gap to our $1.5 million Election Day goal — to be honest with you, we’ve spent into the red over the last few days after Kari Lake’s last minute surge in the polls, and we still have a ways to go to cover what it took to get us to this point.
But we also have to fundraise for tomorrow, and the days after that. We have to go into overtime in Arizona to ensure the votes are counted and that we are prepared for whatever Kari Lake throws at us.
That’s why we’re writing to you this morning. And it’s why we’re humbly asking:
[**Please, chip in to Ruben Gallego’s campaign as we bring this home tonight, and as we ready ourselves to uphold the integrity of this election tomorrow.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241105-1-160&t=1&akid=3535%2E734936%2EHL0HD8)

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
I’ve been writing to you about this day for nearly two years, and it is finally here. Today is the day we have been working toward, and I am full of hope and pride this morning.
We’ve done so much work to get to this day. And, while we’ve been here before, we know a lot can happen between now and when the polls close. If you or someone you know hasn’t voted yet—get out and vote today! Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. in Harris and Fort Bend counties; for information on where to go you can use: https://vote.lizziefletcher.com [https://vote.lizziefletcher.com] . ** Early Voting Recap
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.dominicforct.us

It is straightforward. Republicans are embracing early voting and mail-in voting.

While it may not align with our core values, we also want to win, and that means we need to engage in the process. We have an important day; ahead, get out there, and make it happen. Let’s show our support for our legislative candidates, our federal candidates, and for Donald J. Trump. God bless you, and Godspeed! and secure a victory.

In Liberty,

Dominic Rapini

The Real Referendum is On Election Integrity

Vote NO to MASS MAIL-IN VOTING

Absentee voting is an important privilege for those unable to vote in person due to illness, travel, military service, or religious obligations.

However, expanding mail-in voting to everyone poses unnecessary risks to election integrity. In-person voting remains the safest, most secure way to ensure every vote is counted. Connecticut already provides a generous voting system, including 14 days of early in-person voting, making additional expansion of mail-in voting unnecessary.

It's imperative that you vote no on any referendum to expand mail-in voting in Connecticut. Read my full op-ed in the CT Mirror, and please share this vital message with every voter you know. READ OPED (https://ctmirror.org/2024/10/11/vote-down-cts-no-excuse-ballot-referendum/)

Important Observations

• Voting By Mail is the least secure way to vote

• Absentee Ballots are prone to rejection

because of human error

• Mail-in votes can be lost

• Democrats constantly abuse the Absentee Ballot Process

- over 20 cases on record with the SEEC

Voter Fraud in Connecticut overwhelming involves;

√ Absentee Ballot abuse (example, Bridgeport)

√ Political candidates and operatives (example: Wanda - allegedly)

√ Voter Fraud by mail is only caught through whistle-blowers or video evidence. (Did I mention Bridgeport yet?)

https://www.dominicforct.us

I am writing to oppose the November referendum proposing a “No Excuse Absentee Ballot” system. I strongly urge you to join me in voting against HRJ 1, as it poses severe risks to fairness and election integrity. - Dominic Rapini

Dear friend, Think, today, about the promise of America. We’ve never been a country that gets it all right, yet we’ve always believed that we might. That’s what America is all about, and it is leaders who are striving to take us forward, who believe in our ideals, who can help us get there. That’s why I’m so proud to support fellow Democrats who are working to move our country forward in the face of an opposition party that’s all about turning back the clock. And look how far we’ve come in just a few months with Harris at the top of our ticket! We’re united, motivated, and ready to go. Just a few weeks ago, the critics said this wasn’t possible. They said Democrats would be in total disarray. Instead, we’re witnessing what could be one of the greatest political comebacks in generations. And we couldn’t have come this far without the efforts of thousands of volunteers working tirelessly to get out the vote for Democrats across the country. My organization, Serve America, has endorsed an extraordinary team of servant leaders who will bring patriotism and political courage to Congress. With these candidates, we have the opportunity to flip the House with a new generation of leaders. Many were on the front lines of the Blue Wave that flipped the House in 2018, and they’re ready to help do it again. This is our future, not MAGA extremism. The contrast couldn't be starker in this election. Democrats are fighting to bring America together and take us forward. Trump and Vance want to take us backwards and tear us apart. It’s finally time to relegate the era of Trump to the history books. Democrats believe in the promise of America – a future where everyone has the chance to get ahead, and where America is a force for good in the world. Donald Trump will only bring chaos and grievance to the White House. We are not going back. This isn’t over yet. Thank you for your support and let’s finish the job of electing Kamala Harris as our next president. Regards, Seth [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96608977/510577333/-333616605?refcode=241105&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjMyMzJjYy04MjliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=l-BwpllGKd1HY5PDFoGq0T-Tk7F5t6fCGQQmRui4cIk=)

By Illinois Review

Dear Readers,

Today’s the day. Your voice matters, and your vote is your voice. Even in a deep blue state like Illinois, every single vote can make a difference. That’s why we’re reaching out to encourage you to head to the polls today and cast your ballot.

Please take a moment to call your friends and family, remind them to vote, and ensure that no one’s voice goes unheard. Each vote strengthens our shared values and vision for Illinois’ future.

To the candidates, volunteers, grassroots activists, elected officials, local Republican leaders reading this, we wish you all the best of luck. Your hard work and dedication have led us to this day, and we appreciate everything you’ve done to represent our values.

Let’s make an impact today – get out there and vote!

– The Illinois Review Editorial Team

Michael Isikoff appears on Don Lemon Tonight. (CNN)
By Mark Vargas, Editor-in-Chief

The narrative that the Donald Trump campaign in 2016 was colluding with Russia will go down as one of the greatest political hoaxes in history – but the now discredited reporter behind it, who served as the FBI’s mouthpiece and deliberately pushed a fake story and whose actions cost taxpayers $35 million – is back at it again attacking senior Trump campaign officials – proving once again why Americans’ confidence in the media is at an all time low.

Former Yahoo News chief investigative reporter and Daily Beast writer Michael Isikoff is using his new column at the Daily Beast to attack Trump co-campaign manager Chris LaCivita – a Marine Corps veteran who was wounded in the Gulf War and received a Purple Heart for his service to the nation. The discredited writer is also doing the bidding of the Democratic National Committee and publishing articles attacking the Trump campaign while giving oxygen to the narrative that Trump and his supporters are dangerous, unstable people who harass and intimidate anyone in their way.

Isikoff also believes that Trump is a threat to “democracy” – language that has contributed to not one but two assassination attempts on the former president’s life this past Summer.

Supporters cheer as former President Donald Trump arrives at the podium to speak during a campaign rally at the Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, November 1, 2024. (Kamil Krzaczynski/AFP/Getty Images)
By Illinois Review

Late Friday night, President Donald Trump addressed a jam-packed arena at Fiserv Forum – home to the Milwaukee Bucks, hours after a rally in Warren, Michigan as Democratic infighting divides the party just days before the election.

“I’ve come today with a message of hope for all Americans...I don’t want your money. I want your damn vote,” Trump told the energized crowd, who awaited his arrival by singing and dancing to music blasting on the loudspeakers. Former governors Scott Walker and Tommy Thompson; former presidential advisor Sebastian Gorka and Robert Kennedy, Jr. warmed up the crowd. Kennedy – who traveled with the president on Trump Force One, spoke just moments before the 45th President took the stage.

“When you go to the voting booth on Tuesday, you’re going to see my name on the ballot. I do not want your vote. I want you to vote for Donald Trump,” Kennedy told the crowd. In September, Kennedy sued to have his name removed from the presidential ballot in Wisconsin and other states after he dropped out of the presidential race, but certain state laws – including laws in Wisconsin indicate that if a candidate is qualified to be on the ballot – their names cannot be removed.

Today marks Election Day, and **if you haven’t already, it’s to run not walk to the polls.**

| | Peter,

This is it. Please make sure that you voted and encourage your friends and family to vote for Neil. Also, please join us in Hagerstown for our victory party, click [here](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=58ea4f2494&e=5a45ee1154) for details.

Late last night, Neil Parrott was working right alongside volunteers, putting together signs, mapping out routes to put signs at all 190 polling locations, and pushing yard signs into the ground until early morning. Today, Neil will be talking with voters, all day long, at the polls.

This is Neil Parrott. He is a thinker, he is a friend, and he gets things done!

No one could accuse Neil of being an elitist or a tourist in the district he is trying to represent.

Neil needs our help. In order to pay for the last commercials, the last get-out-the-vote calls and texts, and lunches for the poll workers, Neil's campaign needs over $15,000 right away. Please donate to help Neil with our Election Day expenses!

Friend, this is our last chance to make a difference. For those of you who already voted, thank you so much! If you have not yet voted, please take a look at the information below:
* The safest way to return your ballot is to drop it in one of the Ballot Drop Boxes located throughout Los Angeles County. To locate one near you, please visit: [**https://locator.lavote.gov/**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96611312/510584135/649298954?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzNmNWM5ZWYtODU5Yi1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gsRo6IF1ghPptyaARx-blXF7rrAZqDOmfsW5aYx4gq0=&emci=7fe95ee4-ea9a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=73f5c9ef-859b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=8447100).

* If you vote by mail, your ballot MUST be postmarked by or dropped off by 5pm at a US Post Office \- we don't recommend using a neighborhood blue mailbox in case the mail has already been collected for that day.

* If you didn't get your ballot, walk into any vote center in LA County and they will give you one. You do not have to live near a vote center to cast your ballot at that location.

* Voting centers are open today from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

* California has same-day registration in case your registration has lapsed.

* If you have any questions or require assistance, please call the Los Angeles County Registrar of Voters - (800) 815-2666.

The Voting Polls:
A Mom-Led Revolution

Today is the day, mamas! Text your friends, ask your neighbors: Have they voted? Conservative, patriotic moms are one of the
untapped political forces in our country. We've been called the "silent majority." The stakes are too high, and we are silent no

Each year, we honor our Veterans on November 11. This year, on the Moms for America Podcast we are speaking with two special
guests who have found unique ways to give back to our veterans. Sabin Howard is a master sculptor who won the Centennial
Commission’s competition to create a National World War I Memorial.

Pam Hallal is a Gold Star mom who lost her first child, Marine Deryk Hallal, in a gun battle in Iraq twenty years ago during the
Iraq War. Since that time Pam has stayed closely connected to Deryk’s Band of Brothers, and she’s now involved in a project to
save the lives of veterans struggling with PTSD. Like, Subscribe, and Share!

[] [] [] November 5th, 2024 • Newsletter [] [] [] [] The Voting Polls: A Mom-Led Revolution Today is the day, mamas! Text your friends, ask your neighbors: Have they voted? Conservative, patriotic moms are one of the untapped political forces in our country. We've been called the "silent majority." The stakes are too high, and we are silent no more! On the blog, we're sharing four practical ways that you can join the Mama Bear Revolution sweeping politics. Read the Blog [] 🇺🇸 Honoring Our Veterans 🇺🇸 Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] Each year, we honor our Veterans on November 11. This year, on the Moms for America Podcast we are speaking with two special guests who have found unique ways to give back to our veterans. Sabin Howard is a master sculptor who won the Centennial Commission’s competition to create a National World War I Memorial. Pam Hallal is a Gold Star mom who lost her first child, Marine Deryk Hallal, in a gun battle in Iraq twenty years ago during the Iraq War. Since that time Pam has stayed closely connected to Deryk’s Band of Brothers, and she’s now involved in a project to save the lives of veterans struggling with PTSD. Like, Subscribe, and Share! Peter,

Election Day is officially underway! The polls are open, and you have until 8:00 pm to get to your polling place.

If you haven’t cast your vote yet, please look up your polling place and make a plan to vote right now.

FIND MY POLLING PLACE: https://www.sos.mn.gov/elections-voting/

Remember that you’ll be able to vote as long as you’re in line before 8:00 pm. If you’re still in line when the polls close, please stay in line!

If you’re not registered to vote, you can register in-person at your polling place with proof of residence.

Finally, if you’ve already voted or have a plan to vote, please reach out to five of your family members, friends, and neighbors and ensure they get to the polls. There’s a lot at stake in this year’s election, and we can’t afford to leave anyone out.

Thank you,

Team Keith

| Hi Peter, Do you rely on logic or emotions to make money decisions? In a perfect world, "logic" would be the answer every time. But we don't live in a perfect world, and we aren't robots. So, the reality is that our emotions can outweigh logic in many financial choices we make.1 And that's not necessarily a "bad" thing.
---
|
---
When it comes to money and financial decisions, we can _instantly_ feel positive or negative about them and base our choices on those feelings. Those instant emotions come from the money personalities that are distinct to each of us. Unpacking the different money personality types is the focus of this month's Visual Insights Newsletter. [**Click here to see it!**](https://financeinsights.net/JVeqSwxAzCzg5BYhGze1ZFbqDPY?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Knowing your money personality can give you a stronger grip on your feelings and beliefs about finance. And that's what it can take to shift gears and make your money personality and mindset truly work for you. [**Go ahead and click here to find out what your money personality type is.**](https://financeinsights.net/JVeqSwxAzCzg5BYhGze1ZFbqDPY?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Sincerely,

body:

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96614960/510594062/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3771-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzdiZGY1NC04NzliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r7YpfStJLq0_ji1XiBcuwDPzhUq7IxSkgrbFLCft74U=)
Election Day is finally here, friend, and while there's still work to be done over the next few hours to help folks get to the polls, I want to say thank you.
**This campaign hasn't been easy, and I want to thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for being with me in this fight.** Thanks for believing in the Dignity of Work, in equal rights for all, in the concept that corporations should be held accountable, and in the idea that the wealthiest Americans should pay their fair share.
Because of you and hundreds of thousands of grassroots supporters, we've built a movement powerful enough to take on not just my self-funding, multimillionaire opponent, but national Republicans who are spending record amounts to flip this seat and the Senate red.

body:
https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com [https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com]
Dear Supporters and Friends,
Today is a pivotal moment for our democracy. Today, November 5 is the final day to cast your vote in this crucial election, and your voice matters now more than ever.
At the Tennessee Voter Project (TVP), we’ve been hard at work to support our Democratic candidates and ensure that every voter can participate. This year, we have made significant strides in mobilizing our community and amplifying Democratic voices throughout Shelby County and beyond.
Here’s a snapshot of what we’ve accomplished together:
Yard Signs and Billboards: We’ve distributed countless Harris/Waltz yard signs and set up billboard advertisements across the county to raise awareness about our candidates and encourage voter turnout. These visual reminders are crucial in reminding our neighbors of the importance of their vote.
Harris/Waltz Headquarters: We proudly opened the Harris/Waltz Headquarters in Memphis, serving as a hub for organizing, outreach, and community engagement for volunteers and Democrats. This space has become a vital resource for volunteers and supporters, allowing us to coordinate our efforts effectively.
Mail Outreach: In addition to our on-the-ground initiatives, TVP has mailed out over 10,000 pieces of literature to voters across the district. This outreach has included important information about candidates like Kamala Harris and Jesse Huseth, the Democratic candidate for State House District 97, ensuring that voters are informed and ready to make their decisions.
As we approach the finish line, we urge you to act TODAY. If you haven’t voted yet, please make it a priority to head to the polls. Every vote contributes to the future we envision—one that reflects our shared values of equality, justice, and opportunity for all.
If you have friends or family who still need to vote, remind them of the importance of their participation. Together, we can make a difference in this election and pave the way for a brighter future.
Thank you for your unwavering support and commitment to our cause. Together, we’re building a stronger, more inclusive Tennessee. Let’s finish this election strong!
With gratitude,
Tennessee Voter Project
P.S. If you would like to get involved with our ongoing efforts or make a last-minute donation to support our work, please visit our website, www.tennesseevoterproject.com [http://www.tennesseevoterproject.com] or click on any of the donation links. Every contribution helps us empower voters and uplift Democratic candidates. Let’s keep the momentum going!
P.S.S. Our campaign headquarters in the Cooper-Young area in Memphis will be open tomorrow. Stop by and commiserate with other Democrats. 871 Cooper Street, Memphis, TN 38104

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96616799/510600213/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2I1OTE1OTMtODk5Yi1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=N42BmYcrVsPdK_NZycaIis_yqxv6BVyIImghVzaA5tI=&emci=87832a49-fa9a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=3b591593-899b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
It’s finally Election Day. In just a few hours, polls will close and states will begin to tabulate results.
Unfortunately, that doesn’t mean we can expect results tonight. Here’s why: In some of the critical swing states, election workers can’t count mail-in ballots until Election Day, when they’re also busy with in-person voting.
Michigan’s Secretary of State has already warned the state won’t know the results of the election until Wednesday. Pennsylvania and Wisconsin expect results even later.
**[We’ll talk about why this should worry you in a second, but if you want to support COURIER’s battleground newsrooms in this critical moment, can you chip in $25 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96616805/510600215/-260044646?refcode=20241105-EM-ElectionDay&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2I1OTE1OTMtODk5Yi1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=N42BmYcrVsPdK_NZycaIis_yqxv6BVyIImghVzaA5tI=)**

While we wait patiently for ballots to be counted, Trump and the GOP are going to fear-monger and spread conspiracies about voter fraud, undocumented immigrants, and stolen elections.
When there’s an information void, Trump and his allies will jump in to fill it with misinformation, desperately trying to convince Americans that a delayed result means there’s something wrong with the electoral process.
Remember 2020? Democrats made up the majority of absentee voters. Those votes were largely counted in the days following Election Day. **Trump and his cronies cynically used that fact to allege that the election was stolen.**
**We can’t let it happen again. **
Here at COURIER our election coverage will continue, far beyond today. Our swing state newsrooms are publishing directly in the social media news feeds and email inboxes where election lies are most likely to spread.
With your help we can correct the record and stand up to another bogus effort to steal the election.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Hope over fear
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2410%2E4032634%2EXprPwm)
---
Happy Election Day! I know you might be feeling anxious about today. I understand that — there are many serious issues on the line. But I hope you're also getting to appreciate the magic of casting your ballot. There’s something so special about Election Day. Dropping your mail-in ballot in the mailbox. The poll workers who give you a warm welcome. The roars of cheers in the room when it’s announced that someone is a first-time voter. Getting your sticker after casting your ballot. And after traveling around the country for Kamala Harris and campaigning for re-election here in Massachusetts, I’m feeling hopeful about today. We’ve got great candidates up and down the ticket. We’ve got thousands of dedicated staffers and volunteers fighting their hearts out. And millions of people are speaking up and getting involved. When I often visited swing states on the campaign trail, I’d ask folks to raise their hands if this was the first time they’ve volunteered. So many people were putting up a hand, saying, “I might not have done this before, but wow, this one really, really, really, really matters.” In 2020, Americans showed up in record-shattering numbers — even in the middle of a pandemic — to vote out Donald Trump. Joe Biden and Kamala Harris won more votes than any ticket in history. In the 2022 midterms, experts kept saying that we were in for a “red wave.” They kept insisting that Democrats had no chance to win. But we expanded our Democratic Senate majority, and we defeated downballot election deniers. And ever since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and an abortion vote was put on a state’s ballot, abortion rights won every. single. time. Voters in places that nobody thought would be pro-choice stood up and said, “No, that is not who we want to be, and that is not what we want the government doing.” The first vote was in Kansas. I remember when the first word came that Kansans wanted to vote on abortion, and the experts around the country said “Whoa, don't start in Kansas because there won't be enough people to really stand up and carry this.” By golly, were they wrong. When we use our power in our democracy — when we get in the fight and stay in the fight — we win. Look, it's scary. The polls are very close. But MAGA extremists want us to feel powerless and hopeless. We won’t give them the satisfaction. So let’s square our shoulders and take on today with hope in our hearts. [**If you haven't voted yet, please go to IWillVote.com right now — find your polling place and make your plan to vote before the polls close tonight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2811?t=8&akid=2410%2E4032634%2EXprPwm) If you're already on your way to vote, get three friends, neighbors, or family members to come along and vote, too. If you've already voted, share the [**IWillVote.com**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2811?t=9&akid=2410%2E4032634%2EXprPwm) link with everyone and their mother, and their mother’s mother, and their father, and their father’s best friend, and your neighbors, and your group chat, and your old college study group’s Facebook page that nobody has posted on for years. Let them know why you’re voting for Democrats. Remind them that our freedoms, our democracy, our climate, and our futures are at stake this year. I know that can feel daunting, but we can win today — as long as we all leave everything out on the field. So take a deep breath, and then take action. We’re going to win this and elect Kamala Harris. Pinky promise. Thanks for being a voter, Elizabeth P.S. [**If you’ve got some extra time today after talking with everyone in your circle, volunteer to make calls to voters from home with the Harris-Walz team.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2812?t=10&akid=2410%2E4032634%2EXprPwm) Contacting voters who haven’t cast a ballot yet is one of the best ways to direct any anxious energy you’ve got right now.

When we use our power in our democracy — when we get in the fight and stay in the fight — we win. Look, it's scary. The polls are very close. But MAGA extremists want us to feel powerless and hopeless. We won’t give them the satisfaction. So let’s square our shoulders and take on today with hope in our hearts. If you're already on your way to vote, get three friends, neighbors, or family members to come along and vote, too. If you've already voted, share the link with everyone and their mother, and their mother’s mother, and their father, and their father’s best friend, and your neighbors, and your group chat, and your old college study group’s Facebook page that nobody has posted on for years. Let them know why you’re voting for Democrats. Remind them that our freedoms, our democracy, our climate, and our futures are at stake this year. I know that can feel daunting, but we can win today — as long as we all leave everything out on the field. So take a deep breath, and then take action. We’re going to win this and elect Kamala Harris. Pinky promise. Thanks for being a voter, Elizabeth P.S. Good morning, friends! Election Day is here, polls are open all across the country, and if you haven’t voted yet, now is the time [https://iwillvote.com/] !
I know everyone is feeling stressed today. I get it – elections are stressful! But I want to talk for a minute about why I feel really hopeful right now, and why I think you should, too.
I’m hopeful because after the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , millions of people around the country turned their anger into action and have been pushing to protect and restore reproductive freedom every day since. And every single time abortion rights have been on the ballot since that day, we’ve won .
When I’m campaigning around San Diego, I am constantly filled with hope because there are so many good people dedicated to making our community the best it can be, to solving problems together, and to living up to our values in everything we do.
And as I’ve gotten the chance to campaign on behalf of great House candidates around the country and for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz in battleground states, I have been blown away by the hope I see in other people – in volunteers, in my fellow candidates, in students on campuses.
We don’t know what’s going to happen in this election.
But I do know that no matter what, there are millions and millions of people – here in San Diego, across California, across the entire country – who believe in a brighter future, who believe in freedom and protecting our rights and fighting together for what’s right.
And that fight goes on no matter what happens in ANY election.
So thank you for being by my side in this incredibly important work, and for everything you’ve done this election cycle to help support my re-election campaign and Democrats everywhere.
And of course, one last reminder to go vote! You can look up your polling location or find ballot drop box locations at IWillVote.com [https://iwillvote.com/] , and please take a few minutes today to remind the people you know to do the same.
With gratitude,
Sara

| | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. She has spent her career advocating for her client’s interests while also achieving tangible, positive outcomes. In Congress, she will hold true to her core conservative values while ensuring Washington D.C. is working for the people of District Two. A passionate advocate for families, farms, and faith, Dobson aims to preserve the bedrock values and moral backbone that have defined our nation. With a call for Alabama common sense, she is determined to challenge the far-left agenda in Washington, D.C., advocating for the rights of property owners and defending the freedom to think, speak, and act without interference. Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia. Her decision to run for Congress is deeply rooted in a desire to secure a future for her children and to champion the principles that have made America the land of the free.

| In the last week of the election, the San Jose Mercury published an article about my opponent and me. They told everyone my chances of winning were slim to none. The article failed to mention my opponent’s radical voting record which includes not stopping lethal fentanyl trafficking, deporting convicted criminals, or allowing noncitizens to vote!

My campaign has opened the eyes of many in San Francisco and San Mateo counties, and my consultant said my digital ads have reached double the number of voters compared to typical candidates. My brand resonates with voters and I have a real chance to bring about the change we need. Let’s prove all the naysayers wrong and go vote for a better future. Your vote will be counted as long as the ballot is postmarked before 8 pm today.

| Onward,

BREAKING: God is *not* biting His nails right now.
It has already been decided.
We are about to walk into this reality in a few hours.
My sincere prayer is that God gives us another reprieve and does NOT give us who we most certainly deserve.
Pray. Vote. Call friends and family. Drive them to the polls. Hand out water. Bring a lawn chair for yourself and one other for the long wait.
Then, pray some more. In fact, walk and talk to the Lord today.
Blessings!

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

The bottom line is that opponents of voting rights could easily enact many of the proposed policies from Project 2025. We're focused on the changes to voting and our elections, but there's no doubt that this plan would radically alter our country and our lives into a mix of our inequitable past and an unrecognizable autocracy. The loss of rights might well be irreversible.
We cannot stand by and let Project 2025 become reality. RUSH $25 or more right now to make sure every voter knows about the dangerous consequences of this plan before they vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=110524_2&amount=25]

There's been a lot of talk about the Heritage Foundation's "Project 2025", Team. It's time for the truth.
Project 2025 is a detailed and specific plan for what the next Republican president could ( or in the eyes of some, should ) do with his power, including the preparation needed to put the plan into action. Organized by the Heritage Foundation, a right-wing, dark money, inside-the-beltway, anti-voting think tank , and advised by more than 100 conservative groups, Project 2025 has put forth a 922-page list of policy recommendations, going agency by agency in the federal government.
This is not an unattainable "wish list" -- this is carefully crafted to be a list of things the next president’s appointees really can do , put together by many people who served in top posts under Trump last time and could well do so again. Basically, it’s an attempt to make the second Trump term way more organized and effective than the first.
This is a good place to mention that Project 2025 is also collecting a database of names of conservatives who have already pledged loyalty to Donald Trump and could easily take jobs in his potential second term, willing to start executing this plan on day one.
Already heard enough and are willing to help us educate voters across the country about this dangerous and anti-democracy plan? Pitch in $25 or whatever you can now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=110524_2&amount=25]
Project 2025 covers a lot of different things, but basically falls into three buckets:
➜ Expanding the power of the president. Various pieces of the plan attempt to consolidate executive branch power in the hands of the president and his political appointees and away from nonpartisan civil service employees and Congress. For example, Donald Trump himself could be directing voter suppression efforts through the Department of Justice.
➜ Long-term conservative policy priorities. Slashing regulations on businesses, especially in regards to the environment. Ending climate change mitigation efforts. Reducing programs to help the poor, like food programs or educational requirements. Eradicating civil rights protections, including access to the ballot and our ability to vote. The list goes on, but if you've heard it from a conservative politician over the last forty years, it's likely in this plan.
➜ An extreme religious agenda. Further federal restrictions on abortion access. New, possibly expansive restrictions on contraception coverage. Outlawing pornography and imprisoning members of that industry. Banning LGBTQ books in libraries. Rolling back or ending LGBTQ programs in schools.
Project 2025 would fundamentally alter just about every aspect of American life . We must make sure every American is aware of what their vote might mean and how this expansive blueprint would truly impact themselves, their friends, and their family before it is time for them to cast a ballot.
Fuel our efforts to spread the word and educate voters about these dangerous plans with $25 or more today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=110524_2&amount=25]

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39268%2E3422442%2E38jHka)
Derek, Happy Election Day!
If you haven’t already, [**_please be sure to vote and make your voice heard!_**](https://act.katieporter.com/go/1414?t=2&akid=39268%2E3422442%2E38jHka) If you’ve already cast your ballot, check in with all your friends and family to make sure they’ve also voted.
Before results start coming in, we want to talk through with you what could happen after polls close.
For non-competitive seats, we can expect journalists to call those races tonight. That means they do the math and figure out that one of the candidates is basically guaranteed to win once all the ballots have been counted.
The closer the race is, the more ballots have to be counted before a winner can be called—that takes time. Sometimes that means later at night; sometimes that means days or even weeks later. Remember that in 2020, the _Associated Press_ did not make an official call on the president-elect until Saturday.
This time around, we also need to be ready for the possibility that Trump declares victory, no matter the actual results.
In an especially close race, we could also find ourselves in a recount situation for the presidency or other candidates Truth to Power has endorsed this year.
**[All of this is to say, it’s not actually Election Day; it’s Election Season. If you’re able, can you chip in today, so we’re prepared for whatever comes next?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241105?refcode=em20241105-39268&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39268_3422442_38jHka&akid=39268%2E3422442%2E38jHka)**
We will be watching the presidential election results, of course, but with control of Congress up for grabs, we’re also paying close attention to swing House and Senate seats.
We will be in touch in the coming days to update you on results and ways to stay involved. We know many people are probably exhausted at this point, but our democracy needs us to keep up our engagement on this election until every last ballot is counted.
Thank you for all that you do, and hang in there!
Truth to Power

Remember that in 2020, the Associated Press did not make an official call on the president-elect until Saturday. This time around, we also need to be ready for the possibility that Trump declares victory, no matter the actual results. In an especially close race, we could also find ourselves in a recount situation for the presidency or other candidates Truth to Power has endorsed this year. We will be watching the presidential election results, of course, but with control of Congress up for grabs, we’re also paying close attention to swing House and Senate seats. We will be in touch in the coming days to update you on results and ways to stay involved. We know many people are probably exhausted at this point, but our democracy needs us to keep up our engagement on this election until every last ballot is counted. Thank you for all that you do, and hang in there! Truth to Power Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. Today is Election Day, and we have the original Emerge woman Kamala Harris at the top of the ticket with more than 500 powerhouse Emerge alums up and down the ballot. We’re grateful for how far we’ve come on collective strength. _**But this isn’t just a moment – it’s a movement.**_

Since our founding, Emerge has been building a woman-led America by recruiting, training, supporting, and electing women leaders nationwide and at all levels of government. Today, we are the nation’s largest network of women elected officials and candidates, with over 6,000 women trained, 1,200 women in office, and 500+ Emerge alums up and down the November ballot. _**This is what all our work comes down to – supporting Democratic women.**_

| | | | Dear Peter,
**Today’s the day – Election Day!**
The future of Florida and America is in our hands, and every single vote counts. I need you with me to WIN BIG and defend our values.
If you’ve already cast your vote, thank you! Your support has meant everything to our campaign.

---
| [](https://link.support.mike4congress.)

If not, please make your way to the polls today. They’re open from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., so there’s still time to make your voice heard. Let’s make sure we have a strong Republican turnout by voting up and down the ticket.
_**[Find your polling place here>>](https://link.support.mike4congress.)**_
It’s been an honor to have you by my side throughout this journey. Let’s finish strong and bring home a victory for Florida!
And if you’re able, consider chipping in any amount to help us fuel these final efforts. Every bit counts.

[CHIP IN TODAY>>](https://link.support.mike4congress.)

With gratitude,
Mike Haridopolos

name: Team Fetterman
subject: Want to know how to vote TODAY? Open this.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
The future of our democracy depends on it.
#
Derek,
We wanted to share important information on how to cast your pivotal ballot today on Election Day.
Here’s how to vote in-person, how to track the status of your mail-in ballot, or request an emergency absentee ballot:
1. On Election Day -- TODAY -- polls are open from 7:00 am to 8:00 pm. You can [find your polling place via I Will Vote](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50096?t=1&akid=9569%2E434096%2EzcmrHO) right now if you don’t know it already.
* Only first-time voters need to show an approved form of ID (such as a Pennsylvania driver’s license or current utility bill) to vote at the polls on Election Day.
2. If you requested an absentee ballot OR a mail-in ballot, that MUST be received by your local election official by 8:00 pm on Election Day -- again, TODAY. If you applied for a mail ballot, you can [track the status of your mail ballot](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50097?t=2&akid=9569%2E434096%2EzcmrHO) online. **Do not delay in returning your ballot -- the safest way to ensure your ballot returns in time to be counted is to return it back ASAP.**
3. The deadline to request an absentee or mail-in ballot has passed, HOWEVER: If you have an emergency -- such as an unexpected illness or disability or last-minute absence from your municipality -- you may still be able to obtain a mail ballot. The deadline to submit your emergency absentee ballot application to your county election office is 8:00 pm on Election Day. [You can find information here about requesting an emergency absentee ballot.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50098?t=3&akid=9569%2E434096%2EzcmrHO)

We know Pennsylvania is one of the most critical swing states in this year’s election, and we need everyone to show up to the polls and vote. The future of our democracy depends on it!
Thanks, and happy Election Day!
💙 Team Fetterman
P.S. -- **If you know anyone in Pennsylvania who is on the fence about voting, or who might want to know how to vote, forward this email to them.** They’ll be happy to hear from you and feel empowered to vote, too.

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20241105-9569-footer&t=4&refcode2=9569_434096_zcmrHO&akid=9569%2E434096%2EzcmrHO)**
---

Email us: info@johnfetterman.com
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Fetterman for PA, PO Box 6061, Pittsburgh PA 15211.

Every single vote counts, and with so much on the line, we’d like to personally ask for your support. _Here’s how you can help today:_
1. **Find Your Polling Place:** Make sure you know where to go by checking your polling location. Polls are open from 6 AM until 7 PM, so make a plan to get there. Any voter who at the moment of closing is in the line waiting shall be allowed to vote

---
[ Check your polling location here ](https://clicksp.jonathannezforaz.com/f/a/wWFzwpLqusJEhATza80ZHA~~/AAPPAAA~~~)

2\. **Bring Your ID (any one of the four options listed below is sufficient)** _Acceptable forms of photo ID with name and address include:_
* Valid Arizona driver license
* Valid Arizona non-operating identification card
* Tribal enrollment card or other form of tribal identification
* Valid United States federal, state, or local government-issued identification

3\. **Encourage Others to Vote:** Share the importance of voting today with family, friends, and neighbors. Together, we can create a stronger future for Arizona. 4\. **Cast your ballot for Jonathan Nez!** All the best,
Team Nez

Peter, if you missed our email this morning, we wanted to catch you before lunch. You can see all the details below but before we get to that, if you don’t have plans for watching the election results tonight you can join us at the OKGOP Election Night party. [Register here right away](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=OuHnzqubmow6O_1L76Q3v2F3UxM7-W63U87VaIpPAxdH2VoT8wIrOl0qViseTbJ4&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=2). [](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=OuHnzqubmow6O_1L76Q3v2F3UxM7-W63U87VaIpPAxdH2VoT8wIrOl0qViseTbJ4&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=3)Now for the email from this morning once again: Peter, that’s right, it’s finally Election Day! If you haven’t voted yet, here’s what you need to know:
1. You can verify your polling location [by looking it up online here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=KVdJ3K8uGr2-EEON3vpq7JrUAOTJcXIqIeMkaRQa_DKfivfTPuuMQMoqu_KdtkBV&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=4).
2. And you can look at your sample ballot. [You can see what your ballot will look like by entering your data here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=KVdJ3K8uGr2-EEON3vpq7JrUAOTJcXIqIeMkaRQa_DKfivfTPuuMQMoqu_KdtkBV&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=5).
3. You should print your research to bring with you OR save it to your phone. [You can find out info on the judges to print & bring with you here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaOEva1Jz4u7JgJ_UBwFRQd8&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=6). (**Remember: VOTE NO on all three liberal supreme court judges Edmondson, Gurich, & Kauger!**).
4. Bring someone WITH YOU to vote! Reach out to a coworker, family, friend, or anyone you can think of to bring them to vote with you!
5. Don’t forget to bring your ID. Photo ID works best, but your voter ID card will work as well. You don’t need both, one or the other will work.
6. Lines could be long as we’ve already seen record voter turnout, so you may want to bring along some bottled water & possibly a snack.

And you should check out this video from Governor Stitt on why to VOTE NO on the three liberal Supreme Court judges. Just click the image to watch. [](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=hN0FNeoNOFX4sKu0n6pYneCbWLOphrPk3f8rLC_mBeScTI_2nUHw8Wf7LP7RH6ONyVfb9q4HKjd5AL26VPrKOXlBK6CgttIXftne1JtWgFNdvOFhi_3N6swWyOipKY6f&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=7) If you have already voted through absentee or early voting: thank you! We need every Republican to get out & vote in this election. So you may be thinking your duty is done because you already cast your vote. But there is still something we need you to do TODAY: We need you to contact at least 5 family/friends/coworkers/church members/neighbors. You can send them a text, an email, message on social media, or call them. But make it a goal to reach out to 5 people this morning and **ENCOURAGE THEM TO GO VOTE!** Polls are open until 7:00pm. We must swamp the vote to overcome any margin of cheating! So even if you voted beforehand, there is still work to be done today. Please contact at least 5 people. **Tell them to VOTE NO on the liberal Supreme Court judges**. Send them the image below so they remember their names. Have them watch the video below of Chairman Nathan Dahm discussing these liberal judges. Explain the ease & benefits of voting straight party Republican. Share your knowledge with your sphere of influence & help us multiply your vote on Election Day! [](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=hN0FNeoNOFX4sKu0n6pYneCbWLOphrPk3f8rLC_mBeTaJna08zBhDt6R0tNz_chhhA6kSx21ftZSdVheyCvVbAfV0CdogKtXYI_ZowOTU2VB4gudnxUPiSjigoJD9mIv&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=8) Together we can have a HISTORIC Election Day. But we must not stop until the polls have closed & we can say we’ve done everything we could. That means reaching out to 5 other people right away. Encourage everyone you know to go VOTE! -Team OKGOP

This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/unsubscribe?e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=9).
You can also keep up with OKGOP on [Twitter](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JcrYNQ7dhdufXPgOgJxNGHSsRONv6mnq7ly6aBOUvGVprSj7jfHNOpP70kR_1QLA&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=10) or [Facebook](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=UQNagEd-DqbIXa37T8ODid9mG9NGbq3z9te4_riKc6EaGmrOrRzKc2wAaVTFbzRY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_this_can_be_a_5th_of_novembe&n=11).

Friend,
This Election Day, I'm reflecting on one of my core political beliefs...
I believe that every American should have access to the same four freedoms: the freedom to rise, the freedom to learn, the freedom to govern ourselves, and the freedom from violence.
Donald Trump and his acolytes stand for the exact opposite.
Just look at Project 2025, which would give Trump unchecked power to attack our fundamental rights and prosecute political rivals.

_**Do I need an ID?**_
* If you’ve voted in CA before, you don’t need to show an ID!

* If you’re a **first-time voter in a federal election,** and you registered without providing your driver's license number, California ID number, or the last four digits of your SS #, you may be asked to provide an ID

_**What if I’m not registered to vote?**_
* **Same-day voter Registration** is a safety net for those who missed the deadline or have not updated their registration, [_**and can be done at your county elections office, polling place, or vote center**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96629806/510643661/-915269722?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDM3OGQ3YS05OTliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z9a8twRq-WWvjfsCK_VIJh7Z_1n1rdIw3dqv8ohWQUQ=&emci=1bcdb8ae-9998-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=00378d7a-999b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=6681226)

TODAY'S THE DAY!! No matter what state you live in, or no matter how expect the election to go, make sure you get out and VOTE!! We as Believers hold the power to impact MAJOR change on our nation. According to Pew Research, in 2021, self-identified Christians made up 63% of the U.S. population (210 million). In total, 155 million votes were cast in the 2020 presidential election. Biden won Arizona by 10,457 votes, Georgia by 11,779 votes, Wisconsin by 20,682 votes, and Nevada by 33,596 votes. That’s a total of 76,611 votes across just four states. Let's get out today and CHANGE OUR NATION!!

This year it’s crucial that we vote for climate, so Oregon can continue being a leader on climate regardless of what happens at the federal level. **We need everyone’s voice in this election,** so I wanted to send you all one last reminder to vote if you haven’t already. There are two ways to return your ballot:
1. **Drop your ballot off in person at the post office!** Hand it to an attendant and make sure it’s postmarked by today (November 5th).
2. **Use an[official dropbox](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96631251/510648706/719410068?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA2ZjYxNTk3LTliOWItZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=a6UOtjfZV6AL6rvTvZa58HERx467UPg_nU4I8J7rYfU=&emci=d42f47b2-1e9b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=06f61597-9b9b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=2107230)!** As long as you are in line at an official dropbox location by 8pm today (November 5th), your ballot will be accepted.

This thing isn’t over yet, and we’re still locked in one of the most competitive races in the entire country. |
---
Peter,

This is it – our FINAL day.

Friend,
If you've been following this campaign, you probably know that even as I type this, at 6 am on Election Day, we've already made history.
How? Well, I'm the first Muslim candidate in Washington State's history to advance this far in a federal election. And if elected, I'll be the first white Muslim to serve in Congress in America's history. I'd also be the first woman to serve in Congress on behalf of Washington's 9th District, **ever**!
(The incumbent - the lifetime politician - who did not have any other meaningful career in his life, fools us with empty rhetoric about "Representative" democracy. What does he represent? Over 60% of this congressional district are folks of Color, and about 52% are female. More than half of us - including me - were born since incumbent has been in elected office. Continuing to elect this un-representative Representative means depriving our people of true 'Representation.')
As I write this, we all have no idea how Election Day 2024 is going to play out. Will Harris overcome the substantial handicap of supporting genocide and eke out a win, making her America's first female president? Will Trump manage to sway enough people, despite his racism, history of sexual assault, etc, to prevail in the electoral college? Will the Green Party make history by achieving 5% of the popular vote - ensuring that Americans have a third, federally-funded option on the 2028 ballot, one that isn't beholden to wars and violence for private profits at our (Taxpayer's) expense? How long will final results take; how much electoral violence and vote suppression will America endure; what kind of confusion and/or deliberate chaos will be introduced into what should be a peaceful transition of power?
What a fascinating time to be alive.
[Share "It's a Matter of Integrity" by Melissa Chaudhry](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cde50c4d-1b26-4f8d-968b-95bcda5a6529?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Closer to home, will our broad-based coalition - of people of conscience who reject funding genocide, BIPOC communities who finally see their concerns represented on the ballot, principled Republicans and Independents who want a candidate financially accountable to the people, progressive Democrats who are ready for a new generation of leadership, and our Muslim communities (the densest in Washington State) - overcome a 28-year incumbent advantage and deliver this seat back to the people of Washington's 9th?
No matter what happens at the level of the Presidency, our district deserves a champion. Someone who will fight to protect and defend hard-working people, BIPOC communities, our shared earth, and the next generation. Someone who isn't bought out by AIPAC or the war/violence machine; who knows that prosperity begins with _peace_ ; and who holds with utter conviction the fundamental American ideals of **Liberty and Justice for All** ; **Government Of, By, and For the People** ; and **Lifting our Lamp Beside the Golden Door**.
# **Win or lose this round, my commitment to service will continue. As will this publication.**
In it, I'll explore these themes, and how they apply to America in the modern day. I'll share news you might not otherwise hear, and I'll stand for peace, principle, opportunity, and the people of CD-9 - who are a stunningly beautiful microcosm of the world, united by location and language, whose destinies are entwined with the future of America.
As I've said on the campaign trail, I believe that people of conscience in this country - those who truly believe in American **principles** , who haven't succumbed to the hypocrisy and cognitive dissonance that living in a late-stage empire makes almost inescapable - outnumber the others. We who truly believe that America _can and should_ be a beacon of integrity, refuge, inclusion, and opportunity, have the numbers required to determine America's future. But we must work at it. The forces in opposition to us are daunting - yet we _**must**_ prevail, for humanity to have any chance at a peaceful, prosperous and stable future.
I believe that every generation has the opportunity - and the obligation - to advance the project of equality in America. "To form a more perfect union" should be taken as a sacred charge, and a personal responsibility. Every generation has its defining moment, its mission, its existential battle for the soul of America. Ending slavery, overcoming the power of the robber barons, the Civil Rights movement and Vietnam, Afghanistan, Iraq... American history is full of examples of people of conscience putting their shoulders to the wheel and actively working to bend the arc of the moral universe toward justice.
This time can be no exception.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3260111&post_id=151213871&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUxMjEzODcxLCJpYXQiOjE3MzA4MjgxNzEsImV4cCI6MTczMzQyMDE3MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTMyNjAxMTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.yhWn9mwvxJEl15tekSJSHZP4UFbgnhMB6pN_muzTYbw)
This time, America is in a position of global dominance on the world stage - by design, and by strategy. But that power is fragile, and beginning to fray - and America has lost the essential power of moral leadership, through breaking our promises and treaties, and demonstrating hypocrisy on the issues of war crimes, territorial aggression, financial sovereignty, and genocide - among others. The damage to America's standing abroad by our continuing support for atrocities (in direct contravention of **[our](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bbc5e98b-3d99-45a1-afa4-33c905366a43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [own](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b8087c88-334b-4be1-ac24-847a25f4deaa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [laws](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/967bd392-dfc5-4c85-a1ac-a06d7001bbd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, as well as [international](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0a7c8ac2-9eb1-44c2-8899-497dbd5b9b1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [law](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b639d847-7995-40c7-b11f-3868ac928eb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) cannot be overstated. The consequences will be far-reaching.
Meanwhile, the war machine drains money that Americans need at home to invest in our communities. Housing, education, healthcare, childcare, infrastructure and transportation, a Green New Deal - every imaginable policy to care for our own and uplift the next generation is undermined by our country's perpetual obsession with wars. Those who make the bombs, rake in the profits - paid for with taxpayer money, resulting in unconscionable slaughter abroad. How is this in keeping with "American interests" \- and why are (special/corporate/private) "American interests" treated as so much more important than **American integrity**?
After generations of this pattern, America is chronically underfunded and disinvested at home, and massively overextended and militarily overbuilt abroad. In real terms, wages have [nearly stagnated](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2afd5c56-ce2c-4311-af76-88c74fefc431?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for over 50 years. Seniors living on fixed incomes [cannot afford decent healthy food](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e0aaa6d8-dcd6-4818-8104-5ed33b91d8de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and - and child poverty has skyrocketed again after pandemic-era support programs cut child poverty by more than half. **[One in seven](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1f98d974-fc0b-4964-ba1e-103229ab637a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** children in the USA currently lives in poverty.
Yet we're paying to sustain over [750 military bases](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b8e9ccb0-775a-426f-8a13-da763794857b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) abroad, to the tune of over [$80 billion](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3a6861ea-49cc-4ed8-a627-c645789a1ee7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) annually - and that's just the publicly acknowledged figures.
To be clear, I'm not against the military. My husband and father are both Honorable, decorated, American veterans; I understand the costs of war firsthand and believe in supporting veterans and military families; and I value the ideals and principles of service, sacrifice, duty, and honor that the military instills. I see America's challenge as whether and how well we can _pivot and repurpose_ our military might to be a **force for good, not harm** on this planet. We **can** maintain our strength while gradually shifting our goal to that of powerful strategic cooperation, rather than a policy of "full spectrum dominance" leading to inevitable and unnecessary conflict with other rising powers. We can give the massive juggernaut of the US Military - the unparalleled recruitment, training, and logistics capabilities we've built over generations - _**a better job.**_
And with the money saved by streamlining, repurposing, and - gradually and safely - drawing down our military presence abroad - and by revising our tax code! - we can invest in our communities at home, strengthen America's economy and society, and ensure every American has the support and opportunities they need to thrive.

This mission is not just about one Congressional campaign. It's about fundamentally restoring American Representative democracy, integrity, principle, social fabric, and the rule of law. It's about accounting and compensating for the damage and discrimination of our past; welcoming and celebrating meaningful diversity, not mere tokenization; strengthening our shared commitment to common principles; and building a future that works for _everyone_. It's about refusing to take part in gratuitous violence, apartheid, or genocide. It's about standing for American principles at home and abroad, and aligning both our domestic and foreign policy to this North Star. It's about including **everyone** in our understanding of who is valuable, who is worthy of life and opportunity, and whose voices should be heard and votes should be counted. It's about Liberty and Justice for ALL - no asterisks, and no exceptions.

Derek,
Today is Election Day — the culmination of all of our efforts to win this Senate race, elect Kamala Harris as our next President, hold the Democratic Senate majority, and flip the House through critical California toss-up districts.
If you haven’t yet cast your vote, I want to take a moment to explain why I’m asking for your support:
__California has real challenges, and our state deserves a leader who will work tirelessly to get things done for the Golden State. We also need a leader ready to take on the big fights to protect our democracy.__
For the last two years, I’ve been running hard not just to win my own race, but to ensure that we have a governing majority in the House and the Senate and a Democrat in the White House.

clean_body: We need to sprint through the finish line. | | | | Friend, Today's the day we've all been waiting for. We've worked so hard up until this point, and we're so close to victory. But before the results start coming in, I want to pause for a moment to say thank you. Thank you for your strength, commitment, enthusiasm, contributions, and thoughtful survey responses. Thank you for standing by our Republican Majority through thick and thin, for always supporting our movement, and for your unwavering love of country. But our work is not yet done, and we need to sprint through the finish line. Friend, if you have not yet voted- I need you to stop reading this message right now and head to the nearest voting center. If you don't know where to vote follow this link to find your polling location. FIND YOUR LOCATION >>> "" It is everyday American patriots like you who will lead our movement to victory with your time, donations, and most of all your votes! "And, if you can find it in your heart to chip in another $5, $10, or $20 to power our movement through these final moments, you could make all the difference." We may not know the results of the Election today, which means we could be in for a long, expensive fight. If you cannot spare a few bucks today-don 't worry about it. You've already done more than enough to get us to this point. name: River Gassen
subject: Today Is the Day—Get Out and Vote!
body:
This is it—Election Day is finally here! | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/15daysremaining-8330017?e=3818d77efc)
---
|
# Today Is the Day—Get Out and Vote!
---
| **This is it—Election Day is finally here!**
Everything we’ve worked for, everything we’ve fought for, all comes down to today. Now is the time to make your voice heard and vote for the future we want to see.
Our campaign has been built on the belief that **we can create real change** together—and today, we have the chance to make that a reality. But we can’t do it without you!
Here’s what you can do right now:
1. **Get out and vote!** If you haven’t already, head to the polls and cast your ballot.

2. **Remind your friends and family** to vote. Every vote counts, and we need everyone to show up!

3. **Donate one last time** to help us reach every single voter who hasn’t cast their ballot yet. Just **$25** can still help us reach 500 more voters through texts and last-minute outreach .

---
[Donate Now](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=5364c1ead1&e=3818d77efc)
|
I promise you two things also.

1\. This is the last time I will be asking for donations this election cycle.

2\. I hope that I can get your continues support in the next cycle.

This is the final push—there’s no tomorrow, no second chance. Together, we can make history, but we need everyone to get out and vote today.
Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. Let’s finish strong!

In solidarity,
River Gassen
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Congress, Colorado - 5

P.S. **Today is the day** —let’s get out there and make a difference! And if you can, chip in one last time to help us reach every voter before the polls close. I promise, I won’t ask again this cycle — you have my word.

---

| Fellow Montanan,
Today is Election Day in the Treasure State. When you go to the polls, I encourage you to both remember President Ronald Reagan’s plea for all of us to determine this country’s destiny and to cast your vote so that those, which Reagan referred to as the honored American dead, who gave their lives to stop the advance of darkness in this world in the 20th century did not die in vain.

| As a young man growing up in the 1980s, I became a Republican because I identified with Reagan’s belief that “if we make up our mind what we are going to make of our lives, then work hard toward that goal, we never lose. Somehow we win out."
It is now the time for choosing in the Treasure State. I encourage your choice to be for those candidates, like me, who believe in advancing and protecting the Montana way of life, and the freedoms that come along with it. Today, Montana has a rendezvous with destiny, a destiny guided by the small government principles of the Republican Party to make the world a better place for all. I would be honored to receive your vote to serve as Montana’s next State Auditor. If you vote via absentee ballot, and have not mailed yours, it’s too late to do so. Instead, hand deliver it to your county election center by 8:00pm. Thank you for your support, and God bless America!
Sincerely, James BrownRepublican for Auditor

name: API PA
subject: Happy Election Day!
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
Happy Election Day! The polls in Pennsylvania are open today until 8 PM. If you haven’t made your voting plan, check out the information below to make sure your vote is counted.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DB_uZuQO5q4/ [https://www.instagram.com/p/DB_uZuQO5q4/]
Voting in person?
If you are planning to vote in person today, look up your polling place so you know where to go! [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/Pages/PollingPlaceInfo.aspx]
Remember, if this is the first time you’re voting at your polling location, you’ll need to show your ID. [https://www.pa.gov/en/agencies/vote/voter-support/new-voters.html]
Voting by mail?
You must sign and write the date on the declaration envelope for your ballot to be counted. Your ballot must be received by 8 PM on November 5 to be counted.
If you still have your mail-in ballot, you should hand-deliver it to your county board of elections, a satellite election office, or a designated drop box! [https://vote.pa/find/return] [https://vote.pa/find/return]
Know your rights!
Whether you cast your ballot in person or by mail on Nov. 5, we want to make sure your vote counts. The best way to do that is to make sure you know your rights. [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2024/11/pennsylvania-general-election-day-2024-voter-rights/]
If you encounter any problems or have questions about voting or how to make your voice heard in this election, call the election protection hotline:
English 866-OUR-VOTE 866-687-8683 [tel:866-687-8683]
Spanish/English 888-VE-Y-VOTA 888-839-8682 [tel:888-839-8682]
Asian Languages/English 888-API-VOTE 888-274-8683 [tel:888-274-8683]
Arabic/English 844-YALLA-US 844-925-5287 [tel:844-925-5287]
Already voted? Help empower Asian American communities in PA!
API PA works year-round to organize, educate, and engage our communities in 20+ languages to build lasting Asian American power. Our work would not be possible without donations from our supporters. Make a $20 donation today to support our in-language direct voter contact program! [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/donate?am=20.00&contactdata=+yMByJH3eOu8PqczOvVssVP6CJ+IN073CGijEOAgUsA+qUkgQe5NTEcUk6j/YpBfUqqFydI8xFiRgv1W3mYwjAcT6ZBGRXVuoGi+MvyXlV+YvzHxJERfBhNYGVdZTGTLYN8SjbX9qFSJ34W3EgtlQPxXUUMttiKKHyckJ/8LBDc=]

# When We Vote We Win!

Dear Friends,
Today is Election Day, and I want to share a personal reflection. I became an American citizen in 1996, sworn in right here in Roanoke, Virginia—not far from where I will be tonight at the Harris-Walz victory party at Howard University. My first opportunity to vote was for President Clinton’s reelection. While every election has been important and has had lasting consequences, this one feels different—there is so much more at stake. That is why we must elect my friend, Vice President Harris, and Democrats up and down the ballot.
Vice President Harris is the best candidate to move our country forward. She has consistently championed policies that uplift working families, protect our rights, and promote equality for all. Her experience as a prosecutor and Attorney General gives her a unique perspective on justice and reform, and her commitment to addressing climate change and healthcare access is crucial for our future. With her leadership, we can build a more inclusive and prosperous America.

| | | Donald Trump is reportedly planning on falsely declaring victory early, before any of the networks have called it, the polls have closed, or there's even a shred of evidence to back it up. **The media needs to call out this BS, fact check it as a lie, and do it in real time.[Add your name, and tell the media: "Don't let Trump falsely declare victory!"](https://default.salsalabs.org/T04ffc16f-a429-4594-85e0-15911b81592a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Trump is doing this so he can later claim the election was stolen, when (fingers crossed) Kamala Harris wins. It's BS, but his cultish supporters will swallow it whole, and spew it all over the internet as "proof." The media must not be complicit in this. We get that they need to cover Trump, given that he's the Republican nominee, but the second he falsely claims victory, they should cut away from his speech, say this is a lie -- and say it in plainly and directly. | Peter,

Today is Election Day, and it’s your chance to shape California’s future. With so many important issues on the ballot, your vote has never been more critical.

Every vote makes a difference in securing the California we envision. Here’s how you can make sure your voice is heard:
1. **Find Your Polling Place:** Make sure you know where to go by checking your polling location. Polls are open from 7 AM until 8 PM, so plan your visit accordingly.
**[Find your polling location](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96635693/510662627/1697095066?polling-location=&source=EM_NBI_AB_20241105_FR_Election_0_3MO_AmiBera_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YjYzYjVkZS1hMjliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bXBYCSsMWR4YiNdrkfRVu4ri45URTEPTOAC3t_a2aLU=&emci=8863b5de-a29b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=8b63b5de-a29b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=32394541)**
2. **Bring Your ID if Needed:** Although California does not require ID for most voters, if you're a first-time voter or recently registered by mail, you should bring identification.
3. **Encourage Friends and Family to Vote:** Voting is even more powerful when we do it together. Spread the word to ensure everyone you know makes it to the polls today!

Thank you for standing by our Republican Majority through thick and thin, for always supporting our movement, and for your unwavering love of country.

But our work is not yet done, and we need to sprint through the finish line.

Friend, if you have not yet voted- **I need you to stop reading this message right now and head to the nearest voting center.
