body:
Crossing the finish line strong

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/donate)
---
Peter, This has been an epic and powerful campaign. From our launch almost a year ago until today, Jill’s message of people, planet, and peace has been breaking through the media blockade as they ignore the most important issues of the moment. And in spite of the anti-Democratic party doing all they can to smear us, spending millions on a war room against us, their efforts have backfired. We have built such a powerful coalition - the political elites are quaking in their boots! Every single day Jill has been exposing Israel’s horrific genocide in Gaza, and the Biden/Harris administration for its complicity in that genocide, speaking out on the disastrous march towards World War III, and unmasking both parties for what they are: patsies of war and Wall Street. We may be in the final hours of this election, but the fight to win a better, greener future is not over. Some of us have been working towards a different path forward for decades, and some have been inspired by this campaign to join in that fight. Whatever the case, we encourage you to stay involved - join the Green Party, run for office, organize a protest in support of Palestine, or all of those things! We are building real pressure for political transformation, with powerful partners we’ve never had before in directly impacted communities. But this is election day, so we are asking you to pitch in your support so we can end the campaign strong, taking us over the finish line. Peter, today we are [**_organizing a money bomb for Jill_**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_1_5nov_eoe&n=1) to show her how much we all support her continued resistance to the AIPAC-funded duopoly candidates and their corporate controlled media lackeys. [**Now is the time! If everyone who gets this email donates just $2.40 or more we will raise more money for Jill in one day than we have raised in any single day during the campaign!**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_1_5nov_eoe&n=2)

We finally made it to Election Day.
How are you feeling: nervous, excited, glued to your phone? Here’s a reminder to take a deep breath.
By being a part of the Fair Fight team, you’ve helped reach millions of voters, drive record early voting turnout, and keep voters informed of their rights. Friend, Have you voted yet? Polls close TONIGHT at 8 p.m. Find your polling place**[here](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=QjZGmTM6zxBC4EXRUQjufmL69zokoazAcXKgwiw5ZVUvufEzCa3qO-EFUCp83b8-&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=the_north_coast_needs_you_toda&n=2)**. [**FIND MY POLLING PLACE** »](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=QjZGmTM6zxBC4EXRUQjufmL69zokoazAcXKgwiw5ZVUvufEzCa3qO-EFUCp83b8-&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=the_north_coast_needs_you_toda&n=3) Today is about one thing and one thing only: _getting voters to the polls_. From our March primary triumph, we have worked tirelessly, with no days off, to reach and persuade as many North Coast voters as possible. **We’ve reached tens of thousands of Republicans, independents, and moderate Democrats with our message for positive change in California’s 2nd Congressional District.** Most voters want secure borders, safe neighborhoods, secure water and food supplies, a strong dollar, a robust but measured foreign policy, and a government that works for the people, not the powerful. And now, _today_ is the time for **action**.
1. Vote!

---
Friends -
I’ve been voting for over 40 years, and my first vote was for Ronald Reagan. And in 2022, I did something I had never done before: campaigned on behalf of a Democrat, for Elissa Slotkin in her congressional campaign.
I endorsed Elissa in her race in 2022 because I had seen her work in the House, and I know that she is someone who is laser-focused on doing the right thing for the people she represents and will put service to our country over service to herself, every time.
The choice to me was clear then, and it’s even clearer now. **That’s why I am supporting Elissa Slotkin in her campaign for United States Senate in Michigan.**
The stakes in this election are unlike anything we've ever faced before. But the future of our democracy is on the line, and this is not about policy differences. It’s about doing what’s right for our country.
Donald Trump, if he is reelected with a Republican Congress, will be far more dangerous than we have ever seen before.
And if Elissa loses in Michigan, he will likely get that chance.
We have a responsibility to future generations to ensure that our republic survives. This is not just about the next four or six years—it’s about the kind of country we want to leave for our children and grandchildren.
[**If you’re ready to join me in this fight to preserve our democracy for future generations, please consider contributing $24 or more to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov24.k4yPYt&refcode=em241105-3-900&t=3&akid=2189%2E135344%2EzGUYar)

#

everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. Ruben Gallego is in a tie race, and we’ve only got a few hours until the polls close. He’s going to need our help as he prepares for what comes next. [**Please, read this message from Ruben’s team, and then make a donation if you can.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-1-120&t=1&akid=5919%2E6688874%2EY2A4Kb)
---

We’ve made a difficult decision.
Kari Lake has a cash advantage on us. She’s used that advantage to outspend us in the Tucson media market, home to Arizona’s second largest metropolitan area. It’s a must win region.
That spending and the attacks coming Ruben’s way have had a real impact. In recent Arizona polls, Kari Lake has actually taken the lead over us. Make no mistake: She could win.
At this stage in the campaign, we can’t let things like this go unanswered. We’ve got to fight back. But the truth is, the money to do it wasn’t in the budget. Adding additional spend ahead of our final monthly deadline with virtually no time to raise what we need to close a new budget gap is dangerous, too.
There’s risk either way here, but we huddled as a team... and decided to give the green light.
It was a difficult decision. We’ve missed fundraising goals lately, and we only have two days to raise this investment back. But we’re betting on you today, Beth. We’re hoping that telling you the truth will convince you to chip in and fill the gap in our budget.
There is no time to waste. Arizona is the last line of defense for our Senate Majority.
[**So please, if you can afford it, make a donation to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate. Split a donation between our campaign and Mark Kelly before midnight.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-1-120&t=2&akid=5919%2E6688874%2EY2A4Kb)

body:
| | | | **Peter,**
After this email, I’ll only be reaching out twice more before I sign off for 2024.

But before we close out the year, I want to take a moment to thank _you_ for your incredible support in my congressional races and beyond.
With limited resources, we - the grassroots - came within 8.5% of beating Dan Crenshaw this March with less than $30k. That’s a powerful testament to your commitment to the cause of liberty and the strength of our movement.
Beyond the campaign trail, your support has helped make Project Defiant a success. Through events that build community, inspire patriotism, uplift veterans, and champion locally-owned businesses, we’ve made a real impact. Together, we’ve created a space for patriots who feel left behind by traditional political groups and given a voice to those who deserve to be heard.
When the Republican Party wouldn’t do it...
When the clubs and women’s groups wouldn’t do it...
When the PACs wouldn’t do it...
We stepped up... and _you_ are a part of that.
That’s why I’m making tonight’s event _free to attend_ , with an option to donate if you’d like. The **Houston MAGA Watch Party** kicks off at 7 PM in Cypress, and if you’re in the Greater Houston area, I’d love to see you there.
**Click here to RSVP and get all the details:** [https://houstonmagawatchparty.com](https://jamesonellis.acemlna.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE4UqLMDKF8yQxMUeBt2H6kk_Ugle02XHXLUneg7pN__ky.zeNr242jidg~jvYxYHHI)
After tonight, my next email will share details about an important live announcement I’ll be making for our future. And then, my last message of 2024 will be the announcement itself.
Thank you for being part of this journey.****
_For Liberty,_ Jameson Ellis

# Sharon Clahchischilliage Invites President Donald Trump to New Mexico
---
| “Hey Donald Trump,

Dear Peter,
Today is decision day.
The stakes are sky-high.
This may be the most critical election of our lifetime.
[**And remember the only way to bring about the change we so desperately need is to _vote for Donald Trump_.**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-vote?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_day_11_5_24_1&n=5)
**Voting for Trump** isn’t just a vote for him; it’s a vote to restore free speech, end government overreach, and fight back against the forces trying to silence us.
So, wherever you live — red state, blue state, or swing state — it’s essential to vote Trump.
[Make America Healthy Again](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-vote?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_day_11_5_24_1&n=6)
With President Trump back in the White House and Kennedy in D.C., we will **Make America Healthy Again**. Together, we will reverse the chronic disease epidemic, end the forever wars that have drained our resources and endangered American lives, and protect our civil liberties by standing up against censorship that threatens our freedoms.
As you know, this could be a very close election. A disputed election result would be a disaster for our divided nation.
**__President Trump needs to win in a landslide both in the Electoral College__** and the popular vote. He can’t do it unless our movement supports him.
We have to unify if we are to overthrow the entrenched elites who are ruining our country.

Campaigning yesterday in Pennsylvania, Donald Trump delivered a profane and conspiracy-laden speech, talking about reporters being shot and suggesting he “ shouldn’t have left ” the White House after his 2020 loss. For those counting at home, that's a major party candidate saying he should have been an anti-democratic autocrat and refused to leave office after an election defeat.
We keep banging the drum about the lies and conspiracy theories we've heard for nearly a decade because voters need to understand what is on the line. From documents like Project 2025 to the verbatim quotes from candidates, the forces that want to end our democracy and silence your right to vote are more than on the news -- they're at the gates , determined to break in and change our country for the worse, forever.
Voters must know what's at stake. The voters who care about our democracy, who care about the principle behind our country, who put our shared values ahead of any political party -- we have to make sure each and every one of them shows up and casts their ballot tomorrow.

name: Michael Baumgartner
subject: Thank you!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vote Baumgartner for Congress | (509) 370-8398 | www
body:
Eleanor and I are so grateful for your support! | | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | |
---
| Friends,
While we don’t yet know the results of the election, I do know that I am tremendously privileged to be able to run for Congress with such wonderful support and friendship from folks like you.
Thank you so much for the support and kindness you have shown me and my family in this campaign journey.
I’m particularly grateful to our campaign team and volunteers for many months of hard work - and to my wife Eleanor and our children. (Having a dad who is a public figure isn’t always easy). They have been amazing.
As I woke up this morning, I felt an overwhelming sense of joy and gratitude to have the opportunity to run for office in our Blessed America. I believe that we will win this election and have a great night, but regardless – it has been a wonderful experience because of all of you.
Starting with my first campaign in 2010, each election day I like to gather with volunteers and other candidates at Spokane’s Lincoln statue for one last “sign-wave.” Doing so is a great reminder of the sacrifices our countrymen have made to build and preserve our Republic. Moreover, whatever challenges we face as a country today still pale in comparison to the obstacles America has overcome in the past.
As we await the results tonight, let’s all remember that however the election turns out we are all Americans first, and that our strength as a country is in our unity, one nation under God.
For as Lincoln reminds us – “a house divided against itself cannot stand”. His vision for a reconciled and united nation in his second inaugural focused on the theme of “with malice toward none; with charity for all.”
It’s been a fun campaign and I’m excited for what comes next.
With deepest gratitude,Michael

Last messages, pleas, and GOTV pushes are winding down, and it’s almost time to see what the post-election world looks like. But Democrats like you don’t sit around — and you know we’ll keep working until every poll is closed. Then, we’ll pull ourselves up, no matter the results, and continue fighting to ensure fairness in our democracy. = | = = = = = = Here’s the truth, Peter — the NDRC’s state-by-state strategy does not end after all the votes are counted. We have a long-term plan that involves investing in elections, pushing reform efforts, and making sure the next Census is fair and accurate. Choose Action Over Inaction on Homelessness Today | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/0b721118fddd/choose-action-over-inaction-on-homelessness-today?e=784f78234b)
---
| |
---
| | | Dear Friend,
Today, you have an important decision to make—a choice that will shape the future of San Diego County. Our communities are at a breaking point, and homelessness is the biggest challenge we face. **Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer has had her chance to lead on this issue, but her inaction and lack of accountability have only made things worse.**
Instead of stepping up, Supervisor Lawson-Remer skipped critical votes and [missed every meeting](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=a4b6b08c32&e=784f78234b) of the very homelessness task force she’s supposed to lead. Rather than addressing this crisis, she has chosen to virtue signal opting for appearances over real results. Even the [Voice of San Diego](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=639e1901cf&e=784f78234b) called her out for manipulating homelessness data to make it seem as though progress is being made when, in reality, the crisis is getting worse and you can visibly see it on the streets.
Under her watch, tent encampments have become common, hate crimes are on the rise, and families are struggling to afford to live here. We deserve better. We need leaders who don’t just talk about solutions, but act on them just like I did when I was mayor.
As Mayor, I rolled up my sleeves and got to work. We reduced homelessness by 10 percent, established new shelters and invested in critical mental health resources to turn people’s lives around. I’m running for County Supervisor to bring that same focus to the Board—to implement practical, compassionate policies that get people off the streets and into safe housing, restore our public spaces, and keep our neighborhoods safe and secure. Most importantly, I’m running to make it easier for our kids to have the same opportunities we had.
Today, let’s take a stand for the future of our county. Choose action over inaction, substance over spin. Together, we can bring real change to our communities and end the cycle of failed policies that have held us back. I humbly ask for your support today.
Sincerely,

clean_body: Choose Action Over Inaction on Homelessness Today | | | | | | | | | | | Dear Friend, Today, you have an important decision to make—a choice that will shape the future of San Diego County. Our communities are at a breaking point, and homelessness is the biggest challenge we face. Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer has had her chance to lead on this issue, but her inaction and lack of accountability have only made things worse. Instead of stepping up, Supervisor Lawson-Remer skipped critical votes and of the very homelessness task force she’s supposed to lead. Rather than addressing this crisis, she has chosen to virtue signal opting for appearances over real results. Even the called her out for manipulating homelessness data to make it seem as though progress is being made when, in reality, the crisis is getting worse and you can visibly see it on the streets. Under her watch, tent encampments have become common, hate crimes are on the rise, and families are struggling to afford to live here. We deserve better. We need leaders who don’t just talk about solutions, but act on them just like I did when I was mayor. As Mayor, I rolled up my sleeves and got to work. We reduced homelessness by 10 percent, established new shelters and invested in critical mental health resources to turn people’s lives around. I’m running for County Supervisor to bring that same focus to the Board—to implement practical, compassionate policies that get people off the streets and into safe housing, restore our public spaces, and keep our neighborhoods safe and secure. Most importantly, I’m running to make it easier for our kids to have the same opportunities we had. Today, let’s take a stand for the future of our county. Choose action over inaction, substance over spin. Together, we can bring real change to our communities and end the cycle of failed policies that have held us back. I humbly ask for your support today. body:
| | | Peter, this message is a bit on the longer side, but I hope you'll take the time to read it. **You see, in a lot of ways, this campaign is a love letter to Florida.** I can still remember the first time that I came to Florida. I was working on my master's degree and had just gotten the news that my beloved father had been killed by a criminal with a gun in Ecuador, where I was born. As I grappled with my grief, I found myself missing Ecuador more than I had in years. I missed its warmth, lush greenery, and close-knit communities that I grew up with. My older sister, Monica, knew our family was struggling, so she convinced me to visit her in Miami, where she had recently moved. When I stepped outside of the airport, it was like stepping into another world. **It was warm, wonderfully humid, bustling with lively, diverse communities, lush, and all so, so beautifully green.** We spent the next few days visiting all of Monica's favorite places in her new city — the spots with the most beautiful views and the best cafes to get a _cafecito_. The people we met were even warmer than the weather. Everyone was welcoming, friendly, and proud to call this state their home. I boarded my plane back to my home with a heavy heart but a new resolve. **As soon as I was able, I sold my car and moved across the country to live in a one room apartment in America.** (My mom, always my closest confidant, wasn't far behind.) Since moving here all those years ago, I've had the privilege to build a beautiful life in the Sunshine State. I fell in love here, found the community I had longed for, raised a family of my own, and dedicated my career to serving this state. I've helped protect the Everglades, expanded access to health care, worked for Florida International University, and became the first South American immigrant elected to Congress, right here in Florida. I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. **He wants you to think that Florida families agree with his extreme, hateful agenda._But I can promise you, friend, that couldn't be further from the truth._** Listen, my campaign is deeply personal because of my love for this state — and more importantly, because of what it will mean for my fellow Floridians. Rick Scott wants to sow division and undo decades of meaningful progress. He wants to destroy reproductive rights, gun safety laws, and vital public services, like Medicare and Social Security, that support millions of his constituents, including my own mother. Florida is ready for a change — I hear it from voters every day as I travel around all 67 counties. I know that Floridians will choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda. But the truth is, we're up against a mega-millionaire who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time. If we're going to break through Rick Scott's lies, build unstoppable grassroots momentum, and win this critical race, I'll need your help. **[Please, will you split $5 (or whatever you can spare today) to help me defeat Rick Scott and give our home the leadership that we deserve? body:
Peter,

Have you voted yet? If not, there’s still plenty of time to get to your polling place before 8:00 pm. Please find your voting location and make a plan to cast your vote right now.

FIND MY POLLING PLACE: https://pollfinder.sos.mn.gov/

Remember that you can register in-person at your polling place and you’ll be able to vote as long as you’re in line by 8:00 pm. If you’re in line when the polls close, please stay in line!

If you’ve already voted or made a plan to vote, reach out to five of your family members, friends, and neighbors and make sure they get to the polls. There are extremely close races up and down the ballot this year, and we need all of the help we can get to defeat Donald Trump and his MAGA Republican allies.

Thank you,

Team Keith

When I decided to announce my candidacy last year, I knew Pennsylvanians were fed up with Congressman Scott Perry. I had no idea though just how many of you would offer to knock doors, make phone calls, or donate. To those of you who have lent your support, it means the world to me. Here’s what I know: Scott Perry has “served” for six terms too long. He celebrated when _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned. When Donald Trump lost the 2020 election he perpetuated the Big Lie and helped organize the January 6th insurrection where 140 police officers were assaulted and five people lost their lives. body:
Team, **It’s Election Day, and I’m asking you to get out and vote.** With our democracy in the balance, this is the most consequential election in a generation. How Coloradans and Americans nationwide vote today will determine America’s and the world’s future for years to come. **That’s why I’m asking you to please vote to protect our freedoms, our climate future, and our democracy. ** _As you prepare to vote, here’s some information I hope you will find helpful:_
* Polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. across Colorado.
* If you’re not certain about where to vote, you can find your polling location at [GoVoteColorado.gov](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96641041/510680683/-1484070090?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Njc5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjFjNjBjMC1iMTliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iRGXWFaypkmMyJfw67t3aX0WkiwMSWiC4otnspUXqNo=&emci=61cb03cb-ab9b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=5b1c60c0-b19b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=25481868).
* If you are in line by 7:00 p.m. you will be allowed to vote.
* To vote in person, you must provide an acceptable form of identification. These include a Colorado driver’s license, a military ID, or a current utility bill.
* If you received a mail ballot, you can still drop your completed ballot at official drop boxes until 7pm MT today. You can find your nearest drop box [here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96641042/510680684/128464908?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Njc5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjFjNjBjMC1iMTliLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iRGXWFaypkmMyJfw67t3aX0WkiwMSWiC4otnspUXqNo=&emci=61cb03cb-ab9b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=5b1c60c0-b19b-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=25481868)
* If you lost your mail ballot or need to register you can still vote in person before 7 pm.

And now that Election Day is today, we're ready to do what so many have said was impossible: We're ready to flip Texas blue and send Ted packing!
But, Peter, I can't take this last day for granted, and I hope you won't either. If we are going to win this thing, we need to have the pedal to the metal to get my message out to every voter until the last vote in Texas is cast.
**So please, don't ignore this request. | | For Immediate ReleaseNovember 5, 2024 – Grand Rapids, Michigan After today, what's next for the Republican Party? Austin Chenge, a US Army Veteran and former Republican candidate for Governor of Michigan, today commented on what he anticipates will be a significant electoral shift for the Republican Party, signaling a broader trend towards political moderation in the United States."Today, we are witnessing an unprecedented turn in voter preference, with Republicans garnering an exceptional number of votes, not just from traditional party lines but significantly from independent voters," stated Chenge. "This shift is not merely about party politics; it's a reflection of the American public's desire for a balanced approach to governance that eschews the extremes." He added. Chenge's insights come at a critical juncture where the American electorate appears to be pushing back against the polarization that has characterized recent political discourse. "The policies we have campaigned on, which focus on the economy, immigration and common sense policies resonate with a wide array of voters who are seeking a return to common-sense governance," he explained. The current political climate reflects a growing consensus among Americans for leadership that transcends partisan battles. "Campaigns, and indeed the Republican platform, should be about promoting policies that have economic prosperity, ensure safety and security, and foster an environment where every American has the opportunity to thrive without government overreach," Chenge said. Highlighting the rejection of extremism, Chenge noted, "Americans from all walks of life are signaling they want no part in the political fringes. Whether it's the far-left's push for radical social changes or the far-right's unique ability to fall on their swords rather than compromise on key issues, there's a clear call for a moderate, pragmatic approach." This trend, according to Chenge, should serve as a blueprint for future political campaigns. "As we move forward, the message is clear: the American people crave solutions and cooperation over division. Political leaders must listen and act accordingly." Austin Chenge is a US Army Veteran, a Former Republican Governor Candidate for Michigan. He has served his country both in the military and through his political aspirations, aiming to bring a fresh, unifying voice to Michigan politics. Note: This press release was issued by The Office of Austin Chenge to reflect on the anticipated voting trends and their implications for political direction in the United States.

Hi Peter,

I hope all is well and that everyone is managing these final hours with determination and optimism. We will need both.

I wanted to share with you the email we sent to our board members last night as I thought you might be interested to hear our final numbers.

We are closing out 2024, having officially endorsed **80 candidates** across **_23 states and 1 U.S. territory._**

17% are running for federal office
20% are running for city/local positions
48% are running for State Legislature
10% are running for State Senate
5% are running for judicial positions

As you may already know, **we focused much of our 2024 work on states with abortion bans** (or impending abortion bans); paying special attention to the seats of incumbent legislators who helped get those bans passed. The guiding logic behind this prioritization was that the states with the lowest representation numbers for women in government (4%, 11%, 12%) and the states passing abortion bans and other dangerous laws about women... are the same states.

We are extremely confident that we'll have _one of our highest win rates yet_ after today (!!!!) thanks to the following support we were able to offer candidates:
* Fundraising support
* Thousands of volunteers across the country / Around-the-clock voter outreach
* Candidate connection meetings / exclusive candidate opportunities
* National and local publicity work on behalf of our candidates
* Pro bono comms training
* And much more!

**As I've said before and will say again, none of this would be possible without our supporters on EVERY LEVEL. The grassroots donations we receive from emails like this one have fueled our work and enabled us to grow our candidate support programs exponentially year after year. Thank you for all you do and for your continued prioritization of this mission.**

Happy Election Day! Today's the last day to vote, so remember to cast your ballot and remind your friends and family to make their voices heard. Visit [iwillvote.com](https://substack.com/redirect/e4f7a4ae-dc21-46ca-b95a-9227bde64fbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to see how and where to vote in your jurisdiction.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6158aeae-b20a-4b88-a191-b84ef08bb89a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While we wait for polls to close, I want to take some time now before the madness to share information about what happens next.
When polls close, we still start seeing partial returns. That's because election officials are releasing results as the counting of ballots is ongoing. In some states, the first batch of results also includes early ballots that election officials have counted ahead of time but have waited to release. Most election results sites will indicate what percentage of votes have been counted.
As results start coming in, journalists will start calling races. That means that based on the available partial returns, it is mathematically guaranteed that one candidate will win once all the ballots are counted. The more competitive a race is, the later we will have to wait for it to be called, which could mean a few days or even a few weeks. For example, in 2018, it took 9 days for me to be declared the winner in California's 45th Congressional District.
Often in these close races, campaigns will facilitate ballot curing, depending on what state law permits. This is when voters fix errors that caused their ballot to be rejected, such as a signature that doesn't match what elections officials have on file. **And, they are great low-pressure opportunities to volunteer with a campaign to make sure every vote is counted!**
If there is an especially narrow margin, we might also find ourselves in a recount situation. Some states automatically require recounts if the margin is under a certain threshold, while other states rely on one of the campaigns to request one. During a recount, both campaigns will send people to the local elections office to monitor the process and make sure it's done correctly.
With all of these processes, that's why I always say that we don't have Election Day; we have Election Season. We can't panic if a winner isn't declared immediately--**we keep doing our parts in democracy.**
Buckle up! I'll see you on the other side.
Katie Porter

_It’s not over yet._

Everything we’ve worked for is on the line. My opponent, Martin Heinrich, has stood with the far-left, open-border crowd instead of with our families and values. This election is our chance to take New Mexico back – to take our country back!

**Here's some great news:** Republicans turned out at a higher rate than Democrats during early voting — _57% to 52%!_ Our hard work is paying off.

We’re so close, but I need you with me in these final hours. [**Every dollar counts in this fight to flip this seat and restore a Republican majority in the Senate.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3e25fd01b1594ef4a65ef793366bdce8&_e=JzdmQgatxs28bCdBHasjrObylZg0RpwiIPGowA5BDdxQbZPMMmpYYzMggYRg_3XNpx37z5r9E44qvkjzF5rnkmpd1pZMVSHdJC3OewxyAYMW6oQSOKLwIDAfwvPVW4qR9sonZ6Y__NNKXeEHS4YuHNmYXWVcsvq-sB-xQXWPlNx7rcBUL-YDtWMab5el-TRExBZLfnNX3xo8RRHtJP8vB5WSXPLcaGCv5PHi8Qm2-rD5sUDZSOXhyvZCov71BAdnLGw6rMSTAc7zKaquqYpwmwefH1TghJQAHw1lY_NoJmCSGT6mAVY6FVtI-ETfLslQ_y1MoXOu3KhxWqkTdWEQ1OqJgpQ0QjI9j1L0wb-Cz3fKij4bMVgGsOYVF7RsGGOGhFu_KHjr0N-kmPqKjOeYj-x_zh784YCZ7pP46zYoF4o%3D)

# When We Vote We Win!

Dear Friends,
Today is Election Day, and I want to share a personal reflection. I became an American citizen in 1996, sworn in right here in Roanoke, Virginia—not far from where I will be tonight at the Harris-Walz victory party at Howard University. My first opportunity to vote was for President Clinton’s reelection. While every election has been important and has had lasting consequences, this one feels different—there is so much more at stake. That is why we must elect my friend, Vice President Harris, and Democrats up and down the ballot.
Vice President Harris is the best candidate to move our country forward. She has consistently championed policies that uplift working families, protect our rights, and promote equality for all. Her experience as a prosecutor and Attorney General gives her a unique perspective on justice and reform, and her commitment to addressing climate change and healthcare access is crucial for our future. With her leadership, we can build a more inclusive and prosperous America.
In 2016, many of us took for granted what could happen, but this time, we know the stakes. We've witnessed firsthand the impact of a Trump presidency: the hate, the bigotry, the divisive rhetoric, the incompetence, and the radical far-right policies. We cannot afford to go back.
As we face one of the closest elections in decades, with polls indicating a dead heat, our actions matter more than ever. I urge you to reach out to friends, neighbors, family members, and colleagues. Make calls, send texts, write emails, and visit those in your community to emphasize the importance of voting. Everyone needs to understand what is at stake.
This election isn’t just about candidates; it’s about our values, our rights, and the future we want for ourselves and generations to come. Every vote is a powerful statement. Together, we can shape the future we envision.
I also want to express my heartfelt gratitude to all of you who have supported this effort—whether through donations, volunteering, or spreading the word. Your commitment means the world to me.Let’s make our voices heard today. The future is in our hands, and it starts with each of us casting our vote.
Thank you for your friendship and support.
Asif
P.S. Every vote counts—let’s make it happen! Click on my X account below for live campaign updates throughout the day and into the night. Your engagement makes a difference!

New Hampshire has been my family's home for generations. No one does democracy like we do in the Live Free or Die state. Growing up here in New Hampshire taught me that democracy isn’t just something you watch from the sidelines – it’s something you participate in. I got into this race because Granite Staters deserve a leader who will stand up for reproductive rights, defend our democracy, and hold corporate monopolies accountable for raising prices and exploiting consumers. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: It’s been a wild ride.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that more than 400,000 people would back me up and donate to support me
#

everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. Ruben Gallego is in a tie race, and we’ve only got a few hours until the polls close. He’s going to need our help as he prepares for what comes next. [**Please, read this message from Ruben’s team, and then make a donation if you can.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=1&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
---

Hola, my friend. It’s Ruben.
You might be wondering how this kid...
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=2&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
...ended up where I am now. Running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country, with everyone watching to see how we do tomorrow night.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=3&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
Let me take you back to the beginning. It all started in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=4&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=5&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=6&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
I deployed to al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest hit Marine unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=7&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=8&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=9&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
I decided to run for U.S. Senate, and I’m up against Kari Lake. The “MAGA Queen.” She’s spread more lies and conspiracies about our elections than anyone in the country, after Trump himself.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=10&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.
When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.
When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that more than 400,000 people would back me up and donate to support me, either.
And with hours to go, I never thought it would come down to this. We’re in a neck-and-neck race. Lake and I are tied, and our Senate Majority hangs in the balance.
I know you’ve already done so much to help me, David. But I need you one more time.
[**Please — if you could split an $3 donation between Mark Kelly and me today it would mean the world to me. Races this close come down to turnout, and we need all the resources we can get now as we rush to reach our voters and get them to the polls.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241105-2-120&t=11&akid=5920%2E6688874%2Eah4d0h)

clean_body: | | | Fellow Patriot, With Election Day being today, I owe you an explanation... If you’re reading this message, it’s probably because you’re a financial supporter of the GOP and the America First movement. A lot of people are asking you for your financial support — but not many people are telling you exactly how they’ll use (or have used) your donation. So I’d like to clear that up here and now: ** So we use advertisements on TV, social media, and all across the internet to reach those people and inform them about the Conservative choice in their local election! As you probably know, advertisements aren’t cheap, and the Democrats have a habit of outspending us. That’s why we need your help to build a war chest that can drive Conservatives across the country to VICTORY. Grassroots phone banking and door knocking operations are critical to the success of any Conservative campaign! But these operations aren’t free. We have to supply our grassroots volunteers with print materials, scripts, meals, transportation, phones and tablets, and the software to log responses from voters. Believe me, when I first ran for office, the bills for all this blew me away. But it’s a necessary component of true grassroots campaigns! As Conservatives, we’re fed up with the norm of always promoting career politicians. I’m proud to say that Team Johnson is helping passionate, everyday Conservative Americans who feel called to serve and represent their communities. But you can’t build an effective campaign operation, complete with staff, yard signs, bumper stickers, and get a message out to thousands of people without serious financial resources. I know it’s never been a secret that campaigns need money, but I hope I helped pull back the curtains on why and how we use our resources with this message. ** You invest in the future of America. You invest your trust in the people leading the Conservative charge. You invest your resources to protect our freedoms. I truly can’t thank you enough for making an investment in Team Johnson. Sincerely, Speaker Mike Johnson | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4795%2E552475%2E8SMHbL)
Peter, did you see our note?
It’s not too late to cast your ballot. You have until 8 PM to get in line to vote at your polling place or drop off your ballot. And remember, if you’re in line by 8 PM, stay in line!
Find your polling place or ballot drop-off location: **[IWillVote.com/PA](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/2428?t=2&akid=4795%2E552475%2E8SMHbL)**
Thanks!

_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Team Casey [info@bobcasey.com]
Date: Tues, Nov 5, 2024
Subject: It all comes down to this
_
Hi Peter,
Throughout this campaign, we’ve been grateful for your support in our fight for women’s rights, workers’ rights, and voting rights – for the Commonwealth and across the country.
Bob has always stood up for our Commonwealth and fought for working families across Pennsylvania, and he won’t stop now. That’s why he decided to run for re-election because there are so many key fights we still must win.
It’s been a long and hard-fought journey, and now, it all comes down to today.
[**Polls are open until 8 PM tonight, and we need to make sure as many Pennsylvanians as possible cast their ballots in these final hours. That includes you, Peter.**](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/2428?t=3&akid=4795%2E552475%2E8SMHbL)
If you’ve already voted, thank you for making your voice heard. Can you forward this message to three friends and make sure they get out and vote too?
If you haven’t voted yet, we hope you will make a plan to vote today. Go to **[IWillVote.com/PA](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/2428?t=4&akid=4795%2E552475%2E8SMHbL)** to find your polling place, and make a plan to vote before 8 PM.
Together, we’ll win.
– Team Casey
P.S. If you have questions about casting your ballot, the PA Voter Protection Assistance Hotline is available 24/7 via call or text: 1-833-PA-VOTES.

Bob Casey for Senate

Philadelphia, PA 19102

If you knew a donation of $20 could defeat Kari Lake for good, wouldn’t you chip it in right away?
If you knew that $20 could help defeat Trump in Arizona (and probably ensure his defeat nationwide), wouldn’t that be some of the best money you’ve ever spent?
If that $20 donation could put an end to the last eight years of MAGA Right politics and help us move forward together as a country... Why wouldn’t you donate?
It might not seem like your donation of $20 could do all that. Up against millions of dollars from Lake and the outside groups who are trying to get her elected, I get that.
But I’ve got to tell you: Just about every dollar we’ve raised in this campaign has come from someone like you, chipping in whatever they could when the time was right for them.
Those donations have gotten us this far. 400,000 of them.
And today, with just hours to go, I need you to make one more. With Kari Lake outspending us on television, every dollar we raise goes towards narrowing the gap.
Your $20 could determine the outcome of this election. Really.
So, please. I know you can’t donate to every email we send, but if you could dig deep and split that $20 donation with Tim Kaine, I would be incredibly grateful. I won’t forget it. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]

clean_body: | | | Peter, this is the last email I will send before the polls close. We cannot wake up tomorrow wishing we had done more. That is why I am requesting your donation on behalf of Cresco to help turn out the final voters we need to win. I notice all you have done to power our fight, and I am so grateful. But we must not cut any corners as we work to turn the page on Donald Trump. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | Thank you, Kamala \-----Forwarded message----- Sender: Kamala Harris Date: Tuesday, November 5, 2024 Subject: Peter, once you have voted, you can take no more meaningful action to defeat Trump than donating $47 to help our team reach voters in the battleground states. Peter, for too long, Donald Trump has tried to keep the American people divided and afraid. Today, we can finally turn the page and usher in a new generation of leadership. I am ready to be your next President of the United States. But millions of our fellow citizens are still considering who to vote for -- or whether to vote at all. We must make every effort to turn them out in these final few hours. To that end, I have one last request. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | Peter, if there is one thing I want voters to remember today, it is this: I believe in the promise of America. My mother taught me not to complain about injustice, but to actually do something about it. I will never forget where I come from. Who I fight for. And why I love our country. The patriots who came before us did not struggle, sacrifice, and lay down their lives, only to see us submit to the will of Donald Trump and cede our fundamental freedoms. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | Generations will look back upon what we did at this historic moment. I want us to be able to tell them with conviction that we stood tall, shoulders back, and fought for what we believed in. Thank you for everything, Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States | | | |

name: Jill Stein
subject: Before the polls close
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_gotv&n=1)
---
Peter,

The polls will begin closing on the East Coast soon, and I wanted to take a moment to celebrate all that we achieved together over the last year.

**We built a movement so powerful that the DNC set up an entire war room just to try and knock us down** – with a budget and staff levels equivalent to our entire campaign.

They harassed us with expensive lawsuits to kick us off the ballot. They marginalized and smeared us in the media. They posted jobs seeking people to manage spies and infiltrators to mess up our campaign (which they took offline when exposed).

They even launched an attack ad against us – something they’d never done for any third party contender before.

**It backfired**** _madly_****.** Every time they pounced, their attack dogs – AOC, DNC chair Jaime Harrison, Thom Hartman, Angela Rye and more – were ridiculed and dragged on social media.

As a result, **a whole new multiracial, multigenerational coalition of voters, organizers, and activists have joined forces with the Green Party** – and that coalition will only grow.

Our campaign made connections and built relationships with powerhouse anti-genocide activists, especially in the Muslim and Arab American community; the student movement; the reawakened antiwar movement; and the liberated labor movement with Workers Strike Back and Kshama Sawant.

Just this week Middle East Eye reported that the Democratic party shuffled $400,000 to the Uncommitted Movement in an apparent effort to buy their silence and guarantee they would not endorse any candidate opposing Harris.

These tactics will not work. Opposition to the Democratic leadership has hardened over this administration’s unforgivable crimes in Gaza.

This is our moment. The pressure will continue to build for the political transformation that the American people demand.

The political elites will continue to tell you that resistance is futile. Ignore them.

In 2020, one in three eligible voters refused to vote for either major party presidential candidate, particularly young people, people of color, and people of lower income. Exactly the people our agenda speaks to.

**The vast majority of voters are calling for a political alternative like us, one that serves the greater good instead of the economic elites.

** The Democrats are quaking in their boots that the public is discovering us. They will be shocked to see how much our coalition grows as more voters discover they actually have a choice for the future they deserve.

We have the solutions to end genocide and empire; to adopt a foreign policy based on international law, human rights and diplomacy; to reverse the climate emergency; to reverse wealth inequality and invest in human thriving; to dismantle systems of oppression and build a society rooted in justice, freedom, and equity.

Our movement for people, planet, and peace is aligned with the values and priorities of the American people, and we have the numbers we need to transform our future.

We just have to get the word out to the millions of Americans who reject the failed status quo, and bring them into our movement.

Everything we have achieved together is a victory for working families, for justice, for peace and a future where all of us can thrive.

**Thank you for your unwavering support and for helping us build an America and a world that works for all of us. We will only get stronger from here.

****Together, we’re unstoppable!

** In solidarity and gratitude, Jill

name: Gov. Larry Hogan
subject: From the bottom of my heart, thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hogan for Maryland, Inc
body:
Now is the time to come together
---
| | | | | | | [](https://click.email1.larryhogan.com/?qs=a9c6ccfd2978a91eb1e5618903ac5d368fc3dd409164b7bd04b608110e0ea571de48367b7fc8e61ef79b8b9196b41307887cffbef7ed3fd50be3e403fd0925c2)
Friend,

I want to congratulate County Executive Alsobrooks on a hard-fought victory.

Tonight, regardless of who you voted for, we can all take pride in the election of the first Black woman to represent Maryland in the U.S. Senate.

Yumi and I offer our best wishes and our prayers to Angela and her family.

**Now is the time for us to come together and move forward as one state and one nation.**

I want to thank you to each and every person who stood by my side throughout this campaign.

If the pundits and politicians were more like the people I met every single day on the campaign trail, our country would be so much better off.

I stepped up to run because I was concerned about what kind of a future we would be leaving for all of our kids and grandkids.

**We got into this race for the right reasons: to fix the broken politics and to put our country on the right track.**

We ran the kind of campaign that represents what politics can be-and what it should be-driven by the people, not the party bosses, and focused on the issues that actually matter to families all across Maryland.

From day one, this was the only campaign in America that reached out to Republicans, Democrats, Independents alike.

Because that's what it's going to take to solve the serious problems we face.

Americans today are thoroughly convinced that we're hopelessly divided, that Washington is completely dysfunctional, and that our entire political system is fundamentally broken.

The voices of the exhausted majority are ignored in deference to the demands of the loudest and angriest few who seem hell-bent on tearing America apart.

No matter what happens in this election, we as a country must move beyond talking only with those we agree with.

And we need to stop dismissing or even hating those we disagree with.

**We have got to find a way to come together, to listen, and to believe in each other once again.**

There really is far more that unites us than divides.

**While tonight was not the outcome we hoped for, we can all hold our heads high.**

I can tell you we left it all on the field, and I'm so damn proud of the effort.

**Thank you all.**

We proved that campaigns can be about so much more than just red versus blue.

I kept stressing that we need to get back to the red, white, and blue.

**Though this chapter ends tonight, our work and our commitment to a brighter future and a better path forward will continue.**

_The stakes are too high to stop now.

The stakes are far too high for any of us to walk away and just sit on the sideline._

So to everyone who stood with us in this cause, who worked, fought, and believed in this campaign, let me say this:

**_You should never apologize for standing up for decency and common sense.

Never give in to fear or cynicism.

And never, ever, give up on the work of changing Maryland and America for the better._**

Thank you, God bless you all, and may God bless the great State of Maryland and the United States of America.

Sincerely,
Governor Larry Hogan | [DONATE](https://click.email1.larryhogan.com/?qs=a9c6ccfd2978a91eb1e5618903ac5d368fc3dd409164b7bd04b608110e0ea571de48367b7fc8e61ef79b8b9196b41307887cffbef7ed3fd50be3e403fd0925c2)

As we reach the end of Election Day, I am overcome with gratitude for this team.

Growing up in a military family, I never lived in one place for very long. When I moved to the Lehigh Valley nearly 40 years ago, I fell in love with the community, and I knew this was where I wanted to stay and raise a family.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

It's Election Day, Peter.

Today, we’re proud to support our Justice Democrats incumbents on the
ballot for re-election: Representatives Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Summer
Lee, Ayanna Pressley, Delia Ramirez, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Greg Casar,
Pramila Jayapal, Ro Khanna, and Raúl Grijalva. If you live in one of their
districts, please make sure to vote for these progressive champions!

Together, we hope to flip the House from red to blue so that our bloc has
a better shot at passing the bold solutions our country needs, including
an arms embargo on Israel, a livable minimum wage, Medicare for All, a
Green New Deal, and more.

Control of the U.S. Senate is also up for grabs today, as well as other
state and local offices. And of course, today our country decides the next
President of the United States: Vice President Kamala Harris or right-wing
fascist Donald Trump.

This is a critical election that will no doubt have impacts for decades to
come. Regardless of who wins, Justice Democrats needs to gear up and be
ready for the fights ahead.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20241105?refcode=em20241105-36127&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36127_1203867_5buNi_&akid=36127%2E1203867%2E5buNi_ ]The next election cycle begins tomorrow,
Peter, so will you fuel our work by pitching in
$5 to our 2025-2026 Candidate Recruitment Fund today?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20241105?refcode=em20241105-36127&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36127_1203867_5buNi_&akid=36127%2E1203867%2E5buNi_ ]Contribute $5

This election leaves a fractured nation, divided by right-wing
fear-mongering around immigrants and other marginalized communities, that
continues to be robbed of the future it deserves by the same billionaires
funding that division.

Now is urgently a moment for a new generation of leaders to usher in a new
Democratic Party that is united across our shared needs and against our
shared enemies of corporations, billionaires, and right-wing Super PACs
that seek to divide us while picking our pockets.

No matter what happens coming out of today, we’re going to keep up the
momentum for our progressive movement, work to get billionaires and
corporate Super PACs out of our politics, and elect progressive leaders
who will truly represent everyday people.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

P.S. If you haven’t already, make your voice heard before the polls close
tonight! [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/7815?t=1002&akid=36127%2E1203867%2E5buNi_ ]You can find your polling place and hours here →

Hi, Peter.

I proudly cast my vote in person in Santa Fe today, and now I’m checking in with you with just a few hours left until the polls close.

I’ve also been busy today coordinating with my team, making calls, and doing final interviews because there’s still work to do to turn out voters and win this fight.

My team and I are taking advantage of every minute until the last ballot is cast, [**and I’m hoping that you can still chip in $5 to support our Election Day efforts.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=b8cd7702cc734137b9ccebe6b37013a0&_e=kJHdcY8tLCMZsHb--kMnJE0nugiEAhypf0Q8PpWLB1iSHdZtg51ryHVCJ9cJmINWqXapYFbX6FesvR44iSqQr-xRDCvOZlIqmrgUn5ncRDGBR_cnBKP-HVH5z2zyEx48Ve-f_H0W_ZRksdPIrynOpya7Jj44qfsTzUb6ORiOLwisnRwsHkAtmEGmIfIGyYNcjlM49tfGla-E-J2cjo8RQ53EgfYNkJr0_F4p-a1SugavU7f-x1A3aKcCyH9eVl2kjOLIXtugE4tVdQPzzUc1rP7dB10wEN6TU4410TmMDcmglYkLwAbPIk7lo1XJQelH42WTMS5V4tyPMFW5ACRZC5AaSBQhX3av7qtpvqsYrTCsVgOX03KLbKZX_iz5-_NvOzi5ZY0MqAQjpkSoUB40EZue5Sl-Z4djXNzgybJGdE0%3D)

Moreover, I hope you’ve cast your vote today. If not, you still have time. [**Click here to check your polling place and get out there before 7 pm.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=b8cd7702cc734137b9ccebe6b37013a0&_e=kJHdcY8tLCMZsHb--kMnJGYIH4qrTg0gBUyAY60Gr3rx612peBpX3Mg_XqnBNbzrmdPfjMM_CIF-6IhzSiUf69BnmNPzt5icQ_U-I-GrtuK0_4DivX6HeC5bCg2r6qvIkKmKuuU5bUClZcZ-KSFSynHcigE_YR0wrWjvUJYYMsRyx9fk8D2Mq5C00HtggpKjpp5-nxq_-KyeUc_yLJX9gl_DDS2shImUYJQ9o_L4W2G_EYYcRQH0op-0Jt6sJ-An) And once you’re in line by 7 pm, **STAY THERE!**

Thank you!

**-Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| Team,

As we wait for the polls to close in Michigan, I wanted to reach out one last time.

Together, we’ve built something powerful. Over the past few months, I’ve had the privilege of meeting so many people across West Michigan–sharing hopes, hearing your stories, and working toward a future where every one of us can thrive.

I am beyond grateful for everything you’ve done to get us here. Your support, your voice, and your commitment to this campaign have meant everything.

Tomorrow marks one year since **the largest number of Jewish civilians were killed in one day since the Holocaust**. The world said, “Never again,” yet the blood of 1,300 men, women, and children _cries out from the ground_. October 7, 2023 is hardly just a memory because the bloodshed has not ended. Rockets, missiles, attack drones, and more are being used as tools of carnage and destruction against the people of Israel**to this day**. And more than 100 hostages remain in captivity. But not every story is a sad one. Some are tremendously inspiring. Thousands of paramedics, EMTs, soldiers, police, and everyday civilians found themselves in extraordinary circumstances and **took heroic actions to save lives.** Some gave their last measure of courage in the process. The men and women of **MAGEN DAVID ADOM,** Israel’s emergency services system, have saved tens of thousands of lives in the last 365 days. Yet, 38 of these brave medical professionals have lost their own lives in the process, averaging one loss every 10 days. This is a time of tears and tenacity in Israel. A day to remember those who were lost, taken, and broken on October 7 and over the past year. And a day to take courage and “strengthen the feeble hands, steady the knees that give way.” It is a day to remember that the spirit of the people of Israel will not be broken by rockets and terror attacks. **And a day to remember that God Almighty still fights for Israel.** Any minute we are expecting the next wave of attacks. Our team is working right up until polls close to get out the vote.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241105-4497-footer&t=1&akid=4497%2E420207%2EKZX3j9)
Peter, it’s a busy day for Team Pramila, so we’ll keep this short!
**Remember: If you’re in line to vote when polls close,_stay in line!_** If you can vote in-person, you are still eligible to cast your ballot as long as you entered the line before polls close!
We’re seeing reports of long lines and incredible enthusiasm all across the country, **_but_ we can’t take anything for granted**. We need to make sure as many people as possible cast their ballots so we can hand Donald Trump such an enormous loss that it’s _impossible_ for him to claim that he won.
That’s why our team is working right up until polls close to get out the vote — and since this is a people-powered movement that doesn’t take corporate PAC money, we’re counting on your grassroots support to do it.
